steps.text: Early 219: after a year of stalemate, Liu Bei crosses the Mian River and camps on Mount Dingjun. When Xiahou Yuan comes to contest it, Huang Zhong charges down the slope and kills him.
steps.text_zh: 219年正月，刘备与曹军在阳平关相持一年后，南渡沔水，依山扎营于定军山。夏侯渊来争，法正看准时机，黄忠居高临下猛攻，斩杀夏侯渊。

steps.text: Spring 219: Cao Cao comes in person, but Liu Bei holds the passes and will not fight. With supplies failing, Cao withdraws his whole army from Hanzhong in the fifth month.
steps.text_zh: 219年春，曹操亲率大军赶到汉中，刘备据险坚守，不与交战。曹军运粮困难，士卒逃亡，相持两个多月后，曹操于五月全军撤出汉中。

steps.text: Autumn 219: Liu Bei proclaims himself King of Hanzhong at Mianyang and leaves Wei Yan to hold the region. It is the high point of his career; within weeks Guan Yu marches on Fancheng.
steps.text_zh: 219年七月，刘备在沔阳设坛，自称汉中王，留魏延镇守汉中。这是刘备一生事业的顶点；不久关羽北攻樊城，局势随即逆转。

title: The Battle of Yiling
summary: Guan Yu's loss of Jing province sets Liu Bei against Sun Quan; at Yiling the young Lu Xun burns the Shu camps and the Three Kingdoms settle into place.
summary_zh: 关羽失荆州，刘备倾国东征报仇；年轻的陆逊在夷陵火烧连营，三国格局从此定型。

steps.text: Autumn 219: Guan Yu marches north from Jing province and besieges Cao Ren in Fancheng. Heavy rains flood the Han River, seven relief armies drown, Yu Jin surrenders and Pang De is executed.
steps.text_zh: 219年秋，关羽从荆州北攻樊城。连日大雨，汉水暴涨，于禁所督七军被淹，于禁投降，庞德被斩。关羽威震华夏，曹操一度商议迁都避其锋芒。

steps.text: Winter 219: Sun Quan strikes Guan Yu from behind. Lü Meng hides soldiers in boats disguised as merchant ships, seizes the river watchtowers by night, and the commanders of Gong'an and Jiangling surrender.
steps.text_zh: 219年冬，孙权背盟偷袭荆州。吕蒙让士兵穿白衣扮成商人，藏在船中摇橹，夜袭江边的烽火台，公安守将士仁、江陵守将糜芳相继投降。

steps.text: Winter 219: Guan Yu turns back, but his soldiers desert once they hear their families in Jiangling are well treated. He shelters in Maicheng, slips west, and is captured and beheaded with his son Guan Ping.
steps.text_zh: 219年冬，关羽回师，吕蒙厚待将士家属，关羽部众纷纷离散。他退守麦城，向西突围，在临沮被吴将擒获，与儿子关平一同被杀。荆州尽归孙权。

steps.text: 221: after Cao Pi ends the Han, Liu Bei declares himself emperor of Han in Chengdu. Ignoring objections, he prepares to attack Wu, but Zhang Fei is murdered by his own officers before the army sets out.
steps.text_zh: 221年，曹丕代汉之后，刘备在成都称帝，国号仍为汉，史称蜀汉。他不顾群臣劝阻，决意东征孙权，出发前张飞在阆中被部将杀害。

steps.text: 221: the Shu army comes down the Yangzi gorges, beats the Wu vanguard at Wu county and occupies Zigui. Sun Quan offers peace, is refused, and declares himself Cao Pi's vassal to avoid a war on two fronts.
steps.text_zh: 221年，蜀军沿长江三峡东下，在巫县击破吴军前锋，进驻秭归。孙权求和被拒，于是向魏称臣，受封吴王，以免两面受敌。

steps.text: 222: Sun Quan gives command to the young Lu Xun. Lu pulls back out of the mountains and refuses battle for months. Liu Bei strings dozens of camps along the gorges; Cao Pi hears of it and predicts his defeat.
steps.text_zh: 222年，孙权任命年轻的陆逊为大都督。陆逊退出山地，坚守不战七八个月。刘备沿山连营数十座，曹丕听说后断言：哪有七百里连营能抵御敌人的？

steps.text: Summer 222: with the Shu troops worn out in the heat, Lu Xun orders each soldier to carry a bundle of reeds and sets the camps alight. More than forty camps fall and the Shu army collapses.
steps.text_zh: 222年夏，蜀军久驻疲惫，陆逊命士兵各持一把茅草，火攻蜀营，一举攻破四十多座营寨，在猇亭一带大败蜀军。蜀将冯习、张南等战死。

steps.text: 223: Liu Bei escapes to Baidi, his rearguard burning armour to block the mountain road. Dying, he entrusts his son Liu Shan to Zhuge Liang, telling him to take the throne himself if the boy proves unfit.
steps.text_zh: 223年，靠驿兵烧铠甲堵路逃回白帝城的刘备病重，托孤诸葛亮，说：“若嗣子可辅，辅之；如其不才，君可自取。”不久病逝。

steps.text: Winter 223: Zhuge Liang sends Deng Zhi to Sun Quan at Wuchang. Wu breaks with Wei and renews the alliance with Shu, which holds until Shu falls forty years later.
steps.text_zh: 223年冬，诸葛亮派邓芝出使武昌，说服孙权与魏断绝往来，吴蜀重新结盟。此后两国再未交兵，联盟一直维持到蜀汉灭亡。

title: The Three Kingdoms end in Jin
summary: Shu loses at Yiling, the Sima clan takes over Wei, and the Jin dynasty conquers Shu and Wu to reunite the realm.
summary_zh: 从夷陵之战到高平陵之变，司马氏取代曹魏，先后灭蜀、灭吴，三国归于一统。

steps.text: 222: Liu Bei marches against Wu to retake Jing province and avenge Guan Yu. Lu Xun refuses battle for months, then sets fire to the strung-out Shu camps in summer. Liu Bei flees to Baidi.
steps.text_zh: 222年，刘备为夺回荆州、替关羽报仇东征孙吴。吴将陆逊坚守不战，趁夏季火攻蜀军连营，刘备大败退回白帝城。

steps.text: 249: while the regent Cao Shuang escorts the young emperor to the Gaoping tombs, Sima Yi seizes Luoyang and later executes Cao Shuang and his faction. Real power in Wei passes to the Sima clan.
steps.text_zh: 249年，曹爽陪魏帝曹芳出城祭扫高平陵，司马懿趁机在洛阳发动政变，诛杀曹爽一党。魏国大权从此落入司马氏手中。

steps.text: 263: Wei invades Shu, but Jiang Wei holds Zhong Hui's main army at Jiange. Deng Ai leaves Yinping and cuts a road for over 700 li through empty mountains to surprise Jiangyou.
steps.text_zh: 263年，魏分兵伐蜀，钟会大军被姜维挡在剑阁。邓艾从阴平出发，在无人之地凿山开路七百余里，偷袭江油。

steps.text: 263: Deng Ai defeats Zhuge Liang's son Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu and appears before Chengdu. Liu Shan comes out and surrenders, and Shu Han falls after forty-three years.
steps.text_zh: 263年，邓艾在绵竹击败诸葛亮之子诸葛瞻，兵临成都。后主刘禅出城投降，立国四十三年的蜀汉灭亡。

steps.text: 266: early in the year Sima Yan, son of Sima Zhao, forces the last Wei emperor to abdicate and founds the Jin dynasty at Luoyang. Of the three kingdoms only Wu remains.
steps.text_zh: 266年初，司马昭之子司马炎逼魏元帝曹奂禅位，建立晋朝，定都洛阳。三国只剩下孙吴。

steps.text: 272: Wang Jun begins building a war fleet in Yi province; the largest ships carry over two thousand men and have decks wide enough to ride on. Wood chips float down the Yangzi, but the Wu ruler Sun Hao ignores the warning.
steps.text_zh: 272年起，王濬在益州大造战船，大船能载两千余人，船上可以驰马往来。造船的木屑顺江漂下，吴主孙皓却不加理会。

steps.text: 280: early in the year Jin attacks Wu along six routes. Wang Jun's fleet sails down the Yangzi, clears the iron spikes with rafts, melts the river chains with torches and takes Xiling, Xiakou and Wuchang.
steps.text_zh: 280年初，晋军六路伐吴。王濬船队顺江东下，用大筏冲开江中铁锥，用火炬烧断横江的铁锁，连破西陵、夏口、武昌。

steps.text: 280: in the third month Wang Jun's fleet reaches Jianye and Sun Hao surrenders. The age of the Three Kingdoms is over and the realm is united again.
steps.text_zh: 280年三月，王濬水军直抵建业石头城下，吴主孙皓投降。三国鼎立的局面结束，天下重归一统。

title: Zhuge Liang's northern campaigns
summary: Shu Han's chancellor secures the south, then leads army after army out of Hanzhong against Wei until he dies at Wuzhang Plains.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮平定南中后，五次从汉中出兵伐魏，最终病逝于五丈原。

steps.text: 225: Zhuge Liang marches south and puts down the revolts in the Nanzhong commanderies. The rear of Shu Han is secure, and the south now supplies men and goods for war in the north.
steps.text_zh: 225年，诸葛亮率军南征，平定南中各郡的叛乱，稳住了蜀汉的后方，也为北伐提供了兵源和物资。

steps.text: 227: Zhuge Liang submits his famous memorial on the campaign to Liu Shan and moves the main army to Hanzhong, the forward base for every attack on Wei.
steps.text_zh: 227年，诸葛亮向后主刘禅呈上《出师表》，随后率主力进驻汉中，把这里作为北伐魏国的前进基地。

steps.text: 228: in spring Zhuge Liang feints toward Mei through the Xie valley and leads the main army out by Mount Qi. Nan'an, Tianshui and Anding go over to Shu, and the Wei valley is alarmed.
steps.text_zh: 228年春，诸葛亮扬言从斜谷攻郿县，自己却率主力出祁山。南安、天水、安定三郡响应蜀汉，关中震动。

steps.text: 228: Ma Su ignores his orders and camps on a hill away from water. Zhang He cuts him off and routs him at Jieting. Shu must fall back to Hanzhong, and Zhuge Liang executes Ma Su.
steps.text_zh: 228年，马谡违背诸葛亮的部署，舍水上山扎营，被魏将张郃断绝水源，在街亭大败。蜀军只得退回汉中，诸葛亮斩马谡以谢众。

steps.text: 228: in winter Zhuge Liang crosses the San pass and besieges Chencang. The Wei commander Hao Zhao holds out for over twenty days with about a thousand men, and Shu withdraws when its grain runs out.
steps.text_zh: 228年冬，诸葛亮出散关围攻陈仓。魏将郝昭只有千余人，坚守二十多天，蜀军粮尽撤退。

steps.text: 229: Zhuge Liang sends Chen Shi to take the commanderies of Wudu and Yinping and drives off the Wei general Guo Huai himself, one of the few lasting gains of all his northern campaigns.
steps.text_zh: 229年，诸葛亮派陈式攻取武都、阴平二郡，并亲自出兵击退魏将郭淮，这是历次北伐中少有的实际收获。

steps.text: 231: Zhuge Liang returns to Mount Qi, moving grain with his 'wooden oxen', and faces Sima Yi. Shu wins near Shanggui but must retire for lack of supplies; the pursuing Wei general Zhang He is killed by an arrow.
steps.text_zh: 231年，诸葛亮再出祁山，用木牛运粮，与司马懿对峙。蜀军在上邽一带击败魏军，但终因粮运不继退兵，追击的魏将张郃中箭身亡。

steps.text: 234: Zhuge Liang leads 100,000 men through the Xie valley, sets up farms at Wuzhang Plains and faces Sima Yi across the Wei River for over a hundred days. In the eighth month he dies in camp and Shu withdraws.
steps.text_zh: 234年，诸葛亮率十万大军出斜谷，在五丈原屯田，与司马懿隔渭水相持一百多天。八月，诸葛亮病逝军中，蜀军撤回。

title: The fall of Luoyang and the flight south
summary: Civil war among the Jin princes opens the north to the steppe peoples; Luoyang and Chang'an fall and the court rebuilds itself at Jiankang.
summary_zh: 八王之乱引发北方大乱，洛阳、长安相继陷落，晋室南迁建康，北方士民大批南渡。

steps.text: 291: Empress Jia Nanfeng has the regent Yang Jun killed. For the next decade and more, princes of the Sima clan fight one another for control of the court: the War of the Eight Princes.
steps.text_zh: 291年，晋惠帝的皇后贾南风发动政变，诛杀辅政的杨骏。此后宗室诸王为争夺朝政相互攻杀十余年，史称八王之乱。

steps.text: 304: the Xiongnu noble Liu Yuan rises at Zuoguocheng and proclaims himself King of Han. Other peoples follow, and the era of the Sixteen Kingdoms begins.
steps.text_zh: 304年，匈奴贵族刘渊趁中原大乱，在左国城起兵，自称汉王。北方各族政权相继建立，十六国时代由此开始。

steps.text: 307: Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, moves to Jianye with his adviser Wang Dao. Courting the great southern families, he builds the base on which the Jin court will later be rebuilt.
steps.text_zh: 307年，琅琊王司马睿在王导辅佐下移镇建邺，拉拢江南士族，在江东站稳脚跟，为日后重建晋室打下基础。

steps.text: 311: Liu Cong's generals Liu Yao and Shi Le storm Luoyang, capture Emperor Huai and kill over thirty thousand officials and residents. This is the Yongjia disaster.
steps.text_zh: 311年，刘聪派刘曜、石勒等攻破洛阳，俘虏晋怀帝，杀死官员百姓三万余人，史称永嘉之乱。

steps.text: 313: Zu Ti crosses the Yangzi from Jingkou with about a hundred families of followers. In midstream he strikes the oar and swears never to recross the river until the north is recovered.
steps.text_zh: 313年，祖逖率部曲百余家从京口北渡长江，船到江心时他击打船桨发誓：不能收复中原，决不再渡江回来。

steps.text: 316: Liu Yao takes Chang'an and Emperor Min surrenders; the Western Jin is finished. Northern gentry and commoners flee south in great numbers, the 'southward crossing of caps and robes'.
steps.text_zh: 316年，刘曜攻陷长安，晋愍帝出城投降，西晋灭亡。中原士族百姓大批南迁，史称“衣冠南渡”。

steps.text: 317: Sima Rui becomes King of Jin at Jiankang and takes the imperial title the next year, founding the Eastern Jin. The Wang family shares power so fully that people say 'Wang and Ma rule the realm together'.
steps.text_zh: 317年，司马睿在建康即晋王位，次年称帝，东晋建立。王氏与司马氏共掌朝政，时称“王与马，共天下”。

steps.text: 321: Zu Ti has won back most of the land south of the Yellow River, but distrusted by the court he falls ill and dies at Yongqiu. His gains are soon lost.
steps.text_zh: 321年，祖逖已收复黄河以南大部分土地，却因朝廷猜忌忧愤成疾，病死在雍丘，北伐成果很快丧失。

title: Wang Xizhi and the Eastern Jin gentlemen
summary: Exiled northern aristocrats make Jiankang and Kuaiji the home of a new elegance in calligraphy, painting, poetry and talk.
summary_zh: 南渡的士族在建康、会稽一带安家，书法、绘画、诗文与清谈都达到了新的高度。

steps.text: Around 318: refugees from the north gather to drink at Xinting outside Jiankang. Zhou Yi sighs that the scenery is the same but the rivers and hills are not; Wang Dao rebukes the weepers and calls for recovering the north.
steps.text_zh: 约318年，南渡士人常在建康城外的新亭聚饮。周顗叹息“风景不殊，正自有山河之异”，众人相对流泪，王导正色说应当合力恢复中原，何至于像囚徒一样相对哭泣。

steps.text: 353: on the third day of the third month Wang Xizhi, governor of Kuaiji, gathers Xie An and some forty friends at the Orchid Pavilion. Cups float down a stream, poems are written, and Wang's preface becomes the most admired work of calligraphy.
steps.text_zh: 353年三月三日，会稽内史王羲之与谢安、孙绰等四十余人在兰亭修禊，曲水流觞，饮酒赋诗。王羲之为诗集所写的《兰亭集序》被誉为“天下第一行书”。

steps.text: 360: Xie An, who has lived in retreat in the Eastern Hills of Kuaiji for years, finally takes office at past forty as an aide to Huan Wen. His return gives Chinese the idiom of a comeback from the Eastern Hills.
steps.text_zh: 360年，长期隐居会稽东山、屡次拒绝征召的谢安，年过四十才出山，做了桓温的司马。“东山再起”这个成语就出自他的这次出仕。

steps.text: About 380: Gu Kaizhi, the leading painter of Jiankang, holds that a portrait must capture the spirit through the form. Copies of his Admonitions scroll and Nymph of the Luo River still survive.
steps.text_zh: 约380年，建康的画家顾恺之主张作画要“以形写神”，画人尤重点睛。他的《女史箴图》《洛神赋图》以摹本流传至今，是中国人物画的奠基之作。

steps.text: 383: as the battle on the Fei River is fought, Xie An sits playing weiqi at home in Jiankang. When the victory letter arrives he reads it and goes on playing, saying only that the youngsters have beaten the enemy.
steps.text_zh: 383年淝水之战时，谢安正在建康家中与客人下棋。捷报送到，他看完随手放下，继续下棋，客人问起，只淡淡说：“小儿辈遂已破贼。”王谢两家宅第都在秦淮河南的乌衣巷。

steps.text: 402: the monk Huiyuan, who has lived on Mount Lu for twenty years, gathers monks and lay scholars at Donglin Temple to vow rebirth in the Pure Land. Mount Lu becomes a centre of southern Buddhism.
steps.text_zh: 402年，在庐山东林寺住了二十年的高僧慧远，与僧俗一百多人在阿弥陀佛像前立誓往生西方净土。庐山由此成为南方佛教与名士交往的中心。

steps.text: 405: Tao Yuanming quits as magistrate of Pengze after some eighty days, unwilling to bow to a visiting inspector. He goes home to Chaisang below Mount Lu, writes Returning Home, and farms for the rest of his life.
steps.text_zh: 405年，陶渊明做了八十多天彭泽县令，不愿为五斗米向督邮折腰，辞官回到庐山脚下的柴桑故里，写下《归去来兮辞》，从此躬耕田园。

title: Eastern Jin campaigns to the north
summary: Huan Wen and Liu Yu march north from the Yangzi and briefly retake Luoyang and Chang'an, but neither can hold the north.
summary_zh: 桓温、刘裕先后从江南北伐，一度收复洛阳、长安，却都没能守住中原。

steps.text: 347: Huan Wen, governor of Jing province, sails up the Yangzi and takes Chengdu, ending the Cheng-Han state. The victory makes him the most powerful man in the Eastern Jin and sets him on the road north.
steps.text_zh: 347年，荆州刺史桓温溯江西上，攻入成都，成汉李势出降。桓温由此威名大振，成为东晋最有实力的权臣，也开始筹划北伐中原。

steps.text: 354: Huan Wen leads 40,000 men from Jiangling through Wu Pass into the Wei valley, beats the Former Qin army at Lantian and pushes on toward Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 354年，桓温率步骑四万从江陵出发，经武关进入关中，在蓝田大败前秦军队，兵锋直逼长安。这是东晋军队第一次打进关中。

steps.text: 354: camped at Bashang, Huan Wen is welcomed by locals with oxen and wine. The scholar Wang Meng visits him, but Huan dares not attack Chang'an, and when Qin cuts the wheat early he retreats for lack of food.
steps.text_zh: 354年，桓温进驻灞上，关中父老牵牛担酒迎接，说想不到今天又见到官军。王猛前来求见，但桓温不敢进攻长安，前秦抢割麦子，晋军缺粮只得撤退。

steps.text: 356: on his second campaign Huan Wen defeats the Qiang leader Yao Xiang on the Yi River and retakes Luoyang, repairing the Western Jin tombs. He urges the court to move back north, but it refuses.
steps.text_zh: 356年，桓温第二次北伐，在伊水大败姚襄，收复洛阳，修复西晋皇陵。他上书请求还都洛阳，朝廷不敢答应。几年后洛阳又被前燕夺去。

steps.text: 369: the third campaign, against Former Yan, reaches Fangtou on the Yellow River. Murong Chui blocks him and his supply lines fail; retreating overland, he is ambushed at Xiangyi and loses some 30,000 men.
steps.text_zh: 369年，桓温第三次北伐前燕，进至黄河边的枋头。慕容垂率军抵抗，晋军粮道断绝，焚船从陆路撤退，在襄邑遭伏击，损失三万多人。

steps.text: 410: Liu Yu, a commander of humble birth who has crushed a rebellion and a usurper, takes Guanggu after a long siege. Southern Yan falls, its ruler Murong Chao is executed in Jiankang, and Shandong returns to Jin.
steps.text_zh: 410年，出身寒微的刘裕北伐南燕，围攻广固大半年后破城，俘获南燕主慕容超，押回建康斩首。青齐一带重归东晋，刘裕声望大增。

steps.text: 416: Liu Yu sends his armies against Later Qin. Vanguards under Wang Zhen'e and Tan Daoji sweep up through the Huai and Henan, and Luoyang surrenders in the tenth month.
steps.text_zh: 416年，刘裕兵分数路讨伐后秦。前锋王镇恶、檀道济一路势如破竹，十月攻克洛阳，这是洛阳六十年来第二次回到晋朝手中。

steps.text: 417: Liu Yu's fleet sails up the Yellow River while Northern Wei horsemen shadow it on the north bank. He lands a crescent of war-carts and crossbowmen there, and the Wei cavalry is cut to pieces.
steps.text_zh: 417年，刘裕率水军溯黄河西上，北魏骑兵沿北岸尾随骚扰。刘裕派兵登上北岸，用一百辆战车布成“却月阵”，配合强弩大破魏军骑兵。

steps.text: 417: Wang Zhen'e sails his boats up the Wei River to the walls of Chang'an and Later Qin surrenders. But Liu Yu hurries home to seize power, and the next year the Xia state takes Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 417年，王镇恶率船队沿渭水直抵长安城下，后秦姚泓出降。但刘裕急于回建康夺权，留下少年儿子镇守，第二年长安就被夏国赫连勃勃夺走。

title: The battle of the Fei River
summary: Former Qin unites the north and marches on the Eastern Jin, only to collapse after one battle on the Fei River.
summary_zh: 前秦统一北方后大举南征，在淝水一战惨败，随即土崩瓦解，南北对峙延续下去。

steps.text: 357: Fu Jian seizes the throne of Former Qin and gives power to the Han Chinese minister Wang Meng, who cleans up government and revives farming. Qin quickly grows strong.
steps.text_zh: 357年，苻坚夺位成为前秦君主，重用汉人王猛整顿吏治、发展农业，前秦迅速强盛起来。

steps.text: 370: Wang Meng takes Ye and destroys the Former Yan; the whole northeast now belongs to Qin. The Yan general Murong Chui had already defected to Fu Jian.
steps.text_zh: 370年，王猛率军攻克邺城，灭掉前燕，关东之地尽归前秦。前燕名将慕容垂此前已投奔苻坚。

steps.text: 376: Qin destroys Former Liang in the Hexi corridor and Dai beyond the Great Wall, and now rules all of northern China. Fu Jian begins to plan the conquest of the Eastern Jin.
steps.text_zh: 376年，前秦又灭掉河西的前凉和塞北的代国，统一了整个北方。苻坚雄心勃勃，开始筹划南下消灭东晋。

steps.text: 377: the Jin chief minister Xie An sends his nephew Xie Xuan to Guangling. Xie Xuan recruits tough refugees from the north into the Beifu army, the best troops the Eastern Jin will have.
steps.text_zh: 377年，东晋宰相谢安举荐侄子谢玄镇守广陵，谢玄招募北方流民中的勇士组建北府兵，这支军队成为东晋最精锐的力量。

steps.text: 383: against the advice of his ministers Fu Jian marches south with a host claimed at a million, strung out over a thousand li. His brother Fu Rong takes Shouyang and Fu Jian rides ahead with light cavalry.
steps.text_zh: 383年，苻坚不顾群臣劝阻发兵南下，号称百万，大军前后千里。苻融率前锋攻下寿阳，苻坚亲率轻骑赶往前线。

steps.text: 383: in the eleventh month Xie Xuan asks the Qin army to pull back so his men can cross the Fei River and fight. The retreat turns to panic, Jin troops charge across, Fu Rong is killed and Qin's army flees.
steps.text_zh: 383年十一月，谢玄要求秦军稍稍后退，让晋军渡河决战。秦军一退便阵脚大乱，晋军乘势渡过淝水猛攻，苻融战死，秦军溃逃。

steps.text: 384: after the defeat Murong Chui rebuilds a Yan state in Hebei, and the Qiang leader Yao Chang sets up for himself in the Wei valley. Former Qin's subject peoples break away one after another.
steps.text_zh: 384年，淝水战败后，慕容垂在河北起兵复建燕国，羌人姚苌也在关中自立，北方各族纷纷脱离前秦。

steps.text: 385: Fu Jian is captured by Yao Chang and strangled in a Buddhist temple at Xinping. Former Qin falls apart, the north splinters again, and the Eastern Jin keeps the south.
steps.text_zh: 385年，苻坚被姚苌俘获，在新平的佛寺中被缢杀。前秦瓦解，北方重新陷入分裂，东晋保住了江南。

title: Faxian's journey to India
summary: A monk in his sixties walks from Chang'an across the deserts and the Pamirs to India and returns by sea after thirteen years.
summary_zh: 六十多岁的僧人法显从长安出发，穿越沙漠和葱岭到达天竺，十三年后经海路回国。

steps.text: 399: Faxian, a monk already in his sixties, sets out from Chang'an with a few companions. Troubled that Chinese Buddhism lacks complete monastic rules, he goes to India to find them.
steps.text_zh: 399年，年过六旬的僧人法显因感慨汉地佛教戒律残缺不全，与几位同伴从长安出发，西行天竺寻求律藏。

steps.text: 400: crossing the Long mountains, the party reaches Zhangye and spends the summer retreat there. They meet Zhiyan, Baoyun and other monks, who join them on the road west.
steps.text_zh: 400年，法显一行越过陇山，到达张掖，在那里度过夏安居，又与智严、宝云等僧人相遇，结伴继续西行。

steps.text: 400: at Dunhuang the governor Li Gao supplies them for the desert crossing. Faxian writes that there are no birds above and no beasts below; the only markers are the bones of the dead.
steps.text_zh: 400年，法显到达敦煌，太守李暠资助他们穿越沙河。沙漠中“上无飞鸟，下无走兽”，只能以死人枯骨作为路标。

steps.text: 401: Faxian reaches Khotan, a great Buddhist kingdom with tens of thousands of monks. He stays several months and watches the procession of images through the city.
steps.text_zh: 401年，法显到达于阗。这里佛教兴盛，僧人数万，他停留了数月，观看了盛大的行像仪式。

steps.text: 402: Faxian crosses the Pamirs, snow-covered all year round, then edges along paths cut into sheer cliffs and over rope bridges to cross the Indus River into northern India.
steps.text_zh: 402年，法显翻越终年积雪的葱岭，沿着悬崖上的栈道和绳桥渡过印度河，进入北天竺。

steps.text: About 405: Faxian reaches Pataliputra in Magadha, where he spends three years learning Sanskrit and copying monastic codes. His companions have died or stayed behind, and he is alone.
steps.text_zh: 约405年，法显到达中天竺摩揭提国的巴连弗邑，在这里学习梵语、抄写戒律经典三年。同伴或死或留，只剩他一人。

steps.text: About 410: Faxian sails to the Lion Kingdom, Sri Lanka, stays two years and finds more texts unknown in China. Seeing a merchant offer a white silk fan from home, he weeps.
steps.text_zh: 约410年，法显乘商船到达狮子国（今斯里兰卡），住了两年，又求得几部汉地没有的经典。见到商人供奉的一把晋地白绢扇，他不禁落泪。

steps.text: 412: sailing home on merchant ships, Faxian is battered by storms. After changing ships in Yavadvipa he heads for Guangzhou, but is blown off course and drifts for over two months.
steps.text_zh: 412年，法显搭乘商船东归，途中屡遇大风，在耶婆提国转船后本应驶往广州，却在海上漂流了两个多月，偏离了航向。

steps.text: 412: the ship lands south of Mount Lao, near today's Qingdao, and Faxian is home. He brings back many scriptures and writes a record of the thirty-odd countries he passed through.
steps.text_zh: 412年，海船漂到青州长广郡牢山（今青岛崂山）南岸，法显终于回国。他带回大批经律，写下《佛国记》，记述沿途三十余国的见闻。

title: The road of cave temples
summary: Buddhist cave temples spread from Dunhuang along the Silk Road to the capitals of the north, changing style as they went.
summary_zh: 佛教石窟从敦煌沿丝绸之路一路东传到北方都城，风格也随之不断变化。

steps.text: 366: according to a Tang inscription, the monk Yuezun sees a golden light like a thousand Buddhas on the cliffs near Dunhuang and cuts the first cave there. Mogao grows over the next thousand years.
steps.text_zh: 366年，据唐代碑文记载，僧人乐僔路过敦煌鸣沙山，看到山崖上金光闪耀，状如千佛，于是开凿了第一个洞窟。此后千年间，莫高窟不断扩展。

steps.text: 420: in cave 169 at Binglingsi on the Yellow River, a painted inscription is dated to the Western Qin kingdom. It is the oldest dated inscription in any Chinese cave temple.
steps.text_zh: 420年，黄河边的炳灵寺第169窟留下一则西秦建弘元年的墨书题记，这是中国石窟中现存最早的纪年题记，见证了佛教艺术沿河西走廊东传。

steps.text: 460: at Yungang near Pingcheng the monk Tanyao directs five huge caves, each with a colossal Buddha said to stand for a Northern Wei emperor. Their broad faces and thin robes still recall Central Asian models.
steps.text_zh: 460年起，昙曜在平城西郊云冈主持开凿五座大窟，史称“昙曜五窟”。大佛高达十余米，据说象征北魏五位皇帝，面相丰满、衣纹贴体，带有西域风格。

steps.text: 500: after the move to Luoyang the court starts the Binyang caves at Longmen in memory of Emperor Xiaowen and his empress. The figures are now slender and wrapped in Chinese-style robes.
steps.text_zh: 500年，迁都洛阳后，北魏宣武帝下令在龙门为孝文帝和文昭皇太后开凿宾阳洞，前后用工八十多万。佛像变得清瘦修长、宽袍大袖，风格已明显汉化。

steps.text: 538: back at Dunhuang, cave 285 carries inscriptions from 538 and 539, the earliest dated cave at Mogao. Its paintings mix Indian gods with the slender Chinese style that had spread from Luoyang.
steps.text_zh: 538年，莫高窟第285窟留下西魏大统四年、五年的题记，是莫高窟现存最早的纪年洞窟。窟中壁画把印度诸神和中原流行的清瘦风格融为一体。

steps.text: 540: the deposed Western Wei empress Yifu, forced to kill herself at Qinzhou, is buried in a niche cut into the cliff of Maijishan. The site near Tianshui flourished under Northern Wei and Western Wei patrons.
steps.text_zh: 540年，被废的西魏文帝皇后乙弗氏在秦州被逼自尽，人们在麦积山崖壁上凿龛安葬。天水麦积山石窟在北魏、西魏时期兴盛，以泥塑佛像著称。

steps.text: About 555: Northern Qi rulers cut the Xiangtang caves into Mount Gu, on the road between Ye and Jinyang. The figures grow fuller and rounder again, and whole sutras are carved into the rock.
steps.text_zh: 约555年，北齐皇室在邺城通往晋阳的大道旁的鼓山开凿响堂山石窟。佛像又转向丰满圆润，并在石壁上大面积刻写佛经，下启隋唐风格。

title: Northern Wei unites the north
summary: From a revived chieftaincy on the steppe edge, the Tuoba Xianbei build Northern Wei and in fifty years end the Sixteen Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 鲜卑拓跋部从塞外小国起家，建立北魏，五十多年间扫平群雄，结束十六国的混战。

steps.text: 386: with Former Qin falling apart after the Fei River, the sixteen-year-old Tuoba Gui revives his family's Dai state near Shengle and soon renames it Wei.
steps.text_zh: 386年，淝水之战后前秦瓦解，十六岁的拓跋珪召集旧部复建代国，以盛乐为中心，同年改称魏王，北魏由此建立。

steps.text: 395: Later Yan sends its crown prince Murong Bao against Wei. Tuoba Gui falls back, then catches the retreating Yan army at Canhe Slope by surprise and destroys it, killing tens of thousands of prisoners.
steps.text_zh: 395年，后燕太子慕容宝率大军攻魏。拓跋珪先避其锋，待燕军撤退时在参合陂突然袭击，大破燕军，坑杀降卒数万。后燕从此由盛转衰。

steps.text: 397: after Murong Chui's death Tuoba Gui pours through the Taihang passes into the plain and takes Zhongshan, the Later Yan capital. Most of Hebei now belongs to Wei.
steps.text_zh: 397年，后燕慕容垂死后，拓跋珪大举南下，出井陉进入河北平原，攻克后燕都城中山。河北大部归入北魏版图。

steps.text: 398: Tuoba Gui makes Pingcheng (Datong) his capital and takes the title of emperor. Over 100,000 people from the conquered east are moved in to farm and build the new city.
steps.text_zh: 398年，拓跋珪定都平城（今山西大同），即皇帝位，营建宫室。他把新征服的东方各州吏民和工匠十余万口迁到京畿，开荒种地。

steps.text: 427: Emperor Taiwu attacks Tongwan, the white-walled capital of Xia. Feigning retreat, he draws the Xia army out of its fortress, crushes it in the field and takes the city.
steps.text_zh: 427年，北魏太武帝亲征夏国都城统万城。这座城以蒸土夯筑，十分坚固。太武帝佯装撤退，诱夏军出城决战后大败之，攻克统万。

steps.text: 436: Wei armies close on Longcheng, capital of Northern Yan. Its ruler Feng Hong burns his palace and flees to Goguryeo, where he is later killed.
steps.text_zh: 436年，魏军进逼北燕都城龙城（今辽宁朝阳），燕主冯弘焚烧宫殿，带领部众东逃高句丽，后被杀，北燕灭亡。

steps.text: 439: Emperor Taiwu crosses the desert to Guzang, capital of Northern Liang, and Juqu Mujian surrenders. The Sixteen Kingdoms are over; tens of thousands of Liangzhou families, monks and craftsmen are moved to Pingcheng.
steps.text_zh: 439年，太武帝西征北凉，围攻都城姑臧，沮渠牧犍出降。十六国时代结束，北方归于一统。凉州的三万多户百姓及大批僧人、工匠被迁往平城。

steps.text: 460: after a persecution of Buddhism under Taiwu and its restoration in 452, the monk Tanyao, himself from Liangzhou, begins the giant Buddhas of Yungang outside Pingcheng. The unified north now builds on an imperial scale.
steps.text_zh: 460年，太武帝灭佛之后，文成帝重兴佛法，来自凉州的僧人昙曜主持在平城西郊开凿云冈石窟。统一后的北魏开始以帝国规模营造。

title: Rise and fall of the Southern Dynasties
summary: From Liu Yu's northern victories to the sack of Jiankang by Hou Jing, four southern dynasties rule from Jiankang until Sui conquers Chen.
summary_zh: 从刘裕北伐建宋，到侯景之乱、陈朝灭亡，宋齐梁陈四朝在建康兴衰更替。

steps.text: 410: the Jin general Liu Yu marches north, takes Guanggu and destroys the Southern Yan, winning back Qing province. A man of humble birth, he is now the most powerful figure in the Eastern Jin.
steps.text_zh: 410年，东晋大将刘裕北伐，攻破广固，灭掉南燕，收复青州。出身寒微的刘裕凭战功成为东晋最有权势的人物。

steps.text: 417: advancing by land and river, Liu Yu takes Chang'an and destroys the Later Qin, recovering Luoyang and the Wei valley. He hurries back to Jiankang to seize power, and Chang'an falls to Xia the next year.
steps.text_zh: 417年，刘裕水陆并进攻入长安，灭掉后秦，收复洛阳和关中。不久他急于回建康夺权，长安第二年就被夏国夺走。

steps.text: 420: Liu Yu makes the last Jin emperor abdicate and founds the Song dynasty. Song, Qi, Liang and Chen will rule in turn from Jiankang: the Southern Dynasties.
steps.text_zh: 420年，刘裕迫使晋恭帝禅位，建立宋朝。此后宋、齐、梁、陈四朝相继定都建康，史称南朝。

steps.text: 450: Emperor Wen of Song launches a northern campaign that fails. Emperor Taiwu of Wei counterattacks all the way to Guabu on the north bank of the Yangzi, and the land between the Huai and the Yangzi is laid waste.
steps.text_zh: 450年，宋文帝发动元嘉北伐失利，北魏太武帝乘势南下反攻，一直打到长江北岸的瓜步，江淮一带惨遭破坏。

steps.text: 507: the Liang generals Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong break the Wei siege of Zhongli, one of the south's rare great victories. Afterwards the two sides face each other roughly along the Huai.
steps.text_zh: 507年，梁将韦睿、曹景宗在钟离大破围城的北魏军，这是南朝少有的大胜，此后南北双方大体在淮河一线对峙。

steps.text: 527: Emperor Wu of Liang gives himself to the Tongtai temple as a monk, the first of several times his ministers pay huge sums to buy him back. In his forty-odd years Buddhism and southern culture reach their height.
steps.text_zh: 527年，梁武帝萧衍在建康同泰寺舍身出家，此后又多次舍身，由群臣出巨资赎回。他在位四十多年，佛教盛极一时，南朝文化也达到高峰。

steps.text: 548: Hou Jing, a general who had defected from Eastern Wei, rebels and the next year storms the palace city of Jiankang. The aged Emperor Wu dies a prisoner, and the rich south is devastated.
steps.text_zh: 548年，从东魏投降梁朝的侯景起兵叛乱，次年攻破建康台城，八十六岁的梁武帝被困饿死。江南繁华之地遭到空前破坏。

steps.text: 554: Western Wei takes Jiangling, where Emperor Yuan of Liang had ruled since crushing Hou Jing, and kills him. Tens of thousands of residents are marched north as slaves, and Liang survives only in name.
steps.text_zh: 554年，平定侯景之乱后定都江陵的梁元帝被西魏攻杀，江陵城中数万百姓被掳往关中为奴，梁朝至此名存实亡。

steps.text: 589: Sui armies cross the Yangzi and take Jiankang, capturing the last Chen ruler. The Chen dynasty, founded by Chen Baxian in 557, falls, and nearly three centuries of division end.
steps.text_zh: 589年，隋军渡江攻入建康，陈后主被俘。陈霸先557年建立的陈朝灭亡，近三百年的南北分裂至此结束。

title: Emperor Xiaowen moves to Luoyang
summary: Northern Wei moves its capital from the frontier to Luoyang and adopts Chinese ways, but the neglected frontier garrisons revolt and the dynasty splits.
summary_zh: 北魏孝文帝从平城迁都洛阳，推行汉化，然而边镇不满引发六镇之乱，北魏最终分裂为东西两魏。

steps.text: About 460: work begins on the Yungang caves west of Pingcheng, the Northern Wei capital since 398. Wei now rules all of north China, but its court still keeps many Xianbei customs.
steps.text_zh: 460年前后，北魏开始在都城平城西郊开凿云冈石窟。北魏自398年定都平城，此时已统一北方，统治者仍保留着许多鲜卑旧俗。

steps.text: 485: under the Empress Dowager Feng, Wei issues the equal-field law, allotting land by household size, and the next year sets up the three-elders system to register people. These reforms prepare the way for Xiaowen.
steps.text_zh: 485年，在冯太后主持下，北魏颁布均田令，按人口分配土地，次年又立三长制清查户口。这些改革为孝文帝后来的汉化打下基础。

steps.text: 494: Emperor Xiaowen formally moves the capital to Luoyang. The year before he had marched south as if to attack the Southern Qi, then used his nobles' reluctance to go further to win agreement to stay.
steps.text_zh: 494年，孝文帝正式迁都洛阳。前一年他以南征为名，率大军和群臣南下，到洛阳后趁众人不愿继续进军，定下迁都之议。

steps.text: About 494: with the move, the Wei court and nobility begin carving the Longmen caves on both banks of the Yi River south of Luoyang, starting with the Guyang cave.
steps.text_zh: 494年前后，随着迁都，北魏皇室和贵族在洛阳南郊伊水两岸开凿龙门石窟，古阳洞等早期洞窟由此开始营造。

steps.text: 495: Xiaowen bans Xianbei dress and the Xianbei language at court. The next year the imperial Tuoba clan takes the Chinese surname Yuan, and Xianbei nobles are urged to marry into Han Chinese families.
steps.text_zh: 495年起，孝文帝下令禁穿胡服，朝廷上禁说鲜卑语，次年把皇族拓跋氏改为元氏，并鼓励鲜卑贵族与汉族士族通婚。

steps.text: 524: soldiers and settlers of the six northern garrisons rise in revolt. Since the move south their status and pay had fallen far behind Luoyang's, and the anger plunges Wei into chaos.
steps.text_zh: 524年，北方边境的六镇军民起兵反抗。迁都之后，镇守北边的鲜卑军人地位下降、待遇恶化，积怨终于爆发，北魏陷入大乱。

steps.text: 528: the Qihu chief Erzhu Rong marches on Luoyang, saying the Empress Dowager Hu poisoned the emperor. At Heyin he drowns her and kills over two thousand officials, gutting the Wei court.
steps.text_zh: 528年，契胡首领尔朱荣以胡太后毒杀孝明帝为借口，率军入洛阳，在河阴杀死胡太后和朝臣两千余人，北魏朝廷元气大伤。

steps.text: 534: Emperor Xiaowu flees west to Yuwen Tai in the Wei valley, and Gao Huan sets up another emperor at Ye. Northern Wei splits into Eastern and Western Wei, later replaced by Northern Qi and Northern Zhou.
steps.text_zh: 534年，孝武帝西奔关中投靠宇文泰，高欢另立孝静帝并迁都邺城。北魏分裂为东魏和西魏，后来分别被北齐、北周取代。

title: Eastern and Western Wei
summary: For forty years the heirs of Gao Huan in Ye and of Yuwen Tai in Chang'an fight for the north, and the weaker west wins.
summary_zh: 邺城的高氏与长安的宇文氏争夺北方四十余年，起初较弱的西方最终胜出。

steps.text: 534: the Northern Wei emperor flees west to Yuwen Tai, and Gao Huan sets up another emperor and moves the court to Ye. Some 400,000 households are marched off from Luoyang within days.
steps.text_zh: 534年，北魏孝武帝西奔关中投靠宇文泰，高欢另立孝静帝，迁都邺城。诏书下达三天就动身，洛阳四十万户百姓狼狈上路。东魏由此建立。

steps.text: 535: in Chang'an Yuwen Tai poisons the emperor who fled to him and puts up a new one: Western Wei. It holds only the poorer Wei valley and has far fewer troops than the east.
steps.text_zh: 535年，宇文泰毒杀投奔而来的孝武帝，在长安另立文帝，西魏建立。西魏只有关中、陇右，地瘠民贫，兵力远逊于东魏。

steps.text: Early 537: Gao Huan attacks on three fronts and builds bridges over the Yellow River as a feint. Yuwen Tai slips out through Xiaoguan, falls on Dou Tai's column near Tong Pass, and Dou kills himself.
steps.text_zh: 537年初，高欢三路进攻，在蒲坂架浮桥虚张声势。宇文泰识破其意，秘密出兵小关，突袭潼关一带的窦泰，窦泰兵败自杀，高欢只得撤桥退兵。

steps.text: Winter 537: Gao Huan returns with a huge army. Yuwen Tai, with fewer than 10,000 men, hides troops in the reeds of the Shayuan sand flats by the Wei River. The ambush routs the east and takes some 70,000 prisoners.
steps.text_zh: 537年冬，高欢率二十万大军再攻关中。宇文泰兵不满万，在渭河边沙苑的芦苇中设下伏兵，拦腰截击，东魏大败，被俘七万人。

steps.text: 538: the two sides clash at the Yellow River bridge north of Luoyang. The east's great general Gao Aocao is killed, but the west is beaten in the end; Yuwen Tai falls from his horse and barely escapes.
steps.text_zh: 538年，东西魏在洛阳河桥、邙山一带激战。东魏名将高敖曹战死，但西魏最终失利，宇文泰坠马几乎被擒。洛阳在战火中残破不堪。

steps.text: 543: when an eastern governor defects with Hulao, Yuwen Tai marches to receive him and is badly beaten at Mount Mang. To rebuild, he recruits local strongmen and their militias, the seed of the Fubing army.
steps.text_zh: 543年，东魏将领高仲密以虎牢降西魏，宇文泰东进接应，在邙山大败。此后他广招关陇豪强的乡兵，这成为日后府兵制的来源。

steps.text: 546: Gao Huan throws his full strength at Yubi. For fifty days Wei Xiaokuan answers every earth mound and tunnel; about 70,000 eastern soldiers die. Gao Huan withdraws to Jinyang and dies within weeks.
steps.text_zh: 546年，高欢倾全力围攻玉璧。韦孝宽坚守五十天，对筑土山、挖地道、断水源一一化解，东魏战死病死七万人。高欢令斛律金唱《敕勒歌》稳定军心，退兵后不久病逝。

steps.text: 550: Gao Huan's son Gao Yang deposes the eastern emperor and founds Northern Qi. In 557 Yuwen Tai's son does the same in the west and founds Northern Zhou. The rivalry goes on under new names.
steps.text_zh: 550年，高欢之子高洋废东魏皇帝，建立北齐；557年，宇文泰之子宇文觉也代西魏建立北周。东西对峙换了国号，仍在继续。

steps.text: 577: Emperor Wu of Zhou, after taking Jinyang, storms Ye and captures the Qi rulers. The north is one state again for the first time since 534, and four years later his minister Yang Jian founds the Sui.
steps.text_zh: 577年，北周武帝攻克晋阳后进兵邺城，俘获北齐后主，北齐灭亡。北方自534年分裂以来重归统一，四年后杨坚代周建隋。

title: Sui reunites China
summary: In eight years Yang Jian founds the Sui, secures the north and crosses the Yangtze to end nearly three centuries of division.
summary_zh: 杨坚代周建隋，稳定北方后挥师渡江灭陈，结束了近三百年的南北分裂。

steps.text: 581: Yang Jian, regent and in-law of the Northern Zhou emperors, takes the throne as Emperor Wen of Sui. The north now has a strong new dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 581年，北周外戚、辅政大臣杨坚接受禅让称帝，国号隋，是为隋文帝。北方从此由一个强有力的新王朝统治。

steps.text: 582: Emperor Wen has Yuwen Kai lay out a vast new capital, Daxing, southeast of old Chang'an, with streets in a chessboard grid. It later becomes Tang Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 582年，隋文帝命宇文恺在汉长安城东南营建新都大兴城，街坊整齐如棋盘。这座城后来就是唐朝的长安城。

steps.text: 583: Sui troops beat the Turkic khagan at Baidao while the envoy Zhangsun Sheng plays rival khans against each other. The khaganate splits in two, freeing Sui to turn south.
steps.text_zh: 583年，隋军在白道大败突厥沙钵略可汗，长孙晟又从中离间，突厥分裂为东西两部。北方边患缓解，隋朝可以专心南图。

steps.text: 587: Sui abolishes its client state of Western Liang and takes Jiangling. Sui now holds the middle Yangtze and can threaten Chen from upstream.
steps.text_zh: 587年，隋废除附庸小国西梁，收取江陵。隋军由此控制长江中游，可以顺流而下威胁陈朝。

steps.text: Winter 588: with Prince Yang Guang in overall command, Yang Su, Heruo Bi and Han Qinhu lead over half a million men against Chen along the whole length of the Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 588年冬，隋以晋王杨广为元帅，杨素、贺若弼、韩擒虎等分路出兵，五十余万大军从长江上游到下游同时进逼陈朝。

steps.text: Early 589: Heruo Bi crosses the Yangtze from Guangling to take Jingkou, while Han Qinhu crosses by night to Caishi. The two columns close on Jiankang.
steps.text_zh: 589年正月，贺若弼从广陵渡江攻取京口，韩擒虎从横江夜渡采石，两路夹击陈朝都城建康。

steps.text: 589: Han Qinhu is first into Jiankang. The last Chen ruler, Chen Shubao, hides in a palace well and is pulled out a prisoner. Chen is gone.
steps.text_zh: 589年，韩擒虎率先攻入建康，陈后主陈叔宝躲进景阳宫的井中，被隋军搜出俘获，陈朝灭亡。

steps.text: 589: nearly three centuries of division since the fall of the Western Jin are over. Emperor Wen has Jiankang razed, and power is centred again on the north.
steps.text_zh: 589年，自西晋末年以来近三百年的南北分裂结束。隋文帝下令平毁建康城，政治中心重新回到关中和中原。

title: The Sui Grand Canal
summary: Emperor Yang links the Yellow River, the Huai and the Yangtze into one waterway centred on Luoyang, then sails it south for the last time.
summary_zh: 隋炀帝以洛阳为中心开凿运河，连通黄河、淮河与长江，最后乘龙舟南下，一去不返。

steps.text: 605: newly enthroned, Emperor Yang builds an Eastern Capital at Luoyang. Sitting at the centre of the realm, it becomes the hub of the canals he is about to dig.
steps.text_zh: 605年，隋炀帝即位后营建东都洛阳。洛阳居天下之中，成为随后开凿的大运河的枢纽。

steps.text: 605: over a million people from Henan and Huaibei dig the Tongji Canal, carrying Yellow River water along the Bian to the Huai. Southern grain can now reach the north by boat.
steps.text_zh: 605年，炀帝征发河南、淮北民众百余万开通济渠，从板渚引黄河水，经汴水入淮河。南方的粮食从此可以直达中原。

steps.text: 605: more than 100,000 workers deepen the old Han Channel from Shanyang (Huai'an) to Jiangdu (Yangzhou), linking the Huai with the Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 605年，又征发淮南民众十余万疏浚邗沟，从山阳（今淮安）直到江都（今扬州）入长江，把淮河与长江连在一起。

steps.text: Autumn 605: the canal barely finished, Emperor Yang sails from Luoyang to Jiangdu in a dragon boat. His flotilla stretches for over two hundred li.
steps.text_zh: 605年秋，运河刚刚开通，炀帝便乘龙舟从洛阳南巡江都，随行船队首尾相接二百余里。

steps.text: 608: over a million people from Hebei dig the Yongji Canal, running from the Yellow River north to Zhuojun (Beijing) to move troops and grain for war with Goguryeo.
steps.text_zh: 608年，征发河北民众百余万开永济渠，引沁水南达黄河，北通涿郡（今北京）。这条运河是为东征高句丽运兵运粮而修的。

steps.text: 610: the Jiangnan Canal runs over eight hundred li from Jingkou to Yuhang (Hangzhou). The system now reaches from Zhuojun to Yuhang, joining five river basins.
steps.text_zh: 610年，开江南河，从京口（今镇江）到余杭（今杭州），长八百余里。至此运河北起涿郡、南到余杭，连通五大水系。

steps.text: 616: with the north in uproar, Emperor Yang ignores his ministers and sails south to Jiangdu for the third time. He never returns north.
steps.text_zh: 616年，北方已陷入大乱，炀帝不顾劝阻，第三次乘龙舟南下江都，从此再也没有回到北方。

title: The fall of the Sui
summary: Three failed wars in Korea turn a rich empire into a land of rebels, and the Li family of Taiyuan takes the prize.
summary_zh: 三征高句丽耗尽民力，群雄并起，隋朝在短短几年内崩溃，太原李氏最终夺得天下。

steps.text: 611: as Emperor Yang masses troops at Zhuojun for Korea, Wang Bo raises a revolt at Changbaishan in Shandong, singing that no one should go to die in Liaodong.
steps.text_zh: 611年，炀帝在涿郡集结大军准备征高句丽。王薄在长白山聚众起事，作《无向辽东浪死歌》，号召百姓不去辽东送死。

steps.text: 612: Emperor Yang invades Goguryeo in person. The 305,000 men sent across the Liao are routed by Eulji Mundeok at the Salsu River; only 2,700 make it back.
steps.text_zh: 612年，炀帝亲征高句丽。渡过辽河的三十万五千人在萨水被乙支文德击溃，退回辽东的只有两千七百人。

steps.text: 613: during the second Korean war, Yang Xuangan, in charge of supplies at Liyang, rebels and attacks Luoyang. He is crushed within two months, but the aristocracy is turning away.
steps.text_zh: 613年炀帝二征高句丽时，督运粮草的礼部尚书杨玄感在黎阳起兵，进攻洛阳。叛乱两个月被平定，但贵族已开始背弃隋朝。

steps.text: 614: a third Korean campaign; many levies never arrive. Goguryeo offers a token submission and the army withdraws. Three wars have drained the empire.
steps.text_zh: 614年，炀帝第三次征高句丽，各地征兵多不能按期到达。高句丽遣使请降，隋军撤回，三次东征耗尽了国力。

steps.text: 617: Li Mi and the Wagang rebels seize the Luokou granary, open it to the hungry, swell to hundreds of thousands and besiege Luoyang.
steps.text_zh: 617年，李密率瓦岗军攻占洛口仓，开仓放粮，部众增至数十万，发布檄文历数炀帝罪状，围困东都洛阳。

steps.text: Summer 617: Li Yuan, the governor at Taiyuan, raises his own army and marches south with his son Li Shimin, crossing the Yellow River into the Wei valley.
steps.text_zh: 617年夏，太原留守李渊在晋阳起兵，与儿子李世民等率军南下，渡过黄河直取关中。

steps.text: Winter 617: Li Yuan takes Chang'an, puts Emperor Yang's grandson Yang You on the throne, names the absent emperor retired, and rules as chancellor.
steps.text_zh: 617年冬，李渊攻克长安，立炀帝之孙杨侑为帝，遥尊炀帝为太上皇，自己以大丞相身份掌握实权。

steps.text: Spring 618: homesick palace troops, led by Yuwen Huaji, mutiny at Jiangdu and strangle Emperor Yang. The emperor who built the canal dies at its southern end.
steps.text_zh: 618年春，思归心切的禁军在宇文化及率领下发动兵变，隋炀帝在江都被缢杀，死在了他亲手开通的运河南端。

steps.text: 618: Li Yuan accepts Yang You's abdication and founds the Tang. Rival warlords still hold much of the country, and it will take years of fighting to reunite it.
steps.text_zh: 618年五月，李渊接受杨侑禅让称帝，国号唐。但各地群雄割据，还要再打几年仗才能重新统一。

title: The Zhenguan reign
summary: Taizong seizes the throne in a palace ambush, then governs so well that later ages hold his reign up as the model.
summary_zh: 唐太宗在玄武门之变中夺位，此后励精图治，北破突厥、西定高昌，成为后世称颂的盛世。

steps.text: 626: Prince Li Shimin ambushes his brothers, the crown prince and Prince of Qi, at the Xuanwu Gate of the palace. Two months later his father abdicates and he becomes Emperor Taizong.
steps.text_zh: 626年，秦王李世民在长安宫城北门玄武门设伏，杀死太子李建成和齐王李元吉。两个月后李渊让位，李世民即位，是为唐太宗。

steps.text: 627: the Zhenguan era begins. Taizong relies on Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui, listens to Wei Zheng's blunt criticism and lightens taxes, and the country recovers from the wars.
steps.text_zh: 627年改元贞观。太宗任用房玄龄、杜如晦，听取魏征直言进谏，轻徭薄赋，社会很快从隋末战乱中恢复。

steps.text: 630: Li Jing's cavalry surprise the Eastern Turks below the Yin Mountains and capture Illig Khagan. Steppe chiefs hail Taizong as Heavenly Khagan.
steps.text_zh: 630年，李靖率骑兵突袭阴山，大破东突厥，颉利可汗被俘。草原各部君长尊太宗为“天可汗”。

steps.text: 634: after Tuyuhun raids on the Hexi corridor, Li Jing leads an army west and breaks Tuyuhun power the next year, securing the Qinghai road to the west.
steps.text_zh: 634年，吐谷浑侵扰河西，李靖率军西征，次年击破吐谷浑，打通了经青海通往西域的道路。

steps.text: 640: Hou Junji conquers the oasis kingdom of Gaochang (Turpan). Tang makes it Xizhou and sets up the Anxi Protectorate, its first foothold in the Western Regions.
steps.text_zh: 640年，侯君集率军灭高昌，在其地设西州，并设安西都护府，唐朝势力进入西域。

steps.text: 641: Taizong sends Princess Wencheng, a girl of the imperial clan, to marry the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo, binding the two courts by marriage.
steps.text_zh: 641年，太宗把宗室女文成公主嫁给吐蕃赞普松赞干布，唐与吐蕃结为甥舅之好。

steps.text: 643: Wei Zheng dies. Taizong says that a man can be a mirror showing one's mistakes, and he has lost his mirror. Accepting criticism is what later ages most admired in his reign.
steps.text_zh: 643年魏征去世。太宗说以人为镜可以明得失，如今失去了一面镜子。君臣纳谏成为贞观之治最为后世称道之处。

title: Xuanzang's journey to India
summary: A monk leaves Chang'an without permission, studies in India and returns sixteen years later with 657 texts.
summary_zh: 玄奘私自出关西行求法，在印度游学十多年，带回佛经六百五十七部。

steps.text: 629 (some say 627): Xuanzang, troubled by contradictions between Buddhist texts, sets out for India. The border is closed, so he leaves without permission.
steps.text_zh: 629年（一说627年），玄奘因佛经译本互相矛盾，决心西行求取原典。当时边关禁止出境，他只能私自出发。

steps.text: He slips past the Yumen beacon towers at night and crosses the Mokhayan desert alone, nearly dying of thirst.
steps.text_zh: 他夜过玉门关外的烽燧，独自穿越八百里莫贺延碛，几乎渴死在沙漠中。

steps.text: At Gaochang (Turfan) King Qu Wentai welcomes him and tries to keep him. Xuanzang goes on hunger strike until the king lets him go, with letters and supplies.
steps.text_zh: 到达高昌，国王麴文泰盛情挽留，玄奘绝食明志。国王终于放行，并赠送路费、人马和给沿途各国的书信。

steps.text: Over the Tian Shan he meets the Khagan of the Western Turks near Suyab, whose protection opens the road through Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 翻越天山，在素叶城一带见到西突厥可汗，得到可汗的保护和文书，得以穿越中亚诸国。

steps.text: Via Samarkand and the Hindu Kush he reaches India and studies for about five years at Nalanda under the abbot Silabhadra.
steps.text_zh: 经撒马尔罕，越兴都库什山进入印度，在那烂陀寺师从戒贤法师学习约五年。

steps.text: 642: King Harsha holds a great assembly at Kanyakubja; Xuanzang defends his teaching for eighteen days and no one refutes him.
steps.text_zh: 642年，戒日王在曲女城召开大会，玄奘为论主，十八天无人能驳倒他，声名远播。

steps.text: Turning down offers to stay, he crosses the Pamirs and waits at Khotan for the emperor's pardon for leaving illegally.
steps.text_zh: 他谢绝挽留，翻越葱岭东归，在于阗上表请罪，等待唐太宗的回复。

steps.text: 645: Chang'an turns out to greet him. He spends the rest of his life translating, and dictates the Record of the Western Regions.
steps.text_zh: 645年回到长安，万人空巷。此后他专心译经，并口述《大唐西域记》。

title: Princess Wencheng goes to Tibet
summary: A Tang princess travels from Chang'an across the Qinghai plateau to Lhasa to marry the Tibetan king.
summary_zh: 文成公主从长安出发，翻越青藏高原，远嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布。

steps.text: 640: the Tibetan minister Gar Tongtsen arrives in Chang'an with gold and treasures to ask for a bride. Taizong agrees to send Princess Wencheng to King Songtsen Gampo.
steps.text_zh: 640年，吐蕃大相禄东赞带着黄金珍宝来到长安求婚，唐太宗答应把宗室女文成公主嫁给赞普松赞干布。

steps.text: Early 641: escorted by Li Daozong, Prince of Jiangxia, the princess leaves Chang'an and travels west through Longyou to Shanzhou (Ledu, Qinghai), the Tang frontier town.
steps.text_zh: 641年正月，公主由江夏王李道宗护送离开长安，经陇右西行，来到唐朝西部边城鄯州（今青海乐都）。

steps.text: 641: the party crosses the Red Ridge, today's Riyue Shan, the line between farmland and pasture. According to legend, the princess broke her sun-and-moon mirror here.
steps.text_zh: 641年，公主一行翻过赤岭（今青海日月山），这里是农区和牧区的分界。据传说，公主在山上摔碎了日月宝镜。

steps.text: 641: Songtsen Gampo comes with troops to Lake Bohai near the source of the Yellow River (around Madoi) to meet her, greeting Li Daozong with the courtesy of a son-in-law.
steps.text_zh: 641年，松赞干布亲自率兵到河源附近的柏海（今青海玛多一带的湖泊）迎接，以女婿之礼拜见李道宗。

steps.text: 641: she reaches Rasa (Lhasa). Songtsen Gampo builds her a residence; according to tradition, the Buddha statue she brought is the one later enshrined in the Jokhang.
steps.text_zh: 641年，公主到达逻些（今拉萨）。松赞干布为她修建宫室；据传她带去的释迦牟尼像后来供奉在大昭寺。

steps.text: 680: Princess Wencheng dies in Tibet after nearly forty years there. Envoys, goods and Buddhism moving between Tang and Tibet are long remembered in connection with her name.
steps.text_zh: 680年，文成公主在吐蕃去世。她在那里生活了近四十年，唐蕃之间的使节、物产和佛教往来常与她的名字联系在一起。

title: Tang in Central Asia and Talas
summary: For a century Tang armies hold the Tarim oases and push past the Pamirs, until defeat at Talas marks the limit.
summary_zh: 唐朝经营西域一百余年，设安西四镇、远征葱岭以西，直到怛罗斯之战止步。

steps.text: 648: Tang troops take Kucha. In 658 the Anxi Protectorate moves there, governing the Four Garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar and Karashahr.
steps.text_zh: 648年，唐军击破龟兹。658年安西都护府移驻龟兹，统辖龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆等安西四镇。

steps.text: 657: Su Dingfang crushes the Western Turkic khagan Ashina Helu near the Irtysh. The Western Turkic khaganate falls and Tang influence reaches into Central Asia.
steps.text_zh: 657年，苏定方在额尔齐斯河一带大破西突厥阿史那贺鲁，西突厥汗国灭亡，唐朝的势力扩展到中亚。

steps.text: 679: under cover of escorting a Persian prince home, Pei Xingjian seizes the Turkic chief Ashina Duzhi, an ally of Tibet. Tang fortifies Suyab, for a time one of the Four Garrisons.
steps.text_zh: 679年，裴行俭以护送波斯王子为名，擒获勾结吐蕃的西突厥首领阿史那都支。唐在碎叶筑城，碎叶一度成为安西四镇之一。

steps.text: 692: Wang Xiaojie defeats Tibet and recovers the Four Garrisons, lost for some years. Tang now keeps 30,000 troops at Kucha and holds the Tarim Basin firmly.
steps.text_zh: 692年，王孝杰大破吐蕃，收复一度失陷的安西四镇。此后唐朝在龟兹常驻汉兵三万，长期控制塔里木盆地。

steps.text: 747: Gao Xianzhi leads 10,000 men over the Pamirs and the Darkot Pass to take Little Balur (Gilgit) from Tibet, cutting Tibet's road to the west.
steps.text_zh: 747年，高仙芝率一万步骑翻越葱岭和坦驹岭，攻下吐蕃控制的小勃律（今吉尔吉特），切断吐蕃通往西方的道路。

steps.text: 750: Gao Xianzhi attacks Chach (Tashkent), captures its king and plunders the city. The king's son flees to the Arabs for help.
steps.text_zh: 750年，高仙芝以石国（今塔什干）无礼为名出兵，俘虏国王并大肆掳掠。石国王子逃往大食求援。

steps.text: 751: Gao Xianzhi marches deep into the west and meets the Abbasid army at Talas. After five days of fighting the Karluk troops in his army change sides and the Tang army is routed.
steps.text_zh: 751年，高仙芝率军深入，在怛罗斯与大食（阿拔斯王朝）军队交战。相持五天后，军中的葛逻禄部倒戈，唐军大败。

steps.text: 751: after Talas, Tang expansion in Central Asia stops. Captured Tang craftsmen are said to have brought papermaking to Samarkand. Within years the An Lushan rebellion pulls the western armies east.
steps.text_zh: 751年以后，唐朝在中亚的扩张停止。据传被俘的唐朝工匠把造纸术带到了撒马尔罕。几年后安史之乱爆发，西域守军东调。

title: Wu Zetian
summary: From a palace concubine in a nunnery to the only woman in Chinese history to reign as emperor in her own name.
summary_zh: 从感业寺的尼姑到皇后、天后，再到中国历史上唯一的正统女皇帝。

steps.text: 649: when Emperor Taizong dies, his young concubine Wu is sent with the others to Ganye convent in Chang'an. His son Gaozong, who had noticed her, visits and later brings her back to the palace.
steps.text_zh: 649年，唐太宗去世，才人武氏按例出宫，到长安感业寺为尼。早已对她倾心的唐高宗到寺中进香时与她相见，不久将她接回宫中。

steps.text: 655: Gaozong deposes Empress Wang and makes Wu empress. The senior ministers Zhangsun Wuji and Chu Suiliang, who opposed it, are exiled and later hounded to death.
steps.text_zh: 655年，高宗废王皇后，立武昭仪为皇后。坚决反对的元老长孙无忌、褚遂良先后被贬，开国功臣集团从此失势。

steps.text: 664: the ailing Gaozong lets the empress handle state papers. When the minister Shangguan Yi drafts an edict to depose her, she finds out and he is executed. Court calls the couple the Two Sages.
steps.text_zh: 664年，高宗多病，政事多由武后裁决。宰相上官仪替高宗起草废后诏书，被武后察觉后处死。此后帝后共同临朝，时称“二圣”。

steps.text: 675: the giant Vairocana Buddha at Fengxian Temple in the Longmen caves near Luoyang is finished. The empress had given twenty thousand strings of cash from her cosmetics money.
steps.text_zh: 675年，洛阳龙门石窟奉先寺卢舍那大佛完工。据题记，皇后武氏曾捐助脂粉钱两万贯。洛阳此后成为她经营的政治中心。

steps.text: 684: after Gaozong's death, Wu deposes one son and makes another a figurehead. Li Jingye rises at Yangzhou; Luo Binwang's manifesto against her is so fine she blames ministers for neglecting its author.
steps.text_zh: 684年，高宗死后，武太后废中宗、立睿宗，独揽大权。徐敬业在扬州起兵，骆宾王写下讨武檄文，她读后反而责怪宰相埋没了这样的人才。起兵三个月即被平定。

steps.text: 690: in Luoyang, renamed the Divine Capital, Wu takes the throne herself and names her dynasty Zhou. Informers and harsh officials have already broken the Tang princes and their supporters.
steps.text_zh: 690年，武则天在已改称神都的洛阳正式称帝，改国号为周。此前她设铜匦鼓励告密，任用来俊臣等酷吏，打击了李唐宗室和反对者。

steps.text: 698: her chief minister Di Renjie persuades the aging empress to recall her exiled son Li Xian and name him heir, so that the throne will return to the Li family.
steps.text_zh: 698年，宰相狄仁杰等人力劝年迈的武则天召回被废的庐陵王李显，立为太子，为皇位重回李唐铺平了道路。狄仁杰还向她举荐了张柬之等人。

steps.text: 705: Zhang Jianzhi and other ministers lead palace guards into the palace, kill her favourites the Zhang brothers and force her to abdicate. Zhongzong restores the Tang; Wu dies that winter.
steps.text_zh: 705年，张柬之等率禁军冲入宫中，诛杀武则天宠信的张易之、张昌宗兄弟，逼她传位。中宗复位，恢复唐国号。同年冬武则天病逝于洛阳上阳宫。

steps.text: 706: she is buried beside Gaozong in the Qianling tomb, carved into a mountain northwest of Chang'an. Before it stands a tall stone stele left without an inscription.
steps.text_zh: 706年，武则天与高宗合葬于长安西北梁山上的乾陵。陵前立着一通没有刻字的“无字碑”，功过任由后人评说。

title: Tang and Tibet
summary: Two centuries of marriage alliances, wars and treaties between the Tang and the Tibetan empire.
summary_zh: 和亲、交战、会盟交替上演，唐与吐蕃争夺青海、河西和西域近两百年。

steps.text: 663: after Songtsen Gampo's death, the Tibetan regent Gar Tongtsen conquers the Tuyuhun kingdom around Kokonor. Tibet now borders the Tang directly from Qinghai to the Western Regions.
steps.text_zh: 663年，松赞干布已去世多年，吐蕃大相禄东赞率军攻灭青海湖一带的吐谷浑。吐蕃从此与唐朝直接接壤，双方开始争夺青海和西域。

steps.text: 670: sent to restore the Tuyuhun, Xue Rengui's army is destroyed at Dafeichuan by the Tibetan general Gar Trinring. The Tang gives up the Four Garrisons of the Tarim for a time.
steps.text_zh: 670年，唐派薛仁贵出兵青海，在大非川被吐蕃大将论钦陵击败，几乎全军覆没。唐朝一度放弃安西四镇，吐蕃势力伸入西域。

steps.text: 710: Princess Jincheng is married to the young Tibetan king Tride Tsugtsen, renewing the marriage tie begun by Princess Wencheng seventy years earlier. War and peace still alternate, with a border and markets later fixed at the Red Ridge.
steps.text_zh: 710年，唐中宗把金城公主嫁给吐蕃赞普赤德祖赞，延续了七十年前文成公主开始的和亲。此后双方仍时战时和，在赤岭一带划界互市。

steps.text: 763: with Tang armies pulled east against An Lushan, Tibet seizes the Longyou lands and in the tenth month storms Chang'an. It holds the capital for about fifteen days before Guo Ziyi forces it out.
steps.text_zh: 763年，唐军东调平定安史之乱，吐蕃乘虚夺取陇右诸州，十月攻入长安，立金城公主的侄子李承宏为帝，盘踞约十五天才被郭子仪逼退。

steps.text: 786: one by one the Hexi towns fall: Liangzhou, Ganzhou, Suzhou, Guazhou. Isolated Shazhou (Dunhuang) holds out for years before surrendering on terms. The Tang loses the corridor to the west.
steps.text_zh: 786年，凉、甘、肃、瓜诸州已相继失陷，孤城沙州（今敦煌）坚守多年后，在吐蕃答应不迁徙居民的条件下投降。河西走廊全部落入吐蕃之手。

steps.text: 787: at a treaty meeting at Pingliang, the Tibetan general Zhang Gyaltsen springs an ambush. The Tang envoy Hun Jian barely escapes on horseback; many officials are captured.
steps.text_zh: 787年，唐蕃在平凉会盟，吐蕃大相尚结赞事先埋伏兵马，在盟坛上突然劫盟。唐使浑瑊夺马逃回，副使崔汉衡等大批官员被俘。

steps.text: 821 to 822: exhausted by war, both sides swear a lasting peace, first in Chang'an and then in Lhasa. The treaty, inscribed in Chinese and Tibetan, still stands before the Jokhang temple.
steps.text_zh: 821至822年，双方厌战，先后在长安和逻些（今拉萨）会盟，约定各守边界、互不侵犯。用汉藏两种文字刻成的唐蕃会盟碑至今立在拉萨大昭寺前。

steps.text: 848: with the Tibetan empire collapsing into civil war, Zhang Yichao leads the people of Shazhou in revolt and drives out the Tibetan garrison, then retakes Guazhou and other towns.
steps.text_zh: 848年，吐蕃王朝陷入内乱，沙州汉人张议潮率众起义，赶走吐蕃守将，接着收复瓜州等地，河西陷蕃六十多年后重新出现唐朝的旗帜。

steps.text: 851: Zhang Yichao's brother brings the maps and registers of eleven prefectures to Chang'an. The Tang creates the Returning Allegiance Army with Zhang as governor, ruling Dunhuang for generations.
steps.text_zh: 851年，张议潮派哥哥张议潭带着瓜、沙等十一州的地图户籍入朝。唐朝设立归义军，以张议潮为节度使，张氏、曹氏此后世代统治敦煌。

title: Li Bai's wanderings
summary: The restless poet's life on the road, from the far west to the Yangzi, the capital and back down the river.
summary_zh: 仗剑去国、辞亲远游，诗仙李白一生几乎都在路上。

steps.text: 701: Li Bai is born, by a widely held account at Suyab on the Chu river in Central Asia, then a Tang garrison town, where his family had lived for generations.
steps.text_zh: 701年，李白出生。一种流行的说法认为他生于西域碎叶城（今吉尔吉斯斯坦托克马克附近），祖上久居西域，当时碎叶是唐朝的军镇。

steps.text: 705: the family moves to Changlong in Mianzhou (Jiangyou, Sichuan). Li Bai grows up here reading widely, fencing and visiting Daoist hermits in the hills.
steps.text_zh: 705年前后，李白随父亲迁居绵州昌隆（今四川江油）。他在这里读书、学剑，常到山中寻访道士，度过了青少年时代。

steps.text: 725: aged about twenty-four, he leaves Sichuan by boat through the Three Gorges. At Jiangling he meets the Daoist master Sima Chengzhen, who praises his spirit.
steps.text_zh: 725年，二十四五岁的李白“仗剑去国，辞亲远游”，乘船出三峡。在江陵，他见到了著名道士司马承祯，被称赞有“仙风道骨”。

steps.text: 726: he wanders down the Yangzi to Jinling and Yangzhou. By his own account he spends more than three hundred thousand cash in under a year, much of it helping poor scholars.
steps.text_zh: 726年，李白东游金陵、扬州。据他自述，在扬州不到一年便散金三十余万，多用来接济落魄的文士，豪侠之名由此传开。

steps.text: 742: after years based at Anlu, where he married a former chancellor's granddaughter, he is summoned to Chang'an. He Zhizhang calls him a banished immortal and Xuanzong makes him a Hanlin attendant.
steps.text_zh: 742年，在安陆成家、漫游多年的李白奉诏入长安。贺知章读其诗文称他为“谪仙人”，唐玄宗命他供奉翰林。但不到两年他便被“赐金放还”。

steps.text: 744: having left court, he meets the younger Du Fu at Luoyang. With Gao Shi they ride and drink through the old lands of Liang and Song, a friendship Du Fu will write about all his life.
steps.text_zh: 744年，离开长安的李白在洛阳与杜甫相遇，随后两人和高适同游梁宋（今开封、商丘一带），饮酒论诗。杜甫此后一生写了许多怀念李白的诗。

steps.text: 757: during the An Lushan war he joins the staff of Prince Yong, whose fleet sails down the Yangzi. The prince is crushed as a rebel; Li Bai is jailed at Xunyang and sentenced to exile in Yelang.
steps.text_zh: 757年，安史之乱中李白加入永王李璘的幕府。永王被肃宗视为叛乱而遭剿灭，李白在浔阳（今九江）下狱，次年被判流放夜郎。

steps.text: 759: travelling slowly upriver into exile, he reaches Baidicheng when an amnesty arrives. He turns back and races down the Gorges, the trip tradition links to his poem on leaving Baidi at dawn.
steps.text_zh: 759年，李白流放途中行至白帝城，遇大赦获释，立即乘船东下。相传《早发白帝城》中“轻舟已过万重山”写的就是这次欢快的归程。

steps.text: 762: old and ill, Li Bai lodges with his kinsman Li Yangbing, magistrate of Dangtu on the Yangzi, and dies there. Li Yangbing collects and edits his poems.
steps.text_zh: 762年，年老多病的李白投奔任当涂县令的族叔李阳冰，不久在当涂去世。临终前他把诗稿托付给李阳冰，后者编成《草堂集》。

title: The life of Du Fu
summary: The poet-historian who lived through the fall of the High Tang and wrote it down.
summary_zh: 盛唐转衰的亲历者，杜甫用诗歌记下了安史之乱前后的时代，被称为“诗史”。

steps.text: 712: Du Fu is born at Gong county near Luoyang, into a family of officials; his grandfather Du Shenyan was a court poet of Empress Wu's day.
steps.text_zh: 712年，杜甫生于河南巩县（今巩义）的官宦之家，祖父杜审言是武则天时期的著名诗人。他少年时便能作诗，青年时漫游吴越、齐赵。

steps.text: 746: he goes to Chang'an seeking office and stays ten years. He fails the examinations, presents poems to the powerful and lives poorly, watching the capital's luxury from outside.
steps.text_zh: 746年，杜甫来到长安谋求仕进，一住就是十年。科举落第，献赋求官，过着“朝扣富儿门，暮随肥马尘”的困顿生活，看清了盛世背后的贫富悬殊。

steps.text: Late 755: travelling to his family at Fengxian, he passes the emperor's pleasure palace at Lishan and writes of vermilion gates reeking of wine and meat while the poor freeze on the road. At home his infant son has starved.
steps.text_zh: 755年冬，杜甫从长安去奉先县（今陕西蒲城）探家，途经骊山，写下“朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨”。到家时幼子已经饿死。不久安史之乱爆发。

steps.text: 757: captured by the rebels on his way to the new emperor, he is held in occupied Chang'an. In spring he writes Spring View: the nation is broken, but hills and rivers remain.
steps.text_zh: 757年春，杜甫在投奔肃宗途中被叛军俘获，困在沦陷的长安，写下《春望》：“国破山河在，城春草木深。”

steps.text: 757: he escapes to the emperor's camp at Fengxiang, arriving in hemp sandals and ragged clothes, and is made a Reminder, a junior adviser at court.
steps.text_zh: 757年四月，杜甫冒险逃出长安，穿着麻鞋破衣赶到凤翔行在拜见唐肃宗，被授为左拾遗。不久因上疏营救房琯触怒肃宗。

steps.text: 759: after writing the Three Officials and Three Partings about the war's conscripts, he gives up his post and heads west to Qinzhou, then south to Tonggu, where his family nearly starves.
steps.text_zh: 759年，杜甫写下“三吏”“三别”后弃官西行，带着家人到秦州（今天水），冬天又南下同谷，靠挖野菜度日，年底翻越蜀道入川。

steps.text: 760: with friends' help he builds a thatched cottage by the Huanhua stream outside Chengdu. In these years of relative peace he writes of his garden and of the roof the autumn wind tore away.
steps.text_zh: 760年，在亲友资助下，杜甫在成都浣花溪畔建起草堂，过了几年较安定的生活，写下《茅屋为秋风所破歌》等名篇。

steps.text: 766: he moves down the Yangzi to Kuizhou at the head of the Three Gorges. In under two years he writes some four hundred poems, including Climbing High and Autumn Meditations.
steps.text_zh: 766年，杜甫沿长江东下，寓居夔州（今重庆奉节）。不到两年写诗四百多首，《登高》《秋兴八首》都作于此时。

steps.text: 770: drifting on the Xiang river between Tanzhou and Yuezhou, poor and ill, Du Fu dies on his boat that winter, aged fifty-nine. Later generations call him the Poet Sage and his verse a history in poetry.
steps.text_zh: 770年冬，贫病交加的杜甫漂泊在湘江上，往来于潭州（今长沙）和岳州之间，最终病逝在船中，终年五十九岁。

title: Jianzhen sails to Japan
summary: A Yangzhou monk tries six times over eleven years to reach Japan, loses his sight on the way, and finally founds a temple in Nara.
summary_zh: 扬州高僧鉴真六次东渡、历时十一年，双目失明仍矢志不渝，终于到达日本弘法。

steps.text: 742: two Japanese monks, Eiei and Fusho, come to Daming Temple in Yangzhou and beg the Vinaya master Jianzhen to send someone to Japan. In his fifties, he decides to go himself.
steps.text_zh: 742年，日本僧人荣睿、普照来到扬州大明寺，恳请律宗高僧鉴真去日本传授戒律。五十多岁的鉴真决定亲自东渡。

steps.text: 744: the first attempts all fail. One is stopped after someone informs the authorities, another is wrecked by storms off Mingzhou (Ningbo).
steps.text_zh: 744年，此前的头几次东渡接连受挫：有的因被人告发而中止，有的船在明州（今宁波）附近海面遇风触礁。

steps.text: 748: on the fifth attempt a storm drives the ship south for fourteen days. It lands at Zhenzhou (Sanya) on the southern tip of Hainan.
steps.text_zh: 748年第五次东渡，船在海上遇到大风，漂流十四天，竟到了海南岛南端的振州（今三亚）。

steps.text: 750: making their way back north through Guangxi and Guangzhou, Eiei dies at Duanzhou, and Jianzhen, worn out by the journey and the heat, loses his sight.
steps.text_zh: 750年，鉴真一行辗转经广西、广州北返。日本弟子荣睿在端州病逝，鉴真因长途劳顿和暑热，双目失明。

steps.text: 753: as a Japanese embassy sails home, Jianzhen defies the ban on leaving and boards the vice-envoy's ship at Huangsipu near Suzhou, his sixth try.
steps.text_zh: 753年，日本遣唐使回国，鉴真不顾朝廷禁止，秘密登上遣唐副使的船，从苏州黄泗浦第六次出海。

steps.text: Late 753: the ship reaches Satsuma in southern Kyushu. Jianzhen is sixty-six, and eleven years have passed since he first planned the voyage.
steps.text_zh: 753年底，船抵日本九州南部的萨摩。此时鉴真已六十六岁，距第一次计划东渡已过去十一年。

steps.text: 754: in Nara, Jianzhen sets up an ordination platform at Todaiji and ordains the retired Emperor Shomu and others, giving Japan a proper system of monastic ordination.
steps.text_zh: 754年，鉴真到达奈良，在东大寺设立戒坛，为圣武太上天皇等人授戒，日本从此有了正规的受戒制度。

steps.text: 759: he founds Toshodaiji in Nara, teaching monastic discipline and passing on Tang architecture, sculpture and medicine. He dies there in 763.
steps.text_zh: 759年，鉴真在奈良建唐招提寺，传授律学，也带去了建筑、雕塑和医药知识。763年他在寺中圆寂。

title: The An Lushan rebellion
summary: Eight years of war that broke the Tang at its height.
summary_zh: 八年战乱，盛唐由此转衰。

steps.text: Winter 755: An Lushan, commander of three frontier armies, rises at Fanyang (Beijing) with some 150,000 men, claiming to remove the chancellor Yang Guozhong.
steps.text_zh: 755年冬，身兼三镇节度使的安禄山以讨杨国忠为名，在范阳（今北京）起兵，号称二十万。

steps.text: The rebels cross the Yellow River and take Luoyang in just over a month. Early in 756 An Lushan proclaims himself emperor of Great Yan there.
steps.text_zh: 叛军渡过黄河，一个多月便攻陷东都洛阳。756年初，安禄山在洛阳称帝，国号大燕。

steps.text: Summer 756: forced by the court to leave his strong position, Geshu Han is routed outside Tong Pass. The road to Chang'an lies open.
steps.text_zh: 756年夏，哥舒翰被朝廷逼令出关迎战，大败于灵宝，潼关失守，长安门户洞开。

steps.text: Emperor Xuanzong flees west. At Mawei the guards kill Yang Guozhong and force the emperor to have Consort Yang strangled.
steps.text_zh: 唐玄宗仓皇西逃。行至马嵬驿，禁军哗变，杀死杨国忠，并逼玄宗赐死杨贵妃。

steps.text: The crown prince goes north to Lingwu and takes the throne as Suzong; Xuanzong, now in Sichuan, accepts it. Guo Ziyi's frontier army becomes the core of the fight back.
steps.text_zh: 太子李亨北上灵武即位，是为唐肃宗，避入蜀中的玄宗被尊为太上皇。郭子仪的朔方军成为平叛主力。

steps.text: 757: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan hold Suiyang for ten months, keeping the rebels out of the Huai valley and the grain of the south.
steps.text_zh: 757年，张巡、许远死守睢阳十个月，城破殉国，但挡住了叛军南下江淮，保住了唐朝的财赋之地。

steps.text: Autumn 757: with Uyghur cavalry, Tang armies retake Chang'an and Luoyang. An Lushan has already been murdered by his own son.
steps.text_zh: 757年秋，唐军借回纥骑兵收复长安、洛阳。此前安禄山已被儿子安庆绪所杀。

steps.text: Shi Siming takes over the rebellion, beats the Tang at Yecheng in 759 and retakes Luoyang, but in 761 he too is killed by his son.
steps.text_zh: 史思明接掌叛军，759年在邺城大败唐军，再陷洛阳；761年也被儿子史朝义所杀。

steps.text: 763: Shi Chaoyi kills himself and the war ends. But rebel generals keep Hebei as near-independent governors, Tibet takes the northwest, and the Tang never regains its old strength.
steps.text_zh: 763年，史朝义兵败自杀，战乱结束。但降将据有河北成为藩镇，吐蕃乘虚夺取河西陇右，唐朝从此再未恢复盛世。

title: Huang Chao and the end of Tang
summary: A salt smuggler's rebellion sweeps from Shandong to Guangzhou to Chang'an, and one of his officers ends the Tang.
summary_zh: 黄巢起义转战南北，攻入长安；降唐的部将朱温最终篡唐，唐朝灭亡。

steps.text: 875: Wang Xianzhi has risen at Changyuan, and the salt smuggler Huang Chao joins him from Caozhou. After years of famine east of the passes, hungry farmers flock to them.
steps.text_zh: 875年，王仙芝已在长垣起事，曹州冤句的私盐贩子黄巢聚众响应。关东连年灾荒，大批饥民加入起义军。

steps.text: 878: Wang Xianzhi is defeated and killed at Huangmei. His men join Huang Chao, who now calls himself the Heaven-Storming General.
steps.text_zh: 878年，王仙芝在黄梅兵败被杀，余部归附黄巢，黄巢自称“冲天大将军”。

steps.text: 879: avoiding the main Tang armies, Huang Chao heads south through Zhejiang and Fujian and takes Guangzhou. Arab sources say many foreign merchants were killed.
steps.text_zh: 879年，黄巢避开唐军重兵，渡江南下，经浙东、福建，攻陷广州。据阿拉伯文献记载，城中许多外国商人遇害。

steps.text: 880: with disease spreading in the south, Huang Chao turns north through Hunan to Jiangling, then crosses the Yangtze at Caishi and heads for the heartland.
steps.text_zh: 880年，岭南疫病流行，黄巢率军北上，经湖南至江陵，在采石渡过长江，挥师直指中原。

steps.text: End of 880: Huang Chao takes Luoyang, then Chang'an. Emperor Xizong flees to Chengdu, and Huang Chao proclaims himself emperor of Great Qi in the Hanyuan Hall.
steps.text_zh: 880年底，黄巢攻破洛阳，又攻入长安，唐僖宗逃往成都。黄巢在含元殿称帝，国号大齐。

steps.text: 882: Huang Chao's officer Zhu Wen goes over to the Tang at Tongzhou. He is renamed Zhu Quanzhong and later made governor at Bianzhou (Kaifeng).
steps.text_zh: 882年，黄巢部将朱温在同州降唐，被赐名朱全忠，后来出任宣武军节度使，坐镇汴州。

steps.text: 883: the Shatuo Turk leader Li Keyong defeats Huang Chao and retakes Chang'an. In 884 Huang Chao dies at Langhu Valley near Mount Tai.
steps.text_zh: 883年，沙陀首领李克用率军击败黄巢，收复长安。884年，黄巢在泰山狼虎谷兵败身死。

steps.text: 904: Zhu Quanzhong forces Emperor Zhaozong to move to Luoyang and has Chang'an's palaces and houses torn down. The city is never a capital again.
steps.text_zh: 904年，朱全忠挟持唐昭宗迁都洛阳，拆毁长安的宫室和民居，长安从此不再是都城。

steps.text: 907: Zhu Quanzhong makes the last Tang emperor abdicate and declares himself emperor of Liang at Bianzhou. The Tang, nearly three centuries old, is over.
steps.text_zh: 907年，朱全忠逼唐哀帝禅位，在汴州称帝，国号梁。立国近三百年的唐朝灭亡。

title: The Five Dynasties
summary: Five short-lived dynasties follow each other in the north in half a century, while the Khitan rise beyond the passes.
summary_zh: 半个世纪里北方五个王朝相继更替，契丹趁机南下，直到后周世宗开始重新统一。

steps.text: 907: Zhu Wen founds the Later Liang at Kaifeng. Regional governors break away everywhere: the north will see five dynasties, the south a patchwork of kingdoms.
steps.text_zh: 907年，朱温在开封称帝建立后梁。各地节度使纷纷自立，此后北方先后经历五个朝代，南方则出现多个割据政权。

steps.text: 923: Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, declares himself emperor of Tang at Weizhou, then strikes Kaifeng in a surprise attack. The last Liang emperor kills himself.
steps.text_zh: 923年，晋王李存勖在魏州称帝，国号唐，随即奇袭开封，后梁末帝自杀，后梁灭亡。

steps.text: 926: Zhuangzong, who favoured actors over soldiers, is killed in a mutiny at Luoyang's Xingjiao Gate. The general Li Siyuan takes the throne as Mingzong.
steps.text_zh: 926年，宠信伶人的后唐庄宗在洛阳兴教门之变中被杀，大将李嗣源即位，是为后唐明宗。

steps.text: 936: Shi Jingtang, governor at Taiyuan, calls the Khitan ruler father and promises him the Sixteen Prefectures. With Khitan help he overthrows Later Tang and founds Later Jin.
steps.text_zh: 936年，河东节度使石敬瑭向契丹称臣称子，许以割让燕云十六州，借契丹兵灭后唐，建立后晋。中原从此失去北方屏障。

steps.text: Early 947: after Later Jin stops acting as a vassal, the Khitan take Kaifeng and end it. Yelu Deguang renames his state Liao but withdraws within months in the face of revolts.
steps.text_zh: 947年初，后晋拒绝继续称臣，契丹大军南下攻入开封，后晋灭亡。耶律德光改国号为辽，但因各地反抗，几个月后就北撤。

steps.text: 947: Liu Zhiyuan, governor at Taiyuan, declares himself emperor as the Khitan withdraw, then moves into Kaifeng and founds the Later Han, the shortest of the five dynasties.
steps.text_zh: 947年，契丹北撤之际，河东节度使刘知远在太原称帝，随后南下入主开封，建立后汉，这是五代中最短的一个王朝。

steps.text: 951: the general Guo Wei takes the throne at Kaifeng and founds the Later Zhou. A Later Han prince sets up Northern Han at Taiyuan under Khitan protection.
steps.text_zh: 951年，大将郭威在开封称帝，建立后周。后汉宗室刘崇则在太原自立为北汉，依附契丹。

steps.text: 954: newly enthroned, Chai Rong (Shizong of Zhou) leads from the front at Gaoping and defeats Northern Han and Khitan forces, then reforms the palace army.
steps.text_zh: 954年，周世宗柴荣即位不久，在高平亲自督战，击败北汉和契丹联军，随后大力整顿禁军。

steps.text: 959: having taken Southern Tang's lands north of the Yangtze, Shizong marches against the Khitan and recovers Yingzhou and Mozhou, but falls ill and dies back in Kaifeng.
steps.text_zh: 959年，已夺取南唐江北之地的周世宗又北伐契丹，收复瀛、莫等州，却在途中病倒，回京后去世。

title: A tour of the Ten Kingdoms
summary: While the north changed dynasties five times, the south split into stable, prosperous regional states.
summary_zh: 北方五代更迭，南方十国却多能保境安民，经济文化反而持续发展。

steps.text: 907: when the Tang falls, the south is already divided among warlords who hold it for decades: Wu on the Huai, Wuyue, Min, Chu, Shu and soon Southern Han, with Northern Han later in the north.
steps.text_zh: 907年唐朝灭亡时，南方已被各地节度使瓜分：吴据江淮，钱镠据两浙，马殷据湖南，王审知据福建，王建据四川。加上后来诸国，史称十国。

steps.text: 907: Ma Yin, made King of Chu at Changsha, lets farmers grow and sell tea freely to the north for horses and silk, and casts lead and iron coins that merchants must spend before leaving.
steps.text_zh: 907年，马殷受封楚王，定都长沙。他让百姓自由种茶，贩往北方换回战马丝帛；又铸铅铁钱，商人出境用不了，只好买当地货物带走。

steps.text: 909: Wang Shenzhi becomes Prince of Min at Fuzhou. He keeps peace with the northern courts, opens the harbour of Gantang and draws foreign merchant ships to Fujian.
steps.text_zh: 909年，王审知受封闽王，定都福州。他对中原称臣，保境息民，开辟甘棠港，招来海外商船，福建由此兴盛起来。

steps.text: 910: Qian Liu, King of Wuyue, builds a stone seawall at Hangzhou against the Qiantang tidal bore, using bamboo cages filled with rocks. Legend says his archers shot at the tide.
steps.text_zh: 910年，吴越王钱镠在杭州修筑捍海石塘，用竹笼装石，层层垒筑，抵御钱塘江潮。民间流传着“钱王射潮”的故事。杭州从此日渐繁荣。

steps.text: 917: Liu Yan proclaims himself emperor at Guangzhou, founding what becomes Southern Han. Rich from the sea trade, the court is famous for lavish palaces and, later, vast numbers of eunuchs.
steps.text_zh: 917年，刘䶮在广州称帝，次年改国号为汉，史称南汉。南汉靠海外贸易致富，宫殿奢华，后期宦官人数之多为历代罕见。

steps.text: 924: Gao Jixing is made Prince of Nanping at Jiangling. His tiny state, Jingnan, survives by bowing to everyone and seizing tribute passing through, earning the Gao family the nickname Gao the Rogue.
steps.text_zh: 924年，高季兴受封南平王，据守江陵，史称荆南。地小兵弱的荆南向四方称臣，又截留各国过境的贡物，高氏因此被各国讥为“高无赖”。

steps.text: 937: in Jinling (Nanjing), Xu Zhigao, who controls Wu, takes the throne as Li Bian and founds Southern Tang, the largest southern state, a centre of scholars, painters and poets.
steps.text_zh: 937年，掌握吴国大权的徐知诰在金陵代吴称帝，改名李昪，国号唐，史称南唐。南唐是十国中最大的国家，文人、画家云集，后来出了词人李煜。

steps.text: 940: in Later Shu's Chengdu, Zhao Chongzuo compiles the Among the Flowers anthology of song lyrics. Sheltered by mountains, Sichuan stays rich and peaceful through most of the era.
steps.text_zh: 940年，后蜀的赵崇祚在成都编成《花间集》，这是现存最早的文人词集。前蜀、后蜀凭借山川险阻，在乱世中保持了富庶安定。

steps.text: 951: after the fall of Later Han, Liu Chong declares himself emperor at Taiyuan. His poor, mountain-bound Northern Han survives by serving the Khitan emperor as his nephew.
steps.text_zh: 951年，后汉灭亡，刘崇在太原称帝，史称北汉。北汉地瘠民贫，依附契丹，自称“侄皇帝”，直到979年才被宋朝灭掉，是十国中最后亡国的。

title: The rise of the Khitan
summary: In forty years the Khitan went from steppe tribes to an empire that ruled part of north China and briefly took Kaifeng.
summary_zh: 四十年间，契丹从草原部落联盟发展为帝国，取得燕云十六州，一度入主开封。

steps.text: 907: Abaoji of the Yila clan becomes khagan of the Khitan confederation on the Xar Moron river, the same year the Tang falls. Chinese refugees from the wars bring farming and craft skills.
steps.text_zh: 907年，就在唐朝灭亡这一年，迭剌部的耶律阿保机成为契丹各部的可汗。中原战乱，大批汉人逃入契丹，带来了农耕和手工技术。

steps.text: 916: refusing to hand power back to the tribal council, Abaoji proclaims himself emperor in the Chinese manner. Soon he builds a walled capital and has a Khitan script created from Chinese characters.
steps.text_zh: 916年，阿保机拒绝按部落旧制让出汗位，仿照中原称帝，建元神册。他任用韩延徽等汉人，修建都城，并于920年参照汉字创制契丹大字。

steps.text: 926: Abaoji's armies take Huhan, capital of the Balhae kingdom in Manchuria, ending it after two centuries. He turns it into the Dongdan kingdom under his eldest son.
steps.text_zh: 926年，阿保机亲征渤海国，攻破都城忽汗城，立国两百多年的渤海灭亡。他改渤海为东丹国，由太子耶律倍统治。

steps.text: 926: on the way home Abaoji dies at Fuyu. His widow Empress Shulü takes control and passes over the eldest son for her favourite, Deguang. She is said to have cut off her own hand to bury with her husband.
steps.text_zh: 926年，阿保机在回师途中死于扶余城。述律后临朝称制，据说她砍下自己一只手腕放入丈夫棺中，以代替殉葬。她扶立次子耶律德光继位。

steps.text: 936: besieged in Taiyuan, the Later Tang general Shi Jingtang calls in Deguang, who rides south and smashes the besiegers. Shi becomes emperor of Later Jin and hands over the Sixteen Prefectures.
steps.text_zh: 936年，被后唐军围困在太原的石敬瑭向契丹求援，耶律德光亲率骑兵南下，大破唐军，立石敬瑭为后晋皇帝。石敬瑭随即割让燕云十六州。

steps.text: 938: Youzhou (Beijing) becomes the Khitan Southern Capital. Deguang rules Chinese subjects by Chinese law and officials and Khitans by tribal custom, a dual system the Liao keeps.
steps.text_zh: 938年，契丹把幽州升为南京。耶律德光逐步建立南北面官制度，以汉法治汉人、以契丹旧制治契丹人。长城一线从此不再是中原的屏障。

steps.text: 945: Later Jin stops calling itself a vassal, and Deguang invades. At Yangcheng the Jin army breaks out and routs the Khitan; Deguang escapes on a camel.
steps.text_zh: 945年，后晋拒绝继续称臣，契丹连年南侵。在阳城之战中，晋军奋力反击，契丹大败，耶律德光弃车骑着骆驼才得以逃脱。

steps.text: 947: after the Jin commander Du Chongwei surrenders, Deguang enters Kaifeng and renames his state Liao. His troops' plundering, called grass gathering, sets off revolts, and he soon leaves.
steps.text_zh: 947年初，晋军主帅杜重威投降，耶律德光进入开封，灭后晋，改国号为辽。契丹兵四出“打草谷”抢掠，各地纷纷反抗，他只得北撤。

steps.text: 947: Deguang falls ill and dies on the road north at Shahulin near Luancheng. Liao will hold the Sixteen Prefectures for nearly two centuries, but never again rules the central plain.
steps.text_zh: 947年四月，耶律德光在北撤途中病死于栾城杀胡林。辽朝此后长期占据燕云十六州，但再也没能入主中原。

title: Song reunites China
summary: A palace guard commander is made emperor by his troops and, with his brother, swallows the southern kingdoms one by one.
summary_zh: 赵匡胤陈桥兵变建宋，兄弟二人先南后北，逐一削平割据政权，但收复燕云的努力失败。

steps.text: Early 960: Zhao Kuangyin, commander of the palace army, is draped in the imperial yellow robe by his officers at Chenqiao, returns to Kaifeng and founds the Song.
steps.text_zh: 960年正月，殿前都点检赵匡胤领兵北上，在开封东北的陈桥驿被部下黄袍加身，回师开封即位，建立宋朝。

steps.text: 961: at a banquet, Emperor Taizu persuades Shi Shouxin and the other palace army generals to hand over their commands and retire in comfort.
steps.text_zh: 961年，宋太祖在宴席上劝石守信等禁军大将交出兵权，回乡置产享乐，史称“杯酒释兵权”。

steps.text: 963: Song troops ask for passage through Jingnan to reach Hunan, absorb Jingnan on the way and then take Hunan, gaining the middle Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 963年，宋军借道荆南出兵湖南，顺势吞并荆南，又平定湖南，控制了长江中游。

steps.text: 965: two Song armies enter Sichuan and the Later Shu ruler Meng Chang surrenders. The whole campaign takes sixty-six days.
steps.text_zh: 965年，宋军分两路入川，后蜀国主孟昶出降，从出兵到灭国只用了六十六天。

steps.text: 971: Pan Mei marches south, defeats the Southern Han armies around Shaozhou and takes Guangzhou. Its ruler Liu Chang surrenders and the far south joins the Song.
steps.text_zh: 971年，潘美率军南下，在韶州等地击败南汉军，攻克广州，南汉后主刘鋹出降，岭南归宋。

steps.text: 975: Cao Bin's army, which crossed the Yangtze on a pontoon bridge at Caishi the winter before, takes Jinling, and the poet-king Li Yu of Southern Tang surrenders.
steps.text_zh: 975年，曹彬率军已于上年冬在采石架浮桥渡过长江，此时攻破金陵，南唐后主李煜出降。

steps.text: 978: King Qian Chu of Wuyue comes to court and hands his thirteen prefectures to the Song without a fight. Chen Hongjin in Fujian does the same.
steps.text_zh: 978年，吴越王钱俶入朝，献出所辖十三州一军，和平归宋。同年福建的陈洪进也献地归附。

steps.text: 979: Emperor Taizong besieges Taiyuan in person and Liu Jiyuan of Northern Han surrenders. The age of division is essentially over.
steps.text_zh: 979年，宋太宗亲征，围攻太原，北汉刘继元投降。五代十国的分裂局面基本结束。

steps.text: 979: pressing on to retake the Sixteen Prefectures, Taizong attacks Youzhou but is routed at the Gaoliang River by the Liao general Yelu Xiuge, escaping wounded in a donkey cart.
steps.text_zh: 979年，太宗乘胜进攻幽州，想收复燕云，在高梁河被辽将耶律休哥击溃，太宗中箭后乘驴车逃回。宋辽从此长期对峙。

title: Kaifeng, the Song capital
summary: How a flat river city with no natural defences became the richest capital of its age.
summary_zh: 无险可守的汴京，凭借汴河漕运成为当时世界上最繁华的都城之一。

steps.text: 960: the new Song dynasty keeps Kaifeng as its capital. The city sits on open plain with no mountains to protect it, but the Bian canal links it to the grain of the Yangzi and Huai.
steps.text_zh: 960年，宋朝沿袭后周，定都开封，称东京。这里地处平原、无险可守，但汴河直通江淮，漕运便利，朝廷只能以重兵驻守京城来弥补。

steps.text: 976: Emperor Taizu visits Luoyang and proposes moving the capital there, behind its hills and passes. His brother, the future Taizong, objects that security lies in virtue, not terrain, and Kaifeng stays.
steps.text_zh: 976年，宋太祖西巡洛阳，想把都城迁到山河险固的洛阳。弟弟晋王赵光义以“在德不在险”劝阻，迁都之议作罢，开封从此成为北宋都城。

steps.text: About 1007: barges on the Bian canal, entering from the Huai river at Sizhou, carry some six million piculs of southern grain a year to feed Kaifeng's court, army and citizens.
steps.text_zh: 1007年前后，汴河每年运送的江淮漕粮定为约六百万石。漕船从泗州一带由淮河进入汴河，源源不断北上，养活了京城的朝廷、禁军和百姓。

steps.text: 1027: the court physician Wang Weiyi casts two life-size bronze figures marked with acupuncture points, used for teaching and examining students of medicine in the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1027年，翰林医官王惟一主持铸成两具针灸铜人，身上刻有经络和穴位，用来教学和考核医生。这是开封作为全国学术中心的一个缩影。

steps.text: 1088: Su Song and Han Gonglian begin building a water-driven astronomical clock tower in Kaifeng, combining an armillary sphere, a celestial globe and time-keeping figures.
steps.text_zh: 1088年，苏颂与韩公廉在开封制造水运仪象台，以水力驱动，把观测天象的浑仪、演示天象的浑象和报时装置合为一体。

steps.text: 1103: the court issues Li Jie's Treatise on Architectural Methods, setting standard timber modules and labour norms for the palaces, temples and offices being built across the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1103年，朝廷颁行李诫编写的《营造法式》，统一规定建筑的用材等级、构造做法和工料定额，京城大兴土木都以此为准。

steps.text: Early 1100s: walled wards are long gone and shops line every street. Daxiangguo Temple opens its courtyards for a great market five times a month, and the night market by Zhou Bridge runs past midnight.
steps.text_zh: 12世纪初，开封早已打破坊市界限，临街开店随处可见。大相国寺每月开放五次，供百姓交易；州桥一带的夜市一直营业到三更。

steps.text: About 1110: Zhang Zeduan paints Along the River at Qingming, following the Bian canal from the countryside past the Rainbow Bridge into the city, crowded with boats, carts, shops and travellers.
steps.text_zh: 约1110年，张择端绘成《清明上河图》，从城郊沿汴河画到虹桥和城门内外，船只、车马、店铺和行人密集，留下了北宋汴京的生动面貌。

steps.text: 1126: Jin armies besiege Kaifeng twice and the city falls. Years later, in the south, Meng Yuanlao writes down his memories of it in the Dream of the Splendours of the Eastern Capital.
steps.text_zh: 1126年，金军两次围攻开封，城破，繁华一朝散尽。后来孟元老在南方追忆往事，写成《东京梦华录》，记下了汴京的街市和节令风俗。

title: The Chanyuan treaty and the Xia wars
summary: Song buys peace with the Liao at Chanyuan, then fights and pays again when the Tangut state of Xia rises in the northwest.
summary_zh: 宋辽订立澶渊之盟换来百年和平，此后宋夏交战多年，最终也以岁赐议和。

steps.text: Autumn 1004: the Liao emperor Shengzong and his mother, Empress Dowager Xiao, lead a great army south, bypass the fortified towns of Hebei and head for Chanzhou on the Yellow River.
steps.text_zh: 1004年秋，辽圣宗与萧太后率大军南下，绕过河北的坚城，直逼黄河边的澶州。

steps.text: 1004: some at the Kaifeng court urge moving the capital to Jinling or Chengdu. Chief minister Kou Zhun overrules them and insists Emperor Zhenzong lead the army himself.
steps.text_zh: 1004年，开封朝中有人主张迁都金陵或成都躲避，宰相寇准力排众议，坚持请宋真宗亲征。

steps.text: Winter 1004: the Liao commander Xiao Talin is killed by a crossbow bolt before Chanzhou. Zhenzong then crosses the river to the north city, and Song morale soars.
steps.text_zh: 1004年冬，辽军主将萧挞凛在澶州城下中弩身亡。宋真宗随后渡河登上澶州北城，宋军士气大振。

steps.text: Early 1005: the treaty is sealed. Song pays Liao 100,000 taels of silver and 200,000 bolts of silk a year, and the two rulers call each other brothers. Peace lasts over a century.
steps.text_zh: 1005年初，双方订立盟约：宋每年给辽银十万两、绢二十万匹，两国约为兄弟。此后宋辽维持了一百多年的和平。

steps.text: 1038: the Tangut leader Li Yuanhao declares himself emperor at Xingqing (Yinchuan). His state is known as Western Xia, and war with Song soon follows.
steps.text_zh: 1038年，党项首领李元昊在兴庆府称帝，国号大夏，史称西夏，宋夏战争随即爆发。

steps.text: 1040: Xia defeats a Song army at Sanchuankou near Yan'an. Fan Zhongyan is sent to Shaanxi, where he builds forts and switches to defence.
steps.text_zh: 1040年，西夏在三川口（今陕西延安附近）大败宋军。范仲淹随后赴陕西主持防务，修筑堡寨，转为坚守。

steps.text: 1041: Li Yuanhao lures a Song army into an ambush in the Haoshui valley. The general Ren Fu is killed and his force is destroyed.
steps.text_zh: 1041年，李元昊在好水川设下埋伏，宋将任福率领的宋军陷入包围，任福战死，宋军损失惨重。

steps.text: 1044: Song and Xia make peace. Yuanhao accepts the title of vassal, and Song sends yearly gifts of silver, silk and tea. Song has now bought peace on both frontiers.
steps.text_zh: 1044年，宋夏议和：元昊向宋称臣，宋每年“赐”给西夏银、绢、茶。北宋以财物换取了西北和北方的和平。

title: Su Dongpo's road of exile
summary: The great poet's career took him from Sichuan to the capital and then ever further south, to the island of Hainan.
summary_zh: 从四川眉山到京城，再一贬再贬直到海南，苏轼走遍半个中国，把每一处贬所都写进了诗文。

steps.text: 1037: Su Shi is born in Meishan, Sichuan. In 1056 his father Su Xun takes him and his younger brother Su Zhe down the river and over the mountains to the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1037年，苏轼生于眉州眉山（今四川眉山）。1056年，父亲苏洵带着他和弟弟苏辙出川，前往京城开封应考。

steps.text: 1057: both brothers pass the palace examination in Kaifeng. The examiner Ouyang Xiu is so struck by Su Shi's essay that he predicts the young man will outshine him.
steps.text_zh: 1057年，苏轼、苏辙兄弟同榜考中进士。主考官欧阳修读了苏轼的文章大为赞赏，说自己应当让此人出人头地。

steps.text: 1076: opposed to Wang Anshi's reforms, Su had asked for posts away from the capital: Hangzhou in 1071, then Mizhou in Shandong. Here at Mid-Autumn he writes his famous lyric to the moon for his brother.
steps.text_zh: 1076年，因反对新法自请外任的苏轼已先后任杭州通判、密州知州。这年中秋，他在密州写下《水调歌头·明月几时有》，怀念弟弟苏辙。

steps.text: 1079: after governing Xuzhou, Su moves to Huzhou. Three months later censors arrest him for poems mocking the reforms and take him to their prison in Kaifeng: the Crow Terrace case.
steps.text_zh: 1079年，苏轼在徐州任满后调任湖州，到任仅三个月，就被御史指控在诗文中讥讽新法，押解到开封御史台关押，史称乌台诗案，险些丧命。

steps.text: 1082: exiled to Huangzhou as a minor militia official, he farms a plot on the eastern slope, calls himself Dongpo, and writes the two Red Cliff prose-poems after boating on the Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 1082年，苏轼贬居黄州已近三年，在城东坡地开荒种田，自号东坡居士。他泛舟赤壁，写下前后《赤壁赋》和《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》。
