steps.text: 1089: back in favour, he returns to Hangzhou as governor. He dredges the silting West Lake and uses the mud to build a long causeway, still called the Su Causeway.
steps.text_zh: 1089年，旧党执政，苏轼以知州身份重回杭州。西湖淤塞严重，他组织疏浚，用挖出的淤泥和葑草筑成一道长堤，就是今天的苏堤。

steps.text: 1094: Emperor Zhezong restores the reformers, and Su, now nearly sixty, is banished across the mountains to Huizhou in Guangdong, where he helps build bridges and praises the lychees.
steps.text_zh: 1094年，宋哲宗亲政，重新起用新党，年近六十的苏轼被贬到岭南惠州。他在这里资助修桥，还写下“日啖荔枝三百颗”的诗句。

steps.text: 1097: he is sent further still, to Danzhou on Hainan island, then the edge of the Song world. He lives in a thatched hut and teaches local students.
steps.text_zh: 1097年，六十二岁的苏轼再被贬到海南儋州，这在当时几乎是流放的尽头。他住在简陋的茅屋里，与当地黎族、汉族百姓往来，并办学讲学，培养了不少学生。

steps.text: 1101: pardoned by the new emperor Huizong, Su travels north again, but falls ill on the way and dies at Changzhou. He left work at the summit of Song poetry, lyrics, prose, calligraphy and painting.
steps.text_zh: 1101年，宋徽宗即位后大赦，苏轼得以北归，但在途中染病，七月在常州去世。他留下的诗、词、文、书、画，几乎在每个领域都是宋代的高峰。

title: Wang Anshi's New Policies
summary: A county magistrate's ideas become the boldest reform of the Song, and split the court for half a century.
summary_zh: 从县令的地方试验到全国变法，王安石的新法让北宋朝廷分裂成新旧两党，争斗延续数十年。

steps.text: 1047: Wang Anshi becomes magistrate of Yin county (Ningbo). He repairs dykes and ponds and lends the county's grain to farmers in spring, to be repaid with interest after harvest.
steps.text_zh: 1047年，王安石出任鄞县（今宁波）知县，修筑堤堰、疏浚陂塘，又把官仓存粮在春荒时借给农民，秋后加息归还，这是后来青苗法的雏形。

steps.text: 1058: in Kaifeng he sends Emperor Renzong a memorial of some ten thousand characters, arguing that the laws must change and able officials be trained. The emperor files it away.
steps.text_zh: 1058年，王安石在开封向宋仁宗呈上《言事书》，长达万言，主张改革法度、培养人才，以解决国家积贫积弱的困境，但仁宗没有采纳。

steps.text: 1069: the young Emperor Shenzong makes Wang deputy chief minister and sets up a new Finance Planning Commission. The first laws follow, including the Green Sprouts loans: cheap state credit to farmers in spring.
steps.text_zh: 1069年，二十出头的宋神宗任命王安石为参知政事，设立制置三司条例司主持变法，相继推出均输法和青苗法：青黄不接时由官府放贷，收成后取息二分。

steps.text: 1070 to 1072: more laws follow. Villages are grouped into militia units, labour service is replaced by a cash tax, a State Trade Bureau buys unsold goods in Kaifeng, and land is resurveyed for fairer tax.
steps.text_zh: 1070至1072年，新法接连推出：保甲法把农户编为保甲，农闲练兵；募役法让民户出钱代替服役；市易法在开封设市易务收购滞销货物；方田均税法清丈田亩，按土质定税。

steps.text: 1072: Wang Shao, backed by Wang Anshi, takes the Tao and Huang river valleys from Tibetan chiefs and founds the Xihe circuit, outflanking the Western Xia from the southwest.
steps.text_zh: 1072年，在王安石支持下，王韶率军经营河湟，收复熙州、河州等地，设立熙河路。这是北宋少有的开疆拓土，目的是从侧翼牵制西夏。

steps.text: 1074: after a long drought, the gatekeeper Zheng Xia sends the emperor a painting of starving refugees. The dowager empresses also attack the reforms, and Wang Anshi resigns to govern Jiangning.
steps.text_zh: 1074年，北方大旱，看守京城城门的小官郑侠绘成《流民图》献给神宗，曹太后、高太后也哭诉新法扰民。王安石被迫罢相，出知江宁府。

steps.text: 1076: recalled in 1075, Wang falls out with colleagues and loses his son, then retires for good to Jiangning (Nanjing). Shenzong runs the reforms himself and in the 1080s rebuilds the bureaucracy.
steps.text_zh: 1076年，次年复相的王安石与同僚失和，又遭丧子之痛，再次罢相，从此退居江宁。神宗亲自主持新法，并在元丰年间改革官制，史称元丰改制。

steps.text: 1084: in Luoyang, the leading critic Sima Guang finishes the Comprehensive Mirror, a chronicle of 1,362 years. The work took nineteen years, fifteen of them spent in Luoyang away from the reformist court.
steps.text_zh: 1084年，因反对新法退居洛阳十五年的司马光完成《资治通鉴》。全书二百九十四卷，记载战国至五代一千三百六十二年的历史，前后编修十九年。

steps.text: 1086: with Shenzong dead and the boy Zhezong on the throne, the regent Dowager Gao makes Sima Guang chief minister. He abolishes the new laws; both he and Wang Anshi die the same year.
steps.text_zh: 1086年，神宗已死，高太后临朝，起用司马光为相，尽废新法，史称元祐更化。同年王安石、司马光相继去世，新旧党争却愈演愈烈，直到北宋末年。

title: The Jingkang disaster
summary: Song allies with the rising Jurchen to destroy the Liao, and within two years the Jurchen take Kaifeng and carry off two emperors.
summary_zh: 北宋联金灭辽，不料引狼入室，金兵两度南下攻破开封，徽、钦二帝被掳北去。

steps.text: 1115: the Jurchen chief Wanyan Aguda proclaims the Jin dynasty and, the same year, routes the army led by the Liao emperor himself at Hubudagang.
steps.text_zh: 1115年，女真首领完颜阿骨打称帝，国号金，同年在护步达冈大败辽天祚帝亲率的大军。

steps.text: 1120: Song envoys cross the sea from Dengzhou and agree with Jin to attack Liao together: Jin takes the Liao Central Capital, Song takes Yanjing, and Song's yearly payments go to Jin.
steps.text_zh: 1120年，宋使从登州渡海与金结盟，约定夹攻辽朝：金取辽中京，宋取燕京，宋把原给辽的岁币转给金。

steps.text: 1122: Song armies twice fail to take Yanjing from the remnant Liao; Jin troops take it instead. Song then pays Jin to hand over a city stripped of its people.
steps.text_zh: 1122年，宋军两次攻打燕京，都被残余的辽军打败，燕京最终由金军攻下。宋随后花钱从金人手中赎回一座空城。

steps.text: 1125: the Liao emperor is captured near Yingzhou and Liao is finished. That winter Jin, accusing Song of sheltering a Jin defector, invades in two columns.
steps.text_zh: 1125年，辽天祚帝在应州一带被金军俘获，辽朝灭亡。同年冬，金以宋收纳辽朝降将为借口，分两路南侵。

steps.text: End of 1125: as the Jin armies approach, Emperor Huizong hastily abdicates in favour of his son Zhao Huan, Emperor Qinzong.
steps.text_zh: 1125年底，金军逼近，宋徽宗仓皇传位给太子赵桓，是为宋钦宗。

steps.text: Early 1126: the eastern Jin army besieges Kaifeng, defended by Li Gang. Song promises to cede three northern prefectures and pay huge sums of gold and silver, and Jin withdraws.
steps.text_zh: 1126年初，金东路军包围开封，李纲主持守城。宋答应割让太原、中山、河间三镇并交纳大量金银，金军暂时退去。

steps.text: Autumn 1126: Taiyuan falls after a siege of more than 250 days. Both Jin armies march south again and meet before Kaifeng.
steps.text_zh: 1126年秋，被围二百五十多天的太原失陷。金军两路随即再次南下，会师开封城下。

steps.text: 1127: Kaifeng having fallen at the end of 1126, Jin deposes both emperors, installs Zhang Bangchang as a puppet and in spring marches north with the emperors, the court and thousands of captives.
steps.text_zh: 1127年，开封已于上年底城破，金废徽、钦二帝，立张邦昌为傀儡皇帝，四月押着二帝、后妃宗室和大批工匠北返。北宋灭亡。

steps.text: 1127: Prince Zhao Gou, who escaped capture, takes the throne at Yingtian (Shangqiu) as Emperor Gaozong, beginning the Southern Song. The two captive emperors never return.
steps.text_zh: 1127年五月，康王赵构在南京应天府（今商丘）即位，是为宋高宗，南宋开始。二帝被押往北方，再也没能回来。

title: Yue Fei's northern campaigns
summary: The Song court flees south, then its best general fights his way back toward Kaifeng, only to be recalled and killed for the sake of peace.
summary_zh: 宋室南渡后，岳飞屡败金军、北伐中原，却被十二道金牌召回，以莫须有的罪名被害。

steps.text: 1129: Jin armies cross the Yangtze. Emperor Gaozong flees from Yangzhou over the river, through Hangzhou and Mingzhou, and at one point takes refuge on ships at sea.
steps.text_zh: 1129年，金兵渡江南下，宋高宗从扬州仓皇逃过长江，经杭州、明州，一度逃到海上躲避追兵。

steps.text: 1130: as the Jin commander Wuzhu withdraws north, Han Shizhong's fleet traps him at Huangtiandang on the Yangtze for forty-eight days. The Jin army escapes only by digging a channel.
steps.text_zh: 1130年，金兀术北撤时，韩世忠以水军把他截在长江黄天荡四十八天，金军最后开挖河道才得以逃脱。

steps.text: 1130: Yue Fei attacks the retreating Jin army near Jiankang and retakes the city, the start of his career as an independent commander.
steps.text_zh: 1130年，岳飞在建康附近截击北撤的金军，收复建康，从此开始独当一面。

steps.text: 1134: Yue Fei recovers Xiangyang and five other prefectures from Qi, the Jin puppet state. It is the Southern Song's first successful offensive.
steps.text_zh: 1134年，岳飞从金扶植的伪齐手中收复襄阳等六郡，这是南宋第一次主动出击收复失地。

steps.text: 1140: Jin breaks the truce and invades. Yue Fei marches north and defeats Wuzhu's elite cavalry at Yancheng, then wins again at Yingchang.
steps.text_zh: 1140年，金军撕毁和约南侵。岳飞率军北伐，在郾城击败兀术亲率的精锐骑兵，随后又在颍昌取胜。

steps.text: 1140: according to the official Song history, Yue Fei's vanguard reaches Zhuxian Town, forty-five li from Kaifeng, while resistance bands across the north rise to join him.
steps.text_zh: 1140年，据《宋史》记载，岳家军前锋推进到距开封只有四十五里的朱仙镇，中原各地义军纷纷响应。

steps.text: 1140: bent on peace, Emperor Gaozong and Qin Hui send twelve urgent gold-lacquered orders recalling Yue Fei. He laments that ten years of effort are thrown away in a day.
steps.text_zh: 1140年，一心议和的宋高宗和秦桧接连发出十二道金字牌，催令岳飞班师。岳飞叹息“十年之力，废于一旦”。

steps.text: 1141: the Shaoxing treaty sets the border along the Huai River to Dasan Pass. Song declares itself a vassal and pays 250,000 taels of silver and 250,000 bolts of silk a year.
steps.text_zh: 1141年，宋金达成绍兴和议：以淮河至大散关为界，宋向金称臣，每年纳银、绢各二十五万。

steps.text: Early 1142: Yue Fei is put to death in the Lin'an prison on a charge his accusers could not even state. He is thirty-nine.
steps.text_zh: 1142年初，岳飞以“莫须有”的罪名被害于临安大理寺狱，年仅三十九岁。

title: Zhu Xi and the academies
summary: The philosopher who shaped Confucian thought for seven centuries, and the private academies where he taught.
summary_zh: 朱熹在福建、江西、湖南的书院中讲学著述，他的理学影响了此后七百年的中国。

steps.text: 1130: Zhu Xi is born at Youxi in Fujian, where his father, an official, had taken refuge from the wars in the north. After his father's death in 1143 he grows up at Wufu near the Wuyi mountains.
steps.text_zh: 1130年，朱熹生于福建尤溪，父亲朱松为避战乱寓居于此。朱熹十四岁丧父，随母迁居崇安五夫里（今武夷山市），在那里求学成长。

steps.text: 1160: after passing the jinshi exam young, Zhu walks to Yanping to become the student of Li Tong, heir to the teaching of the Cheng brothers, and turns away from Buddhism to Confucian learning.
steps.text_zh: 1160年，早已考中进士的朱熹步行到延平（今南平），正式拜程颐的三传弟子李侗为师，从此专心于儒学，奠定了理学的根基。

steps.text: 1167: Zhu travels to Changsha to debate with Zhang Shi at the Yuelu Academy. Their two months of discussion draw students from far and wide and make the academy famous.
steps.text_zh: 1167年，朱熹到长沙岳麓书院拜访主讲张栻，两人论学两个多月，四方学者纷纷前来听讲，史称“朱张会讲”，岳麓书院由此闻名天下。

steps.text: 1175: at Goose Lake Temple in Jiangxi, Lü Zuqian brings Zhu together with Lu Jiuyuan. Zhu stresses careful study of things; Lu says this is fragmented and urges finding the moral mind within.
steps.text_zh: 1175年，吕祖谦邀朱熹与陆九渊兄弟在铅山鹅湖寺论学。朱熹主张“格物致知”、读书穷理，陆九渊主张“发明本心”，讥朱学“支离”，双方不欢而散。

steps.text: 1179: as prefect of Nankang at the foot of Mount Lu, Zhu rebuilds the ruined White Deer Grotto Academy and writes its rules. Later he invites his rival Lu Jiuyuan to lecture there.
steps.text_zh: 1179年，朱熹任南康军知军，在庐山脚下重建荒废的白鹿洞书院，亲订《白鹿洞书院揭示》作为学规，后来还请论敌陆九渊来书院讲学。

steps.text: 1183: Zhu builds his own academy, the Wuyi Retreat, beside a stream in the Wuyi mountains. For years he teaches and writes here, drawing students from across the south.
steps.text_zh: 1183年，朱熹在武夷山九曲溪畔建起武夷精舍，在此讲学著述多年，四方学子纷纷前来，武夷山成为理学重镇。

steps.text: 1190: as prefect of Zhangzhou he prints his commentaries on the Four Books. In the Yuan they become the basis of the civil service examinations, which they remain until 1905.
steps.text_zh: 1190年，朱熹任漳州知州，刊印《四书章句集注》。元代以后，这部书成为科举考试的标准教材，一直沿用到清末。

steps.text: 1196: after a short spell lecturing the emperor, Zhu is caught in a court feud. The minister Han Tuozhou bans his school as false learning and blacklists its followers.
steps.text_zh: 1196年，此前只在朝中做了四十多天侍讲的朱熹卷入政争。权臣韩侂胄斥理学为“伪学”，列出“伪学逆党籍”，朱熹被夺职，门人受到打压，史称庆元党禁。

steps.text: 1200: Zhu Xi dies at Kaoting in Jianyang, still under the ban, still revising his commentaries. Within a generation his teaching is honoured by the state.
steps.text_zh: 1200年，朱熹在建阳考亭病逝，临终前仍在修改著作。党禁不久解除，他的学说在南宋后期被朝廷尊为正统。

title: Genghis Khan and the Mongol rise
summary: How the Mongols united the steppe and within thirty years destroyed Western Xia and Jin and reached Central Asia.
summary_zh: 蒙古统一草原后，短短三十年内攻西夏、破金朝、征花剌子模，改变了亚洲的格局。

steps.text: 1206: at an assembly by the source of the Onon river, Temüjin, having united the Mongol and Turkic tribes of the steppe, is proclaimed Genghis Khan and reorganises his people into units of a thousand.
steps.text_zh: 1206年，统一蒙古草原各部的铁木真在斡难河源召开大会，被推举为成吉思汗，建立大蒙古国，把部众编为千户，全民皆兵。

steps.text: 1209: his first major campaign is against Western Xia. The Mongols besiege its capital Zhongxing (Yinchuan); the Xia king submits and gives a daughter in marriage.
steps.text_zh: 1209年，成吉思汗首先进攻西夏，包围都城中兴府（今银川）。西夏国王纳女求和，表示臣服，蒙古从此解除了南侵金朝的侧翼威胁。

steps.text: 1211: invading Jin, the Mongols crush a much larger Jin army at Yehuling, the Wild Fox Ridge north of Zhangjiakou, and break through into the plains north of the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1211年，成吉思汗南下攻金，在野狐岭（今张家口北）大败数量远多于己的金军精锐，金军主力损失殆尽，蒙古骑兵长驱直入华北。

steps.text: 1215: the Jin court has fled south to Kaifeng. Zhongdu, its northern capital at Beijing, falls after a long siege, and much of the city burns.
steps.text_zh: 1215年，金宣宗已于上年南迁汴京，蒙古军攻陷金中都（今北京），宫室多被焚毁。金朝从此失去黄河以北的大片土地。

steps.text: 1219: after the governor of Otrar massacres a Mongol trade caravan and the Khwarazm shah kills his envoys, Genghis marches west. Otrar falls after a long siege.
steps.text_zh: 1219年，因花剌子模讹答剌城的守将杀害蒙古商队、国王又杀了蒙古使者，成吉思汗亲率大军西征，首先围攻讹答剌城，数月后破城。

steps.text: 1220: Bukhara and then Samarkand, the great Silk Road cities of Transoxiana, fall to the Mongols. Shah Muhammad flees and dies on an island in the Caspian.
steps.text_zh: 1220年，蒙古军攻下布哈拉和花剌子模新都撒马尔罕，这些丝路名城遭到严重破坏。花剌子模国王摩诃末一路逃亡，死于里海的小岛上。

steps.text: 1222: the Daoist master Qiu Chuji, summoned from Shandong, crosses Central Asia to meet Genghis in the Hindu Kush and urges him to value life and limit killing.
steps.text_zh: 1222年，应召西行的全真道长丘处机在兴都库什山北的行营见到成吉思汗，劝他“敬天爱民”“清心寡欲”，减少杀戮。弟子把西行经历写成《长春真人西游记》。

steps.text: 1227: back in the east to punish Western Xia, Genghis Khan dies near the Liupan mountains. The Xia capital surrenders soon after and the Tangut state is wiped out.
steps.text_zh: 1227年，成吉思汗在征讨西夏途中病逝于六盘山一带，西夏都城随即投降，立国近两百年的西夏灭亡。

steps.text: 1234: under his son Ögedei, Mongol and Song armies besiege the last Jin emperor at Caizhou. He hangs himself and the Jin dynasty ends; the Mongols and Song now face each other.
steps.text_zh: 1234年，成吉思汗之子窝阔台在位时，蒙古与南宋联军攻破蔡州，金哀宗自缢，金朝灭亡。蒙古与南宋随即正面相对，战争又持续了四十多年。

title: Wen Tianxiang
summary: The top scholar who raised an army for a dying dynasty, fought on after its fall, and chose death over service to Kublai.
summary_zh: 从状元到抗元统帅，文天祥在南宋覆亡之际奔走抗争，最终在大都从容就义。

steps.text: 1236: Wen Tianxiang is born at Luling in Jizhou (Ji'an, Jiangxi). As a boy he admires the portraits of local worthies in the school shrine and resolves to join them.
steps.text_zh: 1236年，文天祥生于吉州庐陵（今江西吉安）。少年时在学宫看到欧阳修等乡贤的画像，立志将来也要名列其中。

steps.text: 1256: at twenty he takes first place in the palace examination in Lin'an. Emperor Lizong personally ranks his essay top of the list. Outspoken against powerful ministers, he is later dismissed more than once.
steps.text_zh: 1256年，二十岁的文天祥在临安参加殿试，对策万言，被宋理宗亲自擢为状元。此后他多次因直言触怒权臣而被罢官。

steps.text: 1275: as Mongol armies sweep down the Yangzi, Wen, governor of Ganzhou, answers the call to defend the throne. He spends his family fortune raising some ten thousand volunteers and marches to the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1275年，元军沿长江东下，朝廷下诏各地勤王。时任赣州知州的文天祥捐出家财，招募义军万余人，率军赶赴临安。

steps.text: 1276: with Lin'an about to surrender, he is sent as envoy to the Mongol commander Bayan at Gaoting Hill. He argues defiantly and is detained, while the court gives up.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，临安即将投降，文天祥以右丞相身份出使皋亭山元营，与元军统帅伯颜当面抗辩，被扣留。不久南宋朝廷开城投降。

steps.text: 1276: taken north under guard, he escapes at Zhenjiang with a few companions, slips past Mongol patrols and sails down the coast to join the loyalists in Fujian. He records it all in his Compass poems.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，文天祥被押解北上，在镇江夜里设法逃脱，历经艰险，从海路南下，到福建投奔新立的流亡朝廷。这段经历被他写成诗集《指南录》。

steps.text: 1277: he leads a counter-attack from Fujian into southern Jiangxi and recovers several counties, but is routed at Kongkeng. His wife and children are captured.
steps.text_zh: 1277年，文天祥从福建进军江西，一度收复赣南多个州县，各地纷纷响应。但在空坑被元军击败，妻子儿女被俘，他只身逃脱。

steps.text: 1278: retreating along the Guangdong coast, he is surprised by Mongol troops at Wupoling near Haifeng while his men are eating. He tries to poison himself but survives and is captured.
steps.text_zh: 1278年冬，文天祥率残部转战广东，在海丰五坡岭吃饭时被元军突袭俘虏。他吞下冰片想要自尽，却没有死成。

steps.text: 1279: carried by ship past Lingdingyang in the Pearl River estuary, he writes his poem asking only to leave a loyal heart in history. Days later he watches the Song fleet destroyed at Yamen.
steps.text_zh: 1279年，元军押着文天祥经过珠江口的零丁洋，他写下《过零丁洋》：“人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青。”随后他目睹了宋军在崖山覆灭。

steps.text: 1283: after more than three years in a Dadu prison, where he writes the Song of the Righteous Spirit, he refuses Kublai's offer of office and is executed at the Chaishi market, aged forty-seven.
steps.text_zh: 1283年初，在大都狱中被囚三年多、写下《正气歌》的文天祥，拒绝了忽必烈的劝降，在柴市从容就义，终年四十七岁。

title: The Mongol conquest of Song
summary: Twenty years of war on the Yangtze, from the death of a khan at Diaoyu to the last Song fleet at Yamen.
summary_zh: 从钓鱼城下蒙哥战死，到襄阳六年围城，再到崖山海战，南宋在二十年间走向灭亡。

steps.text: 1259: the Great Khan Mongke besieges Diaoyu Fortress near Hezhou in person. Wang Jian holds out for months, Mongke dies before the walls, and the Mongol armies pull back.
steps.text_zh: 1259年，蒙古大汗蒙哥亲率大军攻打合州钓鱼城，守将王坚坚守数月，蒙哥死于城下，各路蒙古军北撤。

steps.text: 1259: Kublai, besieging Ezhou on the Yangtze, hears of Mongke's death, agrees to a truce with the Song minister Jia Sidao and hurries north to claim the throne.
steps.text_zh: 1259年，忽必烈正在围攻鄂州，得知蒙哥死讯后与贾似道议和北返，回去争夺汗位。

steps.text: 1260: Kublai is proclaimed Great Khan at Kaiping and spends the next years fighting his brother Ariq Boke. The Song gains a breathing space.
steps.text_zh: 1260年，忽必烈在开平即大汗位，此后数年忙于与弟弟阿里不哥争位，南宋得到短暂喘息。

steps.text: 1268: on the advice of the Song defector Liu Zheng, the Mongols besiege Xiangyang and Fancheng and build a navy to cut off relief along the Han River.
steps.text_zh: 1268年，蒙古军采纳宋朝降将刘整的建议，围攻襄阳、樊城，同时训练水军，切断汉水上的援路。

steps.text: 1273: using counterweight trebuchets, Yuan troops take Fancheng; Lü Wenhuan then surrenders Xiangyang after nearly six years. The way down the Yangtze is open.
steps.text_zh: 1273年，元军用回回炮先攻破樊城，坚守近六年的襄阳守将吕文焕投降，长江中游门户洞开。

steps.text: 1275: Bayan leads the Yuan army down the Yangtze. Jia Sidao's army of some 130,000 collapses at Dingjiazhou, and the Song loses its last field army.
steps.text_zh: 1275年，伯颜率元军顺江东下，贾似道率领的十三万宋军在丁家洲大败，南宋主力丧失殆尽。

steps.text: 1276: the Yuan army reaches Lin'an. Empress Dowager Xie surrenders with the child emperor Gong, and the court is taken north.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，元军兵临临安，谢太后带着年幼的宋恭帝出城投降，南宋朝廷被押往北方。

steps.text: 1276: Lu Xiufei and Zhang Shijie enthrone another young prince, Zhao Shi, at Fuzhou. The exiled Song court then moves south along the coast.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，陆秀夫、张世杰等在福州拥立益王赵昰为帝，南宋流亡朝廷此后沿海一路南迁。

steps.text: 1279: at Yamen the Yuan fleet destroys the last Song ships. Lu Xiufu leaps into the sea carrying the boy emperor Zhao Bing, and the Song dynasty ends.
steps.text_zh: 1279年，元军在崖山海战中击溃最后的宋军船队，陆秀夫背着幼帝赵昺投海，南宋灭亡。

title: Kublai Khan's empire
summary: Kublai wins the khanship, builds Dadu, names the Yuan dynasty and sends fleets overseas, while canals and sea routes feed his new capital.
summary_zh: 忽必烈夺得汗位，营建大都，定国号大元，屡次渡海远征，又开海运、凿运河，供养新都。

steps.text: 1260: Kublai is acclaimed Great Khan at Kaiping and adopts a Chinese-style reign name. Advised by Liu Bingzhong and other Chinese scholars, he governs north China with Chinese institutions.
steps.text_zh: 1260年，忽必烈在开平即大汗位，建年号“中统”。他重用刘秉忠等汉人谋士，采用汉地制度治理中原。

steps.text: 1260: his younger brother Ariq Boke is also proclaimed khan at Karakorum. After four years of war, cut off from Chinese grain, Ariq Boke surrenders in 1264, and the Mongol empire splits for good.
steps.text_zh: 1260年，留守草原的弟弟阿里不哥也在和林称汗。兄弟交战四年，阿里不哥因缺粮于1264年投降，蒙古帝国从此分裂。

steps.text: 1267: Liu Bingzhong lays out a new city northeast of the old Jin capital. Dadu has square walls, palaces at the centre and a grid of streets, the plan of later Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1267年，忽必烈命刘秉忠在金中都东北另筑新城，即大都。城墙方正，宫城居中，街道整齐，奠定了后来北京城的格局。

steps.text: 1271: Kublai takes the dynastic name Great Yuan, from a phrase in the Book of Changes. The next year Dadu becomes the capital and Kaiping, renamed Shangdu, the summer residence.
steps.text_zh: 1271年，忽必烈取《易经》“大哉乾元”之意，定国号为“大元”。次年大都定为首都，开平改称上都，作为夏都。

steps.text: 1274: a Yuan and Korean force crosses the sea and lands at Hakata Bay in Japan. After hard fighting with samurai it returns to the ships, and a storm wrecks much of the fleet.
steps.text_zh: 1274年，元朝与高丽联军渡海在日本博多湾登陆，与日本武士激战后退回船上，夜间遭遇风暴，损失惨重而还。

steps.text: 1281: a second invasion sails from Korea and from Qingyuan (Ningbo), more than 100,000 men in all. A typhoon sinks most of the ships and the expedition collapses.
steps.text_zh: 1281年，元军再征日本，东路军从高丽、江南军从庆元（今宁波）出发，共十余万人。台风袭来，舰船大半沉没，远征彻底失败。

steps.text: 1288: on the third campaign against Dai Viet, Tran Hung Dao plants stakes in the Bach Dang river and traps the Yuan fleet at low tide. A 1293 expedition to Java also returns with nothing.
steps.text_zh: 1288年，元军第三次征安南，陈兴道在白藤江底插下木桩，趁退潮围歼元朝水师。1293年远征爪哇的元军也无功而返。

steps.text: 1289: the Huitong canal opens in Shandong, letting grain barges run north. Earlier Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan had opened a sea route from the Yangzi mouth to Zhigu, which carried most of Dadu's grain.
steps.text_zh: 1289年，会通河在山东开通，南方漕船可沿运河直达北方。此前朱清、张瑄已开辟从长江口到直沽的海运，大都的粮食主要靠海路运来。

steps.text: 1294: Kublai dies at Dadu. His grandson Temur stops the wars against Japan and Dai Viet. The capital and north-south supply lines Kublai built would serve the Ming and Qing as well.
steps.text_zh: 1294年，忽必烈在大都去世，孙子铁穆耳即位为元成宗，停止对日本和安南用兵。他留下的大都和南北运输线，此后为明清两代沿用。

title: Guo Shoujing, astronomer and engineer
summary: A water engineer from Xingtai measures the sky across the empire, writes the most accurate calendar of its age and brings boats into Dadu.
summary_zh: 邢台人郭守敬治水、观天，主持全国天文测量，编成《授时历》，又开通惠河让漕船直入大都。

steps.text: 1262: Guo Shoujing of Xingtai, a student of Liu Bingzhong, is introduced to Kublai and presents six proposals for water works. He is put in charge of canals and rivers.
steps.text_zh: 1262年，邢台人郭守敬经张文谦推荐面见忽必烈，提出六条水利建议，此后奉命主管各地河渠。他早年随刘秉忠学习天文、算学和水利。

steps.text: 1264: sent to the old Western Xia lands, Guo restores the ancient Tanglai and Hanyan canals on the Ningxia plain, bringing large stretches of abandoned farmland back under irrigation.
steps.text_zh: 1264年，郭守敬随张文谦到西夏故地，修复宁夏平原上的唐来渠、汉延渠等古渠，使大片荒废的农田重新得到灌溉。

steps.text: 1276: the court orders a new calendar. Guo and Wang Xun set up an office at Dadu, and Guo first builds better instruments, including the simplified armillary and a tall gnomon.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，元朝决定修订历法，郭守敬与王恂等人在大都设局。他先改造观测仪器，制成简仪、高表等十几种新仪器。

steps.text: 1279: Guo organises a survey of the realm with 27 observing stations, from the South China Sea to the far north in Siberia, measuring the pole's height and the sun's shadow at each.
steps.text_zh: 1279年，郭守敬主持“四海测验”，在全国设二十七处观测点，南到南海，北到北海（约在今西伯利亚），测量各地的北极高度和日影长短。

steps.text: 1279: at Gaocheng near Dengfeng, a central station gets a stone tower with a long measuring scale on the ground below, a giant gnomon for timing the solstices. It still stands.
steps.text_zh: 1279年，河南登封告成镇建起观星台，这是测量中心之一。高大的台身和地上的“量天尺”组成巨型圭表，用来测量冬至、夏至的日影。

steps.text: 1280: the Shoushi calendar is finished and issued the next year. Its year of 365.2425 days matches the Gregorian calendar adopted in Europe three centuries later, and it stays in use for over 300 years.
steps.text_zh: 1280年，《授时历》编成，次年颁行。它以365.2425天为一年，与三百年后欧洲的格里高利历相同，此后沿用了三百多年。

steps.text: 1292: Guo starts a new canal. He leads spring water from Baifu near Changping southwest into Wengshan lake (today's Kunming Lake) and on to Dadu, solving the canal's lack of water.
steps.text_zh: 1292年，郭守敬主持开凿新河。他把昌平白浮泉等泉水引向西南，汇入瓮山泊（今昆明湖），再引入大都，解决了运河水源不足的难题。

steps.text: 1293: the canal opens from Tongzhou to Jishuitan lake inside Dadu. Seeing the lake crowded with boats, Kublai names it the Tonghui river. Southern grain ships can now sail into the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1293年，新河完工，从通州到大都城内的积水潭全线通航。忽必烈看到湖上帆船云集，赐名“通惠河”，南方漕船从此直达都城。

title: Marco Polo in China
summary: The Venetian's book describes a journey from the Mongol summer capital to the great ports of the south; how much he saw himself is still debated.
summary_zh: 威尼斯人马可·波罗自述在元朝游历十七年，足迹从上都到泉州；其记载的真实性至今仍有争议。

steps.text: About 1274: according to his book, Marco Polo travelled east with his father and uncle along the Silk Road through Kashgar and Dunhuang to Ganzhou (Zhangye), where they stayed for a time.
steps.text_zh: 约1274年，据《马可·波罗游记》，他随父亲和叔父沿丝绸之路东来，经喀什、敦煌到达甘州（今张掖），并在那里停留过。

steps.text: 1275: by his own account, they reach Shangdu and are received by Kublai Khan. Scholars still debate many details of what the book says happened next.
steps.text_zh: 1275年，据他自述，他们来到上都朝见忽必烈。游记中关于这段经历的许多细节，至今在学者中仍有争议。

steps.text: About 1276: his book describes Dadu, which he calls Khanbaliq, as a square walled city with streets straight as a chessboard. Kublai wintered here and summered at Shangdu.
steps.text_zh: 1276年前后，据游记描述，大都（他称为汗八里）城墙方正，街道笔直如棋盘。忽必烈冬季住在大都，夏季前往上都。

steps.text: About 1280: he says Kublai sent him on missions to the southwest, through Sichuan to Karajang (Yunnan), and he records local customs such as using cowrie shells as money.
steps.text_zh: 约1280年，他自称受忽必烈派遣出使西南，经四川到达哈剌章（云南），记载了当地用贝壳作货币等风俗。

steps.text: About 1282: the book says he held office in Yangzhou for three years. No Chinese record mentions him, and this is one of the most doubted parts of his story.
steps.text_zh: 约1282年，游记说他曾在扬州任职三年，但中文史料中找不到相关记载，这是他的经历受到质疑最多的地方之一。

steps.text: About 1285: he calls Hangzhou, the old Song capital, Quinsai (from Xingzai), describing it as the finest and noblest city in the world, with its great lake, countless bridges and busy markets.
steps.text_zh: 约1285年，他把南宋旧都杭州称为“行在”，形容它是世界上最美丽华贵的城市，城中有大湖、无数石桥和繁忙的市场。

steps.text: About 1291: he sails home from Zaiton (Quanzhou) with the fleet escorting the princess Kokochin to the Ilkhanate in Persia. He calls Zaiton one of the greatest ports in the world.
steps.text_zh: 1291年前后，他随护送阔阔真公主远嫁伊利汗国的船队从刺桐（今泉州）出海西归。他称刺桐是世界上最大的港口之一。

title: The fall of the Yuan
summary: A Yellow River flood and the labour gangs sent to fix it set off the Red Turban rising, and a former monk outlasts every rival.
summary_zh: 黄河决口与治河引发红巾军起义，群雄并起，朱元璋先后击败陈友谅、张士诚，北伐攻克大都。

steps.text: 1344: the Yellow River breaks its dikes at Baimao. Large parts of Shandong and Henan are flooded for years, and the canal and coastal salt works are badly damaged.
steps.text_zh: 1344年，黄河在白茅堤决口，山东、河南大片土地泛滥数年，运河和沿海盐场也受到严重破坏。

steps.text: 1351: Jia Lu puts 150,000 labourers and 20,000 soldiers to work on the river. Rebels bury a one-eyed stone man in the riverbed, with a rhyme that its discovery will set the realm in revolt.
steps.text_zh: 1351年，贾鲁征发民夫十五万、兵士两万治河。韩山童、刘福通暗中在河道埋下独眼石人，散布“石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反”。

steps.text: 1351: Liu Futong rises at Yingzhou; his men wear red turbans. Xu Shouhui and others follow in the south, and Yuan control crumbles fast.
steps.text_zh: 1351年，刘福通在颍州起事，以红巾为号，称为红巾军。南方的徐寿辉等也相继起兵，元朝统治迅速瓦解。

steps.text: 1354: the salt trader Zhang Shicheng, who rebelled the year before, holds Gaoyou. The chancellor Toghto besieges it with a huge army, but is dismissed by the court on the eve of victory and his army melts away.
steps.text_zh: 1354年，上一年在泰州起兵的盐贩张士诚，占据高邮。丞相脱脱率大军围攻高邮，即将破城时却被朝廷罢免，元军随之溃散。

steps.text: 1356: Zhu Yuanzhang, once an officer under Guo Zixing, takes Jiqing and renames it Yingtian (Nanjing), his new base. The same year Zhang Shicheng takes Pingjiang (Suzhou).
steps.text_zh: 1356年，郭子兴部将出身的朱元璋攻下集庆，改名应天府（今南京），以此为根据地。同年张士诚占据平江（今苏州）。

steps.text: 1363: Chen Youliang besieges Hongdu with a fleet said to carry 600,000 men. Zhu Yuanzhang comes to its relief; after thirty-six days of battle on Lake Poyang, Chen is killed by an arrow.
steps.text_zh: 1363年，陈友谅率号称六十万大军围攻洪都，朱元璋来援，两军在鄱阳湖大战三十六天，陈友谅中箭身亡。

steps.text: 1367: Zhu's army takes Pingjiang after a ten-month siege; Zhang Shicheng is captured and kills himself. That year Xu Da and Chang Yuchun march north with 250,000 men.
steps.text_zh: 1367年，朱元璋军围困平江十个月后破城，张士诚被俘后自尽。同年，徐达、常遇春率二十五万大军北伐。

steps.text: Early 1368: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims himself emperor at Yingtian. His dynasty is the Ming and his reign is named Hongwu. That autumn his northern army closes on Dadu.
steps.text_zh: 1368年正月，朱元璋在应天称帝，国号大明，年号洪武。同年秋，北伐大军逼近大都。

steps.text: Autumn 1368: Xu Da's army enters Dadu. The last Yuan emperor has already fled north to Shangdu, and Mongol rule over China is over.
steps.text_zh: 1368年八月，徐达大军攻入大都，元顺帝已提前北逃上都，元朝在中原的统治结束。

title: The Hongwu emperor builds the Ming
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang drives out the Yuan, abolishes the chancellor, registers every household and field, and purges his own generals.
summary_zh: 朱元璋逐走元廷，废除丞相，清查户口田地，设卫所屯田，最后诛杀开国功臣。

steps.text: 1368: Zhu Yuanzhang, born a poor peasant, becomes emperor at Yingtian (Nanjing) and makes it his capital. He has refugees resettled on empty land and irrigation repaired after decades of war.
steps.text_zh: 1368年，朱元璋在应天称帝，定都应天。出身贫苦农家的他下令招民垦荒、兴修水利，减轻战乱后百姓的负担。

steps.text: 1368: Xu Da takes Dadu and renames it Beiping. The Yuan emperor withdraws to the steppe, where the Northern Yuan lives on, and the northern frontier becomes the Ming's lasting worry.
steps.text_zh: 1368年，徐达攻入大都，改名北平府。元顺帝退回草原，北元仍在漠北与明朝对峙，北方边防成为明朝的长期难题。

steps.text: 1369: Zhu orders a grand Middle Capital built at his home town of Linhao (Fengyang). Work stops six years later as too costly, but its palace plan influenced the later Forbidden City.
steps.text_zh: 1369年，朱元璋下令在家乡临濠（今安徽凤阳）营建中都，城池宫殿规模宏大。六年后因劳民伤财而停工，后来的北京宫城多仿照它的布局。

steps.text: 1380: chancellor Hu Weiyong is executed for treason. Zhu abolishes the Secretariat and the post of chancellor, and the six ministries now report straight to the emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1380年，丞相胡惟庸以谋反罪被杀。朱元璋借此废除中书省和丞相，六部直接对皇帝负责，皇权空前集中。

steps.text: 1381: every household in the empire is entered in the Yellow Registers. From 1387 land is surveyed and drawn in fish-scale maps, so taxes and labour service can be traced to each family and field.
steps.text_zh: 1381年，朝廷在全国编造赋役黄册，登记每户人口和田产。1387年又丈量土地，绘成鱼鳞图册，赋税徭役从此有据可查。

steps.text: 1381: Fu Youde, Lan Yu and Mu Ying conquer Yunnan, and Mu Ying stays as its guardian. Across the empire hereditary soldier families man guard garrisons and farm their own land, Yunnan among the busiest.
steps.text_zh: 1381年，傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率军平定云南，沐英留镇。明朝在各地遍设卫所，军户世代当兵，平时屯田自给，云南就是军屯最多的地区之一。

steps.text: 1387: Feng Sheng leads a great army into Liaodong and at Jinshan forces the surrender of Naghachu, the Northern Yuan commander who had held the region for years. Liaodong becomes Ming land.
steps.text_zh: 1387年，冯胜率大军出征辽东，在金山迫使盘踞多年的北元太尉纳哈出投降，辽东从此归入明朝。

steps.text: 1388: Lan Yu crosses the desert and surprises the Northern Yuan court at Lake Buir, capturing many princes, officials and followers. The Northern Yuan never recovers.
steps.text_zh: 1388年，蓝玉率军穿越大漠奔袭捕鱼儿海，大破北元主力，俘获大批北元皇族、官员和部众，北元从此一蹶不振。

steps.text: 1393: Lan Yu is executed for treason and some 15,000 people die with him. Together with the Hu Weiyong purge, almost all the founding generals are gone, leaving the throne weak against the prince of Yan.
steps.text_zh: 1393年，蓝玉以谋反罪被杀，株连一万五千余人。加上胡惟庸案，开国功臣几乎被杀尽，为后来燕王起兵埋下隐患。

title: The Jingnan campaign
summary: The Prince of Yan rebels against his nephew, takes Nanjing and moves the capital north.
summary_zh: 燕王朱棣起兵夺取侄子的皇位，并把都城迁到北京。

steps.text: 1399: The Jianwen Emperor is stripping his uncles of their fiefs. Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, rises at Beiping, claiming to rescue the throne from evil ministers, and calls his revolt Jingnan, 'quelling the troubles'.
steps.text_zh: 1399年夏，建文帝推行削藩，燕王朱棣以诛杀齐泰、黄子澄、“清君侧”为名在北平起兵，称为“靖难”。

steps.text: Spring 1400: at the Baigou River south of Beiping, Yan cavalry rout the main imperial army under Li Jinglong, who flees south to Dezhou and then Jinan.
steps.text_zh: 1400年春，燕军在北平以南的白沟河大败李景隆率领的南军主力，李景隆一路溃退到德州、济南。

steps.text: 1400: Tie Xuan and Sheng Yong hold Jinan for about three months. Zhu Di cannot take the city and pulls back north, his first serious setback.
steps.text_zh: 1400年，铁铉、盛庸坚守济南约三个月，燕军屡攻不下，只得撤回北平，这是朱棣起兵后的第一次重大受挫。

steps.text: Winter 1400: Sheng Yong beats the Yan army at Dongchang and Zhu Di's leading general Zhang Yu is killed. For two years the war grinds on in Shandong and Hebei.
steps.text_zh: 1400年冬，盛庸在东昌大败燕军，燕军大将张玉战死。此后两年，双方在山东、河北一带反复拉锯。

steps.text: 1402: Zhu Di changes plan, bypasses the Shandong strongholds and drives straight south. In summer his army crosses the Yangtze at Guazhou and Zhenjiang surrenders.
steps.text_zh: 1402年，朱棣改变战略，绕开山东坚城直插南方。夏天燕军在瓜洲渡过长江，镇江守将开城投降。

steps.text: Summer 1402: Li Jinglong opens the Jinchuan Gate and Nanjing falls. The palace burns and the Jianwen Emperor disappears. Zhu Di takes the throne as the Yongle Emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1402年夏，李景隆打开金川门迎降，南京陷落，宫中起火，建文帝下落不明。朱棣登基，是为永乐帝。

steps.text: 1402: The scholar Fang Xiaoru refuses to draft Yongle's accession edict and is executed along with many relatives and followers, a purge that marks the new reign.
steps.text_zh: 1402年，大儒方孝孺拒绝为永乐帝起草即位诏书，被处死，亲族门生多受株连，新朝以血腥清洗开场。

steps.text: 1421: After years building Beijing and the Forbidden City, Yongle moves the capital to his old base. Nanjing becomes the secondary capital, and Beijing stays the seat of Ming and Qing.
steps.text_zh: 1421年，永乐帝营建北京和紫禁城多年后，正式迁都北京，南京改为留都。此后明清两朝都以北京为都城。

title: Zheng He's voyages
summary: Seven voyages of the largest fleet of its time, from the Yangtze to Arabia and East Africa.
summary_zh: 七下西洋，当时世界上最庞大的船队从长江口一直航行到阿拉伯半岛和东非。

steps.text: 1405: the eunuch admiral Zheng He sails from Liujiagang near the Yangtze mouth with over 200 ships and about 27,000 men, sent by the Yongle Emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1405年，宦官郑和奉永乐帝之命，率二百多艘船、两万七千余人，从长江口的刘家港出发。

steps.text: The fleet waits at Fujian for the northeast monsoon, then calls at Champa on the coast of today's Vietnam.
steps.text_zh: 船队在福建等候东北季风，然后南下，第一站是今越南中部的占城。

steps.text: Malacca becomes the fleet's main base: warehouses are built there, and ships gather to wait for the monsoon to turn.
steps.text_zh: 满剌加（马六甲）成为船队的中转基地，在此设立仓库，各分队在这里会合，等待季风转向。

steps.text: In Ceylon Zheng He leaves a stone tablet in Chinese, Tamil and Persian; on the third voyage he fights and captures a hostile local king.
steps.text_zh: 在锡兰（斯里兰卡）立下汉文、泰米尔文、波斯文三语石碑；第三次航行时与当地国王交战并将其俘获。

steps.text: Calicut on the Malabar coast, the great pepper port, is the goal of the first three voyages.
steps.text_zh: 印度西南岸的古里（卡利卡特）是胡椒贸易大港，前三次航行都以此为终点。

steps.text: From the fourth voyage on the fleet goes further, to Hormuz at the mouth of the Persian Gulf; detachments reach Aden, Mecca and the coast of East Africa, bringing back a giraffe.
steps.text_zh: 第四次起航程更远，到达波斯湾口的忽鲁谟斯；分队远至阿丹（亚丁）、天方（麦加）和东非沿岸，还带回了长颈鹿。

steps.text: 1433: on the way home from the seventh voyage Zheng He dies, probably near Calicut. The court ends the voyages and the records are later lost or destroyed.
steps.text_zh: 1433年，第七次下西洋返航途中，郑和在古里一带去世。此后明朝停止远航，相关档案也散失。

title: The Tumu crisis
summary: An emperor is captured by the Oirats, Beijing is saved, and he returns to take the throne back.
summary_zh: 明英宗被瓦剌俘虏，于谦保住北京，英宗后来又夺回皇位。

steps.text: 1449: The Oirat leader Esen, now master of the Mongolian steppe, quarrels with the Ming over tribute and trade and sends his armies against the frontier, the main thrust aimed at Datong.
steps.text_zh: 1449年，统一蒙古草原的瓦剌首领也先因朝贡赏赐与明朝交恶，分兵大举进犯边境，主力直扑大同。

steps.text: 1449: Urged on by the eunuch Wang Zhen, the young Emperor Yingzong decides to lead the army himself. A huge, hastily gathered force marches out of Beijing through Juyong Pass.
steps.text_zh: 1449年，在宦官王振怂恿下，年轻的明英宗不顾群臣劝阻决定御驾亲征，仓促集结的大军从北京出居庸关西进。

steps.text: 1449: The army reaches Datong, hears of defeats ahead and is short of supplies. Wang Zhen orders a retreat, and the slow, confused withdrawal gives the Oirats time to catch up.
steps.text_zh: 1449年，大军到达大同，得知前线连败、粮草不济，王振下令回师。撤退路线反复更改，行动迟缓，给了瓦剌追击的时间。

steps.text: 1449: Oirat cavalry trap the army at Tumu fort, short of water. The Ming force is destroyed, Wang Zhen is killed and the emperor himself is taken prisoner.
steps.text_zh: 1449年，瓦剌骑兵在土木堡追上缺水的明军，明军全军溃败，王振被杀，英宗本人被俘，朝野震动。

steps.text: 1449: Yu Qian rejects calls to flee south, puts the emperor's brother on the throne as the Jingtai Emperor, and beats Esen back outside Beijing's Deshengmen gate.
steps.text_zh: 1449年，于谦力排南迁之议，拥立英宗之弟为景泰帝，调集各地兵马，在德胜门外击退瓦剌，保住了北京。

steps.text: 1450: A captive emperor brings Esen no gains, so he lets Yingzong go. Back in Beijing the former emperor is kept under guard in the Southern Palace for seven years.
steps.text_zh: 1450年，也先挟持英宗却换不到好处，只得将他放还。回到北京的英宗被尊为太上皇，却被景泰帝软禁在南宫七年。

steps.text: 1457: As Jingtai lies ill, Shi Heng and Xu Youzhen lead troops into the palace and restore Yingzong. Yu Qian, the man who saved Beijing, is executed on false charges.
steps.text_zh: 1457年，景泰帝病重，石亨、徐有贞等人率兵闯入宫中，拥英宗复位，史称夺门之变。保卫北京的功臣于谦随即被冤杀。

title: Wang Yangming's road
summary: A philosopher who found the truth in his own mind while in exile, then crushed bandits and a princely rebellion.
summary_zh: 王阳明在贬谪中悟出“心即理”，又剿平南赣盗匪、平定宁王之乱，开创阳明心学。

steps.text: 1472: Wang Shouren, later called Wang Yangming, is born into an official family at Yuyao in Zhejiang. As a boy he says his goal is to become a sage, not just to pass the exams.
steps.text_zh: 1472年，王守仁出生在浙江余姚一个官宦人家，后人称他阳明先生。他少年时就立志要做“圣贤”，而不只是考取功名。

steps.text: About 1492: in his father's residence in the capital, he follows Zhu Xi's advice to investigate things and stares at bamboo for seven days. He learns nothing and falls ill, and begins to doubt the method.
steps.text_zh: 约1492年，在京师父亲官署中，他按朱熹“格物致知”的教导，对着竹子苦思七天，一无所得，反而病倒，开始怀疑向外求理的路子。

steps.text: 1508: beaten and exiled for opposing the eunuch Liu Jin, he serves as a post-station keeper at Longchang in Guizhou. There he realises that principle is not found in outside things but in one's own mind.
steps.text_zh: 1508年，因上疏得罪宦官刘瑾，他被廷杖后贬到贵州龙场驿。在蛮荒山中他忽然领悟：道理不必向外物去求，就在自己心中。

steps.text: 1510: after Liu Jin falls, Wang becomes magistrate of Luling in Jiangxi. In seven months he clears old lawsuits and cuts levies, putting his ideas to work in government.
steps.text_zh: 1510年，刘瑾倒台，王阳明出任江西庐陵知县。他在任七个月，清理积案、减轻摊派，开始把自己的学说用于治民。

steps.text: 1517: as governor based at Ganzhou, he wipes out bandit strongholds in the hills where Jiangxi, Fujian, Guangdong and Hunan meet, then organises villages into mutual-security groups and covenants.
steps.text_zh: 1517年，他以巡抚身份坐镇赣州，在赣、闽、粤、湘交界的山区剿平盘踞多年的盗匪，并推行十家牌法和乡约，安定地方。

steps.text: 1519: the Prince of Ning rebels at Nanchang and sails down the Yangzi to attack Anqing. Wang gathers troops at Ji'an and storms the half-empty Nanchang, cutting the rebels off from their base.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，宁王朱宸濠在南昌起兵，沿江东下进攻安庆。王阳明在吉安招集兵马，趁南昌空虚一举攻克，切断叛军后路。

steps.text: 1519: the prince turns back, and Wang meets his fleet on Poyang Lake, breaks it with fire ships and captures the prince. The rebellion is over in little more than a month.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，宁王回救南昌，王阳明在鄱阳湖畔与叛军决战，用火攻大败叛军，生擒宁王。从起兵到平定只用了一个多月。

steps.text: From 1522: back home in Shaoxing and Yuyao, Wang teaches crowds of students. He preaches extending one's innate knowledge and the unity of knowing and acting; his sayings are collected as the Chuanxi lu.
steps.text_zh: 1522年起，王阳明在绍兴、余姚家中讲学，四方弟子云集。他以“致良知”为宗旨，主张知行合一，弟子将他的言论编成《传习录》。

steps.text: Early 1529: returning from pacifying Si'en and Tianzhou in Guangxi, he dies on a boat at Nan'an in Jiangxi. His last words: "My mind is bright and clear. What more is there to say?"
steps.text_zh: 1529年初，他奉命平定广西思恩、田州之乱后北归，在江西南安舟中病逝。临终时留下遗言：“此心光明，亦复何言。”

title: Qi Jiguang and the pirates
summary: How a new kind of army ended the pirate raids on the southeast coast, then went north to the Great Wall.
summary_zh: 戚家军平定东南倭患，又北上镇守长城。

steps.text: 1548: Zhu Wan destroys the smugglers' port of Shuangyu off Zhoushan. But the sea ban stays strict, and Chinese and Japanese traders and pirates join forces in raids up and down the coast.
steps.text_zh: 1548年，朱纨捣毁舟山双屿港走私据点。但海禁愈加严厉，中日海商与海盗合流，嘉靖年间东南沿海倭患愈演愈烈。

steps.text: 1559: The governor-general Hu Zongxian lures the great sea merchant and pirate chief Wang Zhi ashore and has him executed in Hangzhou. The raids go on under other leaders.
steps.text_zh: 1559年，总督胡宗宪诱降海商兼海盗首领汪直，在杭州将其处死。但倭寇群龙无首，各股仍在浙闽沿海劫掠。

steps.text: 1559: Unhappy with the garrison troops, Qi Jiguang recruits miners and farmers in Yiwu and drills them hard. The Qi Family Army fights in small mixed teams called the mandarin duck formation.
steps.text_zh: 1559年，戚继光嫌卫所兵不堪用，在义乌招募矿工农民严加训练，组成“戚家军”，以长短兵器配合的鸳鸯阵作战。

steps.text: 1561: Pirates strike Taizhou in force. Qi's new army wins nine battles in a row and clears the whole prefecture, breaking the raiders' hold on Zhejiang.
steps.text_zh: 1561年，倭寇大举进犯浙江台州，戚家军转战各地，九战九捷，肃清台州之敌，浙江倭患基本平定。

steps.text: 1562: The raiders shift south to Fujian. Qi marches in and storms their island base at Hengyu near Ningde, crossing the mudflats at low tide.
steps.text_zh: 1562年，倭寇转而侵扰福建。戚继光率军入闽，趁退潮踏着滩涂攻破宁德附近的横屿倭巢。

steps.text: 1563: Pirates seize Pinghai garrison near Putian. Qi Jiguang, Yu Dayou and Liu Xian attack together and retake it, and the large pirate bands in Fujian are broken.
steps.text_zh: 1563年，倭寇攻占莆田附近的平海卫。戚继光与俞大猷、刘显合兵进攻，收复平海卫，福建倭患随之平息。

steps.text: 1567: With the raids over, the court relaxes the sea ban at Yuegang in Fujian and lets Chinese merchants sail abroad. Smuggling turns into legal trade.
steps.text_zh: 1567年，倭患平定后，朝廷在福建月港部分开放海禁，准许民间商船出海贸易，走私从此变为合法通商。

steps.text: 1568: Qi Jiguang is sent north to command the Jizhou frontier near Beijing. He trains troops and adds hollow brick watchtowers to the Great Wall, many of which still stand.
steps.text_zh: 1568年，戚继光北调总理蓟州等处练兵，镇守京师北门，在长城上加筑空心敌台，许多至今犹存。

title: Zhang Juzheng's reforms
summary: For ten years a grand secretary runs the empire for a boy emperor, fills the treasury and reforms taxes, then is disgraced after death.
summary_zh: 张居正辅佐少年万历帝十年，整顿吏治、清丈田亩、推行一条鞭法，死后却被抄家。

steps.text: 1572: the Longqing emperor dies and the ten-year-old Wanli emperor succeeds. Zhang Juzheng allies with the eunuch Feng Bao to oust Gao Gong and becomes senior grand secretary.
steps.text_zh: 1572年，隆庆帝去世，十岁的万历帝即位。张居正联合宦官冯保逐走首辅高拱，自任内阁首辅，开始主持朝政。

steps.text: 1573: Zhang introduces the evaluation law. Every office records its tasks with deadlines; the supervising secretaries check the ministries, and the Grand Secretariat checks them. Officials start getting things done.
steps.text_zh: 1573年，张居正推行考成法：各衙门把应办的事登记在册，按期检查完成情况，由六科监督六部，内阁再监督六科，官员办事效率大增。

steps.text: About 1574: Zhang firmly backs Qi Jiguang at Jizhou and Li Chengliang in Liaodong. With trade at border markets since the 1571 peace with Altan Khan, the northern frontier stays quiet for years.
steps.text_zh: 1574年前后，张居正执政，戚继光镇守蓟镇、李成梁镇守辽东，都得到他的全力支持。加上1571年俺答封贡后互市不断，北部边境多年安宁。

steps.text: 1578: Pan Jixun takes charge of the Yellow River and the Huai for the third time. He narrows the channel so the current scours out silt, and strengthens the Gaojia dike so the clear Huai flushes the Yellow River.
steps.text_zh: 1578年，潘季驯第三次主持治理黄河、淮河。他主张“束水攻沙”，加固高家堰，让清澈的淮水冲刷黄河泥沙，河道和漕运多年畅通。

steps.text: 1580: Zhang orders all farmland in the empire remeasured. Large areas hidden by powerful families are put back on the tax rolls, spreading the burden more fairly and raising state income.
steps.text_zh: 1580年，张居正下令在全国清丈田亩，查出大量被豪强隐瞒、未纳税的土地，赋税负担变得较为公平，国家收入明显增加。

steps.text: 1581: the Single Whip method goes nationwide. Land tax, labour service and miscellaneous levies are merged into one silver payment by acreage. Tried first in the Yangzi delta, it reflects the flood of silver.
steps.text_zh: 1581年，一条鞭法推行到全国：把田赋、徭役和各种杂税合并，折成白银按田亩征收。这一改革在江南等地早有试行，也反映了白银的大量流入。

steps.text: 1582: Zhang dies. The treasury is full and the state granaries are said to hold ten years of grain. But his heavy-handed rule had made many enemies, including the grown-up Wanli emperor.
steps.text_zh: 1582年，张居正病逝。此时国库充盈，太仓存粮据说可支用十年。但他生前专权，得罪了许多官员，也让长大的万历帝心怀不满。

steps.text: 1584: the emperor has Zhang's family estate at Jiangling in Hubei confiscated. His eldest son hangs himself and some relatives starve. Many of the reforms lapse, and Ming decline resumes.
steps.text_zh: 1584年，万历帝下令查抄张居正在湖北江陵的家，长子张敬修自缢，家人有人饿死。他的许多改革措施随之废弛，明朝重新走向衰落。

title: Wanli's three great campaigns
summary: In nine years the Ming crushes a mutiny in Ningxia, drives the Japanese out of Korea and destroys a rebel chieftain in Guizhou.
summary_zh: 九年之间，明朝平定宁夏哱拜之乱，援朝击退日本，又剿灭播州杨应龙，史称万历三大征。

steps.text: Spring 1592: the Mongol-born officer Pubei mutinies at Ningxia. After months of siege Li Rusong and others flood the city with Yellow River water and take it in the autumn.
steps.text_zh: 1592年春，蒙古降将哱拜在宁夏发动兵变。明军围城数月不下，李如松等引黄河水灌城，九月攻破宁夏城，叛乱平定。

steps.text: 1592: Toyotomi Hideyoshi's armies land at Busan. Within two months they take Seoul and Pyongyang, and the Korean king flees to Uiju on the Yalu and begs the Ming for help.
steps.text_zh: 1592年，日本丰臣秀吉派大军在朝鲜釜山登陆，两个月内攻陷汉城和平壤，朝鲜国王逃到义州，向明朝求援。

steps.text: January 1593: fresh from Ningxia, Li Rusong leads a Ming army into Korea and, with heavy cannon, retakes Pyongyang. The Japanese fall back south and most of northern Korea is freed.
steps.text_zh: 1593年正月，刚平定宁夏的李如松率明军入朝，用火炮猛攻，收复平壤。日军向南撤退，朝鲜北部随之恢复。

steps.text: 1593: pressing on with light cavalry, Li is ambushed at Byeokjegwan north of Seoul and pulls back. The war stalls and both sides turn to peace talks.
steps.text_zh: 1593年，李如松乘胜追击，轻骑冒进，在汉城以北的碧蹄馆遭日军伏击受挫。此后双方相持，转入议和。

steps.text: 1597: talks collapse and Japan invades again. The Ming sends more troops and at the end of the year besieges the Japanese fort at Ulsan, without success. The armies deadlock in the south.
steps.text_zh: 1597年，和谈破裂，日军再次大举进攻朝鲜。明朝增兵援朝，年底围攻日军据守的蔚山城，久攻不下，双方在朝鲜南部僵持。

steps.text: 1598: Hideyoshi dies and the Japanese withdraw. Chen Lin, Deng Zilong and Korea's Yi Sun-sin intercept their fleet at Noryang. Deng and Yi die in the battle that ends the seven-year war.
steps.text_zh: 1598年，丰臣秀吉病死，日军撤退。明将陈璘、邓子龙与朝鲜李舜臣在露梁海截击日军船队，邓子龙和李舜臣都战死，七年战争结束。

steps.text: 1599: Yang Yinglong, the hereditary chieftain of Bozhou (Zunyi in Guizhou), rebels and raids Sichuan, Guizhou and Huguang. The court gathers troops from many provinces.
steps.text_zh: 1599年，世袭播州（今贵州遵义）的土司杨应龙叛乱，攻掠四川、贵州、湖广各地。朝廷调集各省兵马准备进剿。

steps.text: 1600: Li Hualong's eight columns storm Hailongtun, Yang's mountaintop fortress, and Yang kills himself. Bozhou becomes two prefectures. The three campaigns are over, but the treasury is nearly empty.
steps.text_zh: 1600年，李化龙统率八路大军进剿，攻破杨应龙据守的山顶要塞海龙囤，杨应龙自杀。播州改设遵义、平越二府，三大征至此结束，国库也几乎耗尽。

title: Xu Xiake's travels
summary: A gentleman from Jiangyin spends thirty years walking China's mountains and rivers and writes it all down.
summary_zh: 江阴人徐霞客三十多年遍游名山大川，写下兼具文学和地理价值的《徐霞客游记》。

steps.text: 1607: Xu Hongzu of Jiangyin, known as Xu Xiake, turns his back on the exams and, encouraged by his mother, starts travelling, first around Lake Tai. He will spend thirty years on the road.
steps.text_zh: 1607年，江阴人徐弘祖（号霞客）不愿走科举之路，在母亲鼓励下开始出游，先到太湖一带。此后三十多年，他几乎走遍了大半个中国。

steps.text: 1613: he climbs Tiantai in Zhejiang and writes the diary that opens his travel records. China's national tourism day, 19 May, is set on the date that diary begins.
steps.text_zh: 1613年，他游览浙江天台山，写下《游天台山日记》，这是游记的开篇。今天的“中国旅游日”就定在这篇日记开头的日子，5月19日。

steps.text: 1616: he climbs Huangshan in the snow, and returns two years later to scale Tiandu and Lianhua peaks. The same year he visits the Wuyi mountains in Fujian and floats down the Nine Bend stream.
steps.text_zh: 1616年，他冒雪登上黄山，两年后又再次登山，攀上天都峰和莲花峰。同年他还游历福建武夷山，乘竹筏沿九曲溪而下。

steps.text: 1618: he explores Mount Lu in Jiangxi, climbing Wulao and Hanyang peaks and noting waterfalls, temples and paths in detail, before heading back to Huangshan.
steps.text_zh: 1618年，他游览江西庐山，攀登五老峰、汉阳峰，详细记下山中的瀑布、寺院和道路，然后再上黄山。

steps.text: 1623: he goes north to Songshan and Huashan, the central and western sacred peaks, then south to Wudang. He now pays attention to how ranges run and where rivers begin, not just the scenery.
steps.text_zh: 1623年，他北上游览中岳嵩山、西岳华山，又南下湖北武当山。他已不满足于观赏风景，开始留心山脉走向和河流源头。

steps.text: 1637: on his last and longest journey, begun the year before with the monk Jingwen, robbers attack their boat on the Xiang river in Hunan. They lose their money and Jingwen is hurt, but Xu goes on west.
steps.text_zh: 1636年，五十岁的徐霞客与静闻和尚踏上最后一次远游。次年在湖南湘江上遭遇强盗，财物被劫，静闻受伤，他仍坚持西行。

steps.text: 1637: around Guilin in Guangxi he explores the limestone caves one by one, measuring and describing them, among the earliest systematic studies of karst landscape anywhere.
steps.text_zh: 1637年，他在广西桂林一带考察石灰岩溶洞，逐个丈量记录七星岩等岩洞，是世界上最早系统考察喀斯特地貌的人之一。

steps.text: 1638: in Guizhou he reaches the Baishui river and describes the Huangguoshu falls as pearls pounded and jade shattered. The mountain roads are so hard that some days he covers only a few kilometres.
steps.text_zh: 1638年，他进入贵州，在白水河畔看到黄果树瀑布，记下“捣珠崩玉，飞沫反涌”的壮观景象。贵州山高路险，他常常一天只走十几里。

steps.text: 1639: he buries the ashes of Jingwen, who died on the road, on Jizu mountain in Yunnan and writes a gazetteer of it. Then his legs fail, and in 1640 the Lijiang prefect has him carried home.
steps.text_zh: 1639年，他把途中病故的静闻的骨灰送到云南鸡足山安葬，并为此山编写山志。不久他双足病重不能行走，1640年由丽江知府派人送回江阴。

title: The fall of the Ming
summary: Squeezed between the Manchus in the northeast and famine rebels in the northwest, the Ming collapses.
summary_zh: 东北后金崛起，西北饥民起义，明朝在内外夹击中覆亡。

steps.text: 1619: The Ming sends four columns against Nurhaci's Later Jin. He concentrates his forces and destroys three of them in a few days at Sarhu. The Ming loses the initiative in Liaodong.
steps.text_zh: 1619年，明军分四路进攻后金，努尔哈赤集中兵力各个击破，数日内歼灭三路明军。萨尔浒之战后，明朝在辽东转攻为守。

steps.text: 1626: Yuan Chonghuan holds Ningyuan with Western-style cannon and drives off Nurhaci, the first big defeat of his long career. Nurhaci dies later that same year.
steps.text_zh: 1626年，袁崇焕凭借坚城和西洋大炮守住宁远，击退努尔哈赤，这是后金起兵以来的首次大败，努尔哈赤同年去世。

steps.text: 1628: Years of drought in northern Shaanxi drive hungry farmers and unpaid soldiers to revolt. When the court cuts the postal service to save money, laid-off courier Li Zicheng joins the rebels.
steps.text_zh: 1628年，陕北连年大旱，饥民和欠饷的边兵纷纷起事。朝廷裁撤驿站节省开支，失业驿卒李自成也投身起义军。

steps.text: 1630: Hong Taiji's raid around the Wall to Beijing's gates in 1629 shakes the court. The Chongzhen Emperor, believing Yuan Chonghuan a traitor, has his best general executed.
steps.text_zh: 1629年，皇太极绕道蒙古破关，兵临北京城下。崇祯帝听信谗言，认定袁崇焕通敌，于1630年将其处死，自毁长城。

steps.text: 1641: Li Zicheng takes Luoyang, kills the wealthy Prince of Fu and opens his granaries to the starving. His army swells to hundreds of thousands.
steps.text_zh: 1641年，李自成攻克洛阳，杀死富甲一方的福王朱常洵，开仓放粮赈济饥民，起义军迅速扩大到数十万人。

steps.text: 1643: Sun Chuanting, the last field army commander the Ming can trust, is defeated and killed at Tong Pass. Li Zicheng enters Xi'an and holds the whole northwest.
steps.text_zh: 1643年，明朝最后一支可用的主力在潼关被击溃，督师孙传庭战死。李自成随即攻入西安，控制了整个西北。

steps.text: 1644: In the first month of the new year Li Zicheng founds the Great Shun dynasty in Xi'an, then marches east across Shanxi straight toward Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1644年正月，李自成在西安建立大顺政权，年号永昌，随即率军东渡黄河，经山西直取北京。

steps.text: Spring 1644: Shun troops enter Beijing. The Chongzhen Emperor hangs himself on Coal Hill behind the palace, and the Ming dynasty ends after 276 years.
steps.text_zh: 1644年三月，大顺军攻入北京，崇祯帝在紫禁城后的煤山自缢身亡，统治276年的明朝灭亡。

steps.text: 1644: Wu Sangui, holding Shanhai Pass, turns to the Manchus. Together they rout Li Zicheng, who abandons Beijing, and the Qing army pours through the pass into China.
steps.text_zh: 1644年，镇守山海关的吴三桂投降清朝，与清军联手大败李自成。李自成放弃北京西撤，清军由此入关。

title: The Qing conquest
summary: Eighteen years from Shanhai Pass to the last Ming holdouts in Yunnan and Taiwan.
summary_zh: 从山海关到台湾，清朝用十八年平定南明。

steps.text: 1644: The Manchu regent Dorgon joins forces with Wu Sangui at Shanhai Pass. The Qing cavalry breaks Li Zicheng's army, and the road to Beijing opens.
steps.text_zh: 1644年，摄政王多尔衮率清军与吴三桂合兵，在山海关大败李自成的大顺军，通往北京的大门由此打开。

steps.text: 1644: The Qing enter Beijing and hold funeral rites for the Chongzhen Emperor to win over Ming officials. In autumn the boy Shunzhi Emperor arrives from Shenyang and Beijing becomes the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1644年，清军进入北京，为崇祯帝发丧以笼络人心。秋天，年幼的顺治帝从盛京迁来，清朝定都北京。

steps.text: 1644: In Nanjing, Ming officials crown the Prince of Fu, Zhu Yousong. This Southern Ming court holds the land south of the Huai but is torn by factional quarrels.
steps.text_zh: 1644年，明朝遗臣在南京拥立福王朱由崧，建立弘光政权，史称南明。它据有淮河以南，但朝中党争不断。

steps.text: 1645: Shi Kefa defends Yangzhou against the advancing Qing armies. When the city falls he is killed, and the Qing troops sack and massacre it for ten days.
steps.text_zh: 1645年，史可法督师死守扬州，拒绝清军招降。城破后史可法殉国，清军在城中屠杀十日，史称“扬州十日”。

steps.text: 1645: Nanjing surrenders without a fight and the Hongguang Emperor is captured. Then the Qing order all men to shave their heads in the Manchu style, and towns like Jiading rise and are massacred.
steps.text_zh: 1645年，清军渡江，南京不战而降，弘光帝被俘。清廷随即颁布剃发令，江南各地奋起反抗，嘉定三次遭到屠城。

steps.text: 1652: Li Dingguo, a former rebel now fighting for the Ming Yongli Emperor, takes Guilin and drives the Qing prince Kong Youde to suicide, then kills Prince Nikan at Hengyang.
steps.text_zh: 1652年，原大西军将领李定国拥护永历帝，攻克桂林，逼死定南王孔有德，又在衡阳阵斩敬谨亲王尼堪，南明一度复振。

steps.text: 1659: Zheng Chenggong (Koxinga) and Zhang Huangyan sail up the Yangtze with a great fleet and besiege Nanjing, but Zheng is careless, is beaten outside the walls and retreats to Xiamen.
steps.text_zh: 1659年，郑成功与张煌言率大军溯长江而上，围攻南京。郑成功轻敌，在城下大败，退回厦门。

steps.text: 1662: Koxinga crosses the strait and forces the Dutch to surrender Fort Zeelandia, making Taiwan a Ming base. The same year the Yongli Emperor is killed in Kunming.
steps.text_zh: 1662年初，郑成功渡海围攻热兰遮城，迫使荷兰人投降，收复台湾作为抗清基地。同年，永历帝在昆明被杀，南明基本终结。

title: Kangxi secures the empire
summary: In twenty-five years the Kangxi Emperor crushes rebels, takes Taiwan, fixes the Russian border and defeats Galdan.
summary_zh: 康熙平三藩、收台湾、定中俄边界、败噶尔丹，奠定清朝版图。

steps.text: 1673: The young Kangxi Emperor orders the three great Chinese feudatories in the south to disband. Wu Sangui rises in Yunnan, and Geng Jingzhong and Shang Zhixin later join him.
steps.text_zh: 1673年，年轻的康熙帝下令撤藩，平西王吴三桂在云南起兵反清，耿精忠、尚之信相继响应，南方大半震动。

steps.text: 1678: With the war turning against him, Wu Sangui proclaims himself emperor of Zhou at Hengzhou in Hunan. He dies of illness a few months later.
steps.text_zh: 1678年，战局对吴三桂日益不利，他在湖南衡州称帝，国号周，几个月后便病死，叛军失去主心骨。

steps.text: 1681: Qing armies take Kunming and Wu Sangui's grandson Wu Shifan kills himself. After eight years of war the revolt of the Three Feudatories is over.
steps.text_zh: 1681年，清军三路会攻，攻破昆明，吴三桂之孙吴世璠自杀，历时八年的三藩之乱彻底平定。

steps.text: 1683: Admiral Shi Lang, a former Zheng officer, destroys the Zheng fleet off the Penghu islands. Zheng Keshuang, Koxinga's grandson, then surrenders Taiwan to the Qing.
steps.text_zh: 1683年，福建水师提督施琅在澎湖海战中击败郑军主力，郑成功之孙郑克塽投降，台湾归入清朝版图。

steps.text: 1684: Some officials want to abandon the island, but Kangxi takes Shi Lang's advice to keep it. Taiwan becomes a prefecture under Fujian province, ruled directly from Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1684年，朝中有人主张放弃台湾，康熙采纳施琅的意见保留台湾，设台湾府，隶属福建省。

steps.text: 1685: Russians have built a fort at Albazin on the Amur. Qing troops besiege it in 1685 and again in 1686, pressing Moscow to talk.
steps.text_zh: 1685年，清军围攻沙俄在黑龙江上游修筑的雅克萨城，次年再次围攻，迫使俄国同意谈判。

steps.text: 1689: The Treaty of Nerchinsk, China's first with a European state, sets the border along the Argun River and the Stanovoy range. The Amur basin stays with the Qing.
steps.text_zh: 1689年，中俄签订《尼布楚条约》，以额尔古纳河和外兴安岭为界，确认黑龙江流域归属清朝。这是中国与欧洲国家签订的第一个边界条约。

steps.text: 1690: Galdan, ruler of the Dzungars, drives east into Inner Mongolia. Kangxi takes the field himself, and at Ulan Butung, only a few hundred kilometres from Beijing, Qing guns force Galdan back.
steps.text_zh: 1690年，准噶尔首领噶尔丹东进漠南，距北京仅数百公里。康熙亲征，清军在乌兰布通以火器击败噶尔丹，迫其北逃。

steps.text: 1696: On a second personal campaign, Kangxi's general Fiyanggu crushes Galdan at Jao Modo near the Tula River. Galdan dies the next year, and Outer Mongolia comes under the Qing.
steps.text_zh: 1696年，康熙再次亲征，费扬古在土拉河畔的昭莫多大败噶尔丹。噶尔丹次年死去，喀尔喀蒙古从此归附清朝。

title: Yongzheng tightens the reins
summary: In thirteen years the Yongzheng emperor reforms taxes, replaces native chieftains, sets up the Grand Council and fights the Dzungars.
summary_zh: 雍正帝在位十三年，改革赋税，改土归流，设立军机处，在西北与准噶尔交战。

steps.text: 1723: the new Yongzheng emperor folds the poll tax into the land tax, so the landless no longer pay it. The next year he brings the meltage surcharges officials had pocketed into the public treasury.
steps.text_zh: 1723年，雍正帝即位，推行摊丁入亩，把人头税并入田赋，无地的人不再交丁银。次年又实行火耗归公，把地方私自加征的附加税收归国库。

steps.text: 1726: Ortai, governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, starts replacing hereditary native chieftains with regular appointed officials across Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi, bringing the southwest under direct rule.
steps.text_zh: 1726年，鄂尔泰出任云贵总督，在云南、贵州、广西大规模改土归流：废除世袭土司，改派可以调换的流官，朝廷直接统治西南山区。

steps.text: 1727: the Treaty of Kyakhta fixes the border between Mongolia and Russian Siberia. Kyakhta becomes the trading post through which Chinese tea flows to Russia for the next century and more.
steps.text_zh: 1727年，中俄签订《恰克图条约》，划定蒙古地区的中段边界，恰克图成为两国通商口岸，此后茶叶经这里大量输往俄国。

steps.text: 1729: to run the war against the Dzungars, Yongzheng sets up a small office in the palace, later the Grand Council. A few trusted ministers see him daily and draft secret edicts, sidelining the Grand Secretariat.
steps.text_zh: 1729年，为了指挥对准噶尔的战争，雍正在宫中设立军机房，后称军机处。几位亲信大臣每天面见皇帝，直接撰写密谕发往各地，内阁逐渐被架空。

steps.text: 1731: misled by false reports, the general Furdan pushes deep into the Altai and is ambushed by the Dzungars at Khoton Nuur. The Qing army is nearly wiped out.
steps.text_zh: 1731年，靖边大将军傅尔丹轻信敌情，率军深入，在和通泊遭准噶尔军伏击，清军损失惨重，几乎全军覆没。

steps.text: 1732: when the Dzungars strike east into Khalkha, the Mongol prince Tseringe routs them near Erdene Zuu monastery. The two sides then drift toward a truce.
steps.text_zh: 1732年，准噶尔军东进喀尔喀，额驸策棱率蒙古骑兵在光显寺（额尔德尼召）一带大败准噶尔军。双方此后逐渐停战议和。

steps.text: 1735: Miao people around Guzhou in Guizhou rise against the new officials. Yongzheng dies that year, and the Qianlong emperor sends Zhang Guangsi to crush the revolt, a sign of what direct rule had cost.
steps.text_zh: 1735年，贵州古州一带苗民不满新设官府的压迫，大规模起事。同年雍正帝去世，乾隆帝即位后派张广泗平定，改土归流的代价由此可见。

title: Qianlong's first southern tour
summary: Following his grandfather Kangxi, the Qianlong emperor travels down the Grand Canal to Hangzhou, inspecting river works and courting the south.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝效仿祖父康熙，沿大运河南下杭州，视察河工，笼络江南士民。

steps.text: January 1751: the Qianlong emperor sets out from Beijing with the empress dowager on his first southern tour, modelled on his grandfather Kangxi's six tours. The stated aims: river works and the people's welfare.
steps.text_zh: 1751年正月，乾隆帝奉皇太后从北京出发，开始第一次南巡。他效仿祖父康熙的六次南巡，名义上是视察河工、了解民情。

steps.text: 1751: the procession passes through Zhili into Shandong, via Dezhou and Jinan. Qianlong remits taxes in the places he passes through as a show of imperial favour.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，南巡队伍经直隶进入山东，经过德州、济南南下。乾隆下令减免沿途所经地方的钱粮，以示恩惠。

steps.text: 1751: the imperial barges reach Qingkou, where the Yellow River, the Huai and the Grand Canal meet. Qianlong inspects the Gaojia dike; keeping the rivers tamed and the canal open is the core of every tour.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，御舟到达黄河、淮河和运河交汇的清口。乾隆亲自察看高家堰等堤防，治理黄河、保障漕运是他历次南巡最重要的事务。

steps.text: 1751: at Yangzhou the rich salt merchants of the Huai region compete to build gardens and decorated pavilions for the emperor, and the city's garden culture flourishes as never before.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，乾隆来到扬州。富甲天下的两淮盐商争相修建园林、搭设彩棚迎驾，扬州园林由此更加兴盛。

steps.text: 1751: he reaches prosperous Suzhou. A few years later the court painter Xu Yang paints the long scroll Prosperous Suzhou and a set of scrolls of the southern tour, records of the region's wealth.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，他到达繁华的苏州。几年后宫廷画家徐扬绘成《姑苏繁华图》，又画《乾隆南巡图》，描绘了这一时期江南的富庶。

steps.text: 1751: in Hangzhou he tours West Lake and leaves poems carved in stone. On later tours he goes to Haining to inspect the Qiantang seawall and orders earthen dikes rebuilt in stone.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，乾隆抵达杭州，游览西湖并题诗刻石。后来几次南巡他还到海宁察看钱塘江海塘，下令把土塘改建为坚固的鱼鳞石塘。

steps.text: 1751: on the way back he stops at Jiangning (Nanjing), pays respects at the tomb of the Ming founder and reviews the Banner garrison, courting southern scholars while showing his strength.
steps.text_zh: 1751年，回程途中他到达江宁（今南京），祭拜明孝陵，又检阅驻防八旗，以此笼络江南士人、展示武力。

steps.text: Summer 1751: Qianlong returns to Beijing. He will tour the south five more times, the last in 1784. The six tours cost enormous sums, and in old age he reportedly admitted they had burdened the people.
steps.text_zh: 1751年夏，乾隆回到北京。此后他又五次南巡，最后一次在1784年。六次南巡耗费巨大，据说他晚年也承认劳民伤财。

title: Qianlong's Ten Great Campaigns
summary: Highlights of the wars Qianlong boasted of, from the conquest of Xinjiang to an army in the Himalayas.
summary_zh: 乾隆自诩的十全武功：从平定新疆到兵临喜马拉雅。

steps.text: 1755: The Dzungar khanate, the Qing's old rival on the steppe, is split by a succession war. Qianlong seizes the moment and sends armies to Ili, capturing the khan Dawachi.
steps.text_zh: 1755年，清朝的宿敌准噶尔汗国陷入内乱，乾隆抓住时机发兵直取伊犁，俘获准噶尔汗达瓦齐。

steps.text: 1757: Amursana, the Dzungar prince who had helped the Qing, rebels. Qing armies return, the khanate is destroyed and the north of Xinjiang comes under direct Qing rule.
steps.text_zh: 1757年，曾助清作战的阿睦尔撒纳起兵反清。清军再度进兵，准噶尔汗国灭亡，天山北路纳入清朝统治。

steps.text: 1759: The Khoja brothers rise in the oasis cities south of the Tianshan. Zhaohui defeats them and takes Kashgar, and the whole region is named Xinjiang, the 'new frontier'.
steps.text_zh: 1759年，大小和卓在天山南路起兵，兆惠率军平定，攻占喀什噶尔。天山南北归入清朝版图，统称“新疆”。

steps.text: 1766: Border clashes start a war with Burma. Four Qing invasions in the mountains of the southwest meet disease and hard fighting, and in 1769 both sides agree a truce.
steps.text_zh: 1766年，边境冲突引发清缅战争。清军先后四次入缅，在西南山区饱受瘴疫和苦战之苦，1769年双方议和。

steps.text: 1771: War breaks out again with the Jinchuan chiefdoms in western Sichuan. Agui needs five years and vast sums to take their stone towers, ending the war in 1776.
steps.text_zh: 1771年，四川西北的大小金川土司再度起兵。阿桂率军苦战五年，逐一攻克碉楼，1776年才平定，耗银六千余万两。

steps.text: 1787: Lin Shuangwen's rebellion has spread across most of Taiwan. Fuk'anggan crosses the strait with fresh troops and crushes it early the next year, capturing Lin.
steps.text_zh: 1787年，林爽文起义已席卷台湾大半。福康安率援军渡海，次年初平定起义，林爽文被俘。

steps.text: 1788: Qianlong sends troops into Vietnam to restore the Le king, but Nguyen Hue routs them at Thang Long early in 1789. Nguyen Hue then asks to be recognised and Qianlong accepts.
steps.text_zh: 1788年，清军出兵安南扶持黎朝，次年初在升龙被阮惠击败撤回。阮惠随后遣使请封，乾隆顺势承认。

steps.text: 1792: The Gurkhas of Nepal invade Tibet. Fuk'anggan leads an army over the Himalayas to near Kathmandu and the Gurkhas submit. Next year the Golden Urn is introduced in Tibet.
steps.text_zh: 1792年，廓尔喀侵入西藏，福康安率军翻越喜马拉雅山，直逼加德满都，廓尔喀请降。次年清朝在西藏推行金瓶掣签。

title: The First Opium War
summary: Britain goes to war over opium and forces China into its first unequal treaty.
summary_zh: 英国为鸦片发动战争，迫使清朝签订第一个不平等条约。

steps.text: 1839: Imperial commissioner Lin Zexu forces British merchants in Canton to hand over their opium and destroys more than a thousand tonnes of it at Humen. Britain decides on war.
steps.text_zh: 1839年，钦差大臣林则徐迫使英商交出鸦片，在虎门海滩销毁一千多吨。英国政府随即决定出兵。

steps.text: 1840: A British fleet sails north and seizes Dinghai on Zhoushan island, then appears off Tianjin. The alarmed Daoguang Emperor dismisses Lin Zexu and sends Qishan to negotiate.
steps.text_zh: 1840年，英国远征军北上攻占浙江定海，又直抵天津大沽口外。道光帝惊慌，撤换林则徐，派琦善到广州议和。

steps.text: 1841: Britain occupies Hong Kong Island in January. When talks fail, its ships smash the Humen forts and the veteran admiral Guan Tianpei dies at his post.
steps.text_zh: 1841年1月，英军占领香港岛。谈判破裂后，英舰攻破虎门炮台，水师提督关天培力战殉国。

steps.text: 1841: The British close in on Canton and the Qing commander pays a ransom for the city. In villages to the north, local militia at Sanyuanli surround a British detachment.
steps.text_zh: 1841年5月，英军进逼广州，奕山求和赎城。城北三元里一带乡民自发组织起来，围困了一支英军。

steps.text: 1842: Reinforced, the British take Xiamen and Ningbo, then in June storm the Wusong forts at the mouth of the Huangpu. The old general Chen Huacheng is killed and Shanghai falls.
steps.text_zh: 1841年后英军增兵，连陷厦门、宁波。1842年6月攻破吴淞炮台，老将陈化成战死，上海随即失守。

steps.text: 1842: The fleet sails up the Yangtze. Manchu troops at Zhenjiang fight hard before the city falls, and the Grand Canal, the empire's grain route, is cut.
steps.text_zh: 1842年7月，英舰溯长江而上进攻镇江，八旗守军顽强抵抗后城陷，漕运命脉大运河被切断。

steps.text: August 1842: With British guns off Nanjing, the Qing sign the Treaty of Nanking: Hong Kong Island is ceded, five ports are opened and an indemnity of 21 million silver dollars is paid.
steps.text_zh: 1842年8月，英舰兵临南京城下，清朝被迫签订《南京条约》：割让香港岛，开放五口通商，赔款2100万银元。

steps.text: 1843: The treaty is ratified and Hong Kong becomes a British colony. Shanghai and the other treaty ports open to foreign trade over the following months.
steps.text_zh: 1843年，《南京条约》正式换约生效，香港岛成为英国殖民地。上海等五个通商口岸陆续开埠。

title: The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
summary: From a Guangxi village to a capital at Nanjing, and fourteen years of the deadliest civil war of the century.
summary_zh: 从广西金田到天京，十四年战争席卷半个中国。

steps.text: 1851: Hong Xiuquan, who believes he is the younger brother of Jesus, leads his God Worshippers in revolt at Jintian village in Guangxi and proclaims the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
steps.text_zh: 1851年1月，自称上帝之子、耶稣之弟的洪秀全率拜上帝会在广西桂平金田村起义，建号太平天国。

steps.text: 1851: The Taipings take Yongan (today Mengshan) and hold it for half a year. Here Hong names his chief followers the Eastern, Western, Southern, Northern and Assistant kings.
steps.text_zh: 1851年秋，太平军攻占永安州（今蒙山），驻守半年，洪秀全在此分封东、西、南、北、翼五王，初步建立制度。

steps.text: 1852: Breaking north into Hunan, the Taipings besiege Changsha for about eighty days but fail to take it. The Western King Xiao Chaogui is killed in the fighting.
steps.text_zh: 1852年，太平军突围北上进入湖南，围攻长沙八十多天未能攻克，西王萧朝贵在战斗中阵亡。

steps.text: January 1853: The Taipings take Wuchang, their first provincial capital. Their army has grown to hundreds of thousands, and they leave the city to sail down the Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 1853年1月，太平军攻克湖北省城武昌，队伍扩大到数十万人，随即弃城乘船顺长江东下。

steps.text: March 1853: The Taipings capture Nanjing, rename it Tianjing, the Heavenly Capital, and make it their seat of government. For eleven years it faces the Qing across the empire.
steps.text_zh: 1853年3月，太平军攻克南京，改名天京，定为都城，颁布《天朝田亩制度》，与清朝形成南北对峙之势。

steps.text: 1853: A Northern Expedition under Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang reaches the outskirts of Tianjin, but cut off in the cold north it is wiped out by 1855.
steps.text_zh: 1853年，林凤祥、李开芳率北伐军一路打到天津附近，震动京师，但孤军深入、缺衣少粮，1855年全军覆没。

steps.text: 1856: Power struggles tear the leadership apart. The Eastern King Yang Xiuqing and thousands of followers are slaughtered, and the able Shi Dakai later leaves Tianjing with his army.
steps.text_zh: 1856年，天京事变爆发，东王杨秀清及部众数千人被杀，北王韦昌辉随后也被处死，翼王石达开不久率部出走，太平天国元气大伤。

steps.text: 1861: After a long siege, Zeng Guoquan's Hunan Army, raised by his brother Zeng Guofan, takes Anqing upriver from Tianjing. The capital loses its main shield.
steps.text_zh: 1861年，曾国藩创建的湘军由其弟曾国荃率领，围攻安庆一年多后破城，天京失去上游最重要的屏障。

steps.text: 1864: Hong Xiuquan dies, and weeks later the Hunan Army breaks into Tianjing and sacks it. The war has left tens of millions dead across southern China.
steps.text_zh: 1864年，洪秀全病逝，一个多月后湘军攻破天京，太平天国失败。这场战争使南方各省死亡数千万人。

title: The Self-Strengthening Movement
summary: After the Opium Wars and the Taiping war, Qing officials build arsenals, shipyards, mines and a navy on the Western model.
summary_zh: 两次鸦片战争和太平天国战争之后，清朝官员仿效西方兴办军工、船厂、矿务和海军。

steps.text: 1861: after taking Anqing from the Taiping, Zeng Guofan opens an arsenal there to copy Western guns. Xu Shou and Hua Hengfang work on steam engines and later build the Huanghu, China's first home-made steamship.
steps.text_zh: 1861年，曾国藩攻下安庆后设立内军械所，试造洋枪洋炮。徐寿、华蘅芳等在这里试制轮船，后来造成中国第一艘自制的蒸汽轮船“黄鹄号”。

steps.text: 1865: Zeng and Li Hongzhang found the Jiangnan Arsenal in Shanghai, the largest in the country, making guns, ammunition and steamships. Its translation bureau puts many Western science books into Chinese.
steps.text_zh: 1865年，曾国藩、李鸿章在上海创办江南制造总局，制造枪炮弹药和轮船，是当时国内最大的军工厂。附设的翻译馆译出大批西方科技书籍。

steps.text: 1866: Zuo Zongtang founds the Fuzhou Navy Yard at Mawei, run by Shen Baozhen. Its naval school trains a generation of officers and thinkers, including Yan Fu and Deng Shichang.
steps.text_zh: 1866年，左宗棠奏请在福州马尾创办船政局，由沈葆桢主持，建造军舰。附设的船政学堂培养了严复、邓世昌等一批近代海军人才。

steps.text: 1867: the Tianjin Machine Works is founded and later enlarged by Li Hongzhang. It makes gunpowder and ammunition for the Huai Army in the north and later for the Beiyang fleet.
steps.text_zh: 1867年，天津机器局创办，后由李鸿章扩建，主要制造火药和枪炮弹药，供应北方的淮军和后来的北洋海军。

steps.text: 1872: Li Hongzhang sets up the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company in Shanghai, merchant-run under official supervision, to compete with foreign lines on the Yangzi and the coast. The movement now seeks wealth as well as arms.
steps.text_zh: 1872年，李鸿章在上海创办轮船招商局，采用官督商办的方式，与外国轮船公司争夺长江和沿海航运，洋务从军事转向求富。

steps.text: 1878: Tong King-sing opens the Kaiping mines at Tangshan with modern machinery. The Tangxu railway, built in 1881 to haul the coal, is the first working railway China built for itself.
steps.text_zh: 1878年，唐廷枢在河北唐山创办开平矿务局，用机器采煤。为运煤修建的唐胥铁路于1881年通车，是中国自建的第一条实用铁路。

steps.text: 1888: the Beiyang fleet is formally established at Weihaiwei, based on Liugong island. With German-built ironclads such as Dingyuan and Zhenyuan, it is called the strongest navy in Asia.
steps.text_zh: 1888年，北洋水师在威海卫正式成军，以刘公岛为基地，拥有从德国购买的定远、镇远等铁甲舰，号称亚洲第一。

steps.text: 1890: Zhang Zhidong, governor-general at Wuchang, begins the Hanyang Iron Works, Asia's first large modern steel plant. Yet most of these ventures stayed under official control and achieved less than hoped.
steps.text_zh: 1890年，湖广总督张之洞在汉阳开工兴建汉阳铁厂，几年后投产，是亚洲最早的大型近代钢铁企业。但洋务各业多由官府控制，成效有限。

title: Zuo Zongtang retakes Xinjiang
summary: After Yakub Beg and Russia carve up Xinjiang, Zuo Zongtang's army marches out of Gansu and wins it back, and Xinjiang becomes a province.
summary_zh: 阿古柏入侵、沙俄占据伊犁之后，左宗棠率军出关收复新疆，新疆随后建省。

steps.text: 1865: amid uprisings across Xinjiang, Yakub Beg, an officer from the Khanate of Kokand, enters Kashgar. Within a few years his regime holds the southern oases and takes Urumqi.
steps.text_zh: 1865年，趁新疆各地反清起事之机，中亚浩罕汗国的军官阿古柏进入喀什噶尔，逐步建立政权，几年间占据南疆，又攻占乌鲁木齐。

steps.text: 1871: Russia occupies the Ili valley, claiming to hold it for the Qing until order returns. Russian officials begin governing it, and now northern Xinjiang is in foreign hands too.
steps.text_zh: 1871年，沙俄以“代为收复”为名出兵占领伊犁地区，并在当地设官收税，新疆北部也落入外国之手。

steps.text: 1875: at court, coastal defence and frontier defence compete for money. Zuo Zongtang argues Xinjiang must be saved and is put in charge, raising grain, funds and arms at Lanzhou.
steps.text_zh: 1875年，朝中爆发“海防”与“塞防”之争。左宗棠力主收复新疆，被任命为钦差大臣督办新疆军务，在兰州筹粮筹饷，设机器局造枪炮。

steps.text: 1876: Zuo moves his headquarters to Suzhou (Jiuquan) with a plan to take the north first and to prepare slowly but strike fast. Liu Jintang leads the main army out through Jiayu Pass.
steps.text_zh: 1876年，左宗棠移驻肃州坐镇指挥，定下“先北后南、缓进急战”的方略。刘锦棠率湘军主力出嘉峪关西进。

steps.text: Summer 1876: Liu Jintang storms the fort of Gumudi and then retakes Urumqi and the nearby towns. Apart from Ili, the land north of the Tianshan is back under Qing control.
steps.text_zh: 1876年夏，刘锦棠攻克古牧地，随即收复乌鲁木齐、昌吉等城，天山北路除伊犁外大体平定。

steps.text: Spring 1877: Qing troops take Dabancheng, the pass through the Tianshan, and then Turpan, opening the way south. Soon after, Yakub Beg dies suddenly at Korla and his state falls apart.
steps.text_zh: 1877年春，清军攻克天山门户达坂城，又收复吐鲁番，打开了南疆大门。不久阿古柏在库尔勒突然死去，其政权迅速瓦解。

steps.text: Early 1878: Liu Jintang retakes Kashgar, Khotan and the other southern oases. Yakub Beg's state is gone and all of Xinjiang except Ili is recovered.
steps.text_zh: 1878年初，刘锦棠收复喀什噶尔、和田等南疆城市，阿古柏政权彻底覆灭，新疆除伊犁外全部收复。

steps.text: 1881: rejecting an earlier ruinous treaty, Zeng Jize renegotiates in St Petersburg and recovers most of Ili. Zuo had already moved to Hami, famously bringing his own coffin to show his resolve.
steps.text_zh: 1881年，崇厚此前签订的丧权条约被否决，曾纪泽赴俄重新谈判，签订《中俄伊犁条约》，收回伊犁大部分地区。此前左宗棠已带着棺材出关到哈密，以示决心。

steps.text: 1884: Xinjiang becomes a province with its capital at Dihua (Urumqi) and Liu Jintang as first governor. It is now run with the same prefectures and counties as the rest of China.
steps.text_zh: 1884年，清朝在新疆设省，以迪化（今乌鲁木齐）为省会，刘锦棠任首任巡抚，新疆从此实行与内地相同的郡县制度。

title: The Sino-French War
summary: France and the Qing fight over Vietnam on land and sea; the Qing wins at Zhennan Pass yet signs away its claim.
summary_zh: 中法两国为争夺越南在陆上和海上交战，清军取得镇南关大捷，最后却签约承认法国对越南的控制。

steps.text: 1883: France forces Vietnam to accept a protectorate and attacks Liu Yongfu's Black Flag army and Qing troops on the Red River. In December it takes Son Tay and the war begins.
steps.text_zh: 1883年，法国迫使越南接受保护，又进攻驻守红河的刘永福黑旗军和清军。年底法军攻陷山西，中法战争爆发。

steps.text: March 1884: the Qing garrison at Bac Ninh collapses almost without a fight. In Beijing the empress dowager Cixi uses the defeat to dismiss Prince Gong and the whole Grand Council.
steps.text_zh: 1884年3月，驻守北宁的清军几乎不战而溃。消息传到北京，慈禧太后借机罢免恭亲王奕訢等全班军机大臣。

steps.text: August 1884: Admiral Courbet's squadron opens fire at Mawei near Fuzhou. In about half an hour the Fujian fleet is nearly destroyed and the navy yard is shelled.
steps.text_zh: 1884年8月，孤拔率法国舰队在福州马尾突然开火，福建水师在半小时内几乎全军覆没，马尾船厂也遭炮击。

steps.text: 1884: the French attack northern Taiwan. Liu Mingchuan gives up Keelung to concentrate his forces and in October beats off a landing at Tamsui. The next year Taiwan becomes a province.
steps.text_zh: 1884年，法军进攻台湾北部。督办台湾军务的刘铭传弃守基隆，集中兵力，10月在淡水（沪尾）击退登陆法军。次年台湾建省。

steps.text: March 1885: the French squadron attacks the mouth of the Yong river at Zhenhai in Zhejiang and is driven off by shore batteries. In June Courbet dies of illness in the Penghu islands.
steps.text_zh: 1885年3月，法国舰队进犯浙江镇海口，守军凭借炮台击退法舰。同年6月，法军统帅孤拔在澎湖病死。

steps.text: March 1885: the veteran Feng Zicai, nearly seventy, holds a long wall at Zhennan Pass and leads his men in hand-to-hand fighting. The French are routed and the land war turns.
steps.text_zh: 1885年3月，年近七十的老将冯子材在镇南关筑起长墙固守，率部与法军肉搏，大败法军，扭转了陆上战局。

steps.text: 1885: Qing troops follow up and retake Lang Son, a key town in northern Vietnam, as the French fall back. When the news reaches Paris, Jules Ferry's government falls.
steps.text_zh: 1885年，清军乘胜追击，收复越南北部重镇谅山，法军全线后撤。消息传到巴黎，茹费理内阁因此倒台。

steps.text: June 1885: Li Hongzhang signs a treaty at Tianjin recognising the French protectorate over Vietnam and opening the border to trade. Critics said China had lost a war it had not lost.
steps.text_zh: 1885年6月，李鸿章与法国代表在天津签订《中法新约》，承认法国对越南的保护，开放中越边境通商。清朝在军事占优时求和，被时人讥为不败而败。

title: From the Sino-Japanese War to the Revolution
summary: Eighteen years from defeat by Japan to the end of two thousand years of emperors.
summary_zh: 从甲午战败到清帝退位，十八年间帝制走向终结。

steps.text: 1894: Japan and China go to war over Korea. In September the Qing army at Pyongyang is beaten and retreats in disorder to the Yalu River.
steps.text_zh: 1894年，中日因朝鲜问题爆发甲午战争。9月平壤之战，清军战败，一路溃退到鸭绿江边。

steps.text: 1894: In the Yellow Sea off the Yalu mouth, the Japanese navy defeats the Beiyang Fleet. Captain Deng Shichang goes down with his ship Zhiyuan.
steps.text_zh: 1894年9月，北洋舰队与日本联合舰队在黄海大东沟海面激战，致远舰管带邓世昌壮烈殉国，北洋舰队受重创。

steps.text: 1895: Japanese troops land and take the forts around Weihaiwei from behind. The trapped Beiyang Fleet is destroyed and Admiral Ding Ruchang takes his own life.
steps.text_zh: 1895年初，日军从陆路攻占威海卫炮台，北洋舰队困守港内全军覆没，提督丁汝昌自杀。

steps.text: 1895: Li Hongzhang signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki: Taiwan, Penghu and the Liaodong peninsula are ceded and 200 million taels are paid. Russia, Germany and France soon force Japan to return Liaodong.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，李鸿章在日本马关签订《马关条约》，割让台湾、澎湖和辽东半岛，赔款白银二亿两。不久俄德法三国干涉，清朝赎回辽东。

steps.text: 1898: The Guangxu Emperor backs Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao in sweeping reforms. After about a hundred days Empress Dowager Cixi stops them and six reformers are executed.
steps.text_zh: 1898年，光绪帝任用康有为、梁启超等推行变法。仅约百日，慈禧太后发动政变，光绪被囚，谭嗣同等六君子遇害。

steps.text: 1900: Boxer bands flood into Beijing and Tianjin and besiege the legations. An eight-nation force takes Beijing, Cixi flees to Xi'an, and the 1901 Boxer Protocol imposes huge indemnities.
steps.text_zh: 1900年，义和团涌入京津，围攻使馆区。八国联军攻占北京，慈禧挟光绪西逃，次年清朝签订《辛丑条约》，赔款四亿五千万两。

steps.text: 10 October 1911: Revolutionary soldiers of the New Army rise at Wuchang and take the city. Within weeks most provinces declare independence from the Qing.
steps.text_zh: 1911年10月10日，革命党人联络的新军在武昌起义，成立湖北军政府。一个多月内，全国多数省份宣布脱离清朝独立。

steps.text: 1 January 1912: Sun Yat-sen takes office in Nanjing as provisional president of the Republic of China, the first republic in Asia. But the Qing court still sits in Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1912年1月1日，孙中山在南京就任临时大总统，宣告中华民国成立，亚洲第一个共和国诞生。

steps.text: 12 February 1912: Under pressure from Yuan Shikai, the child emperor Puyi abdicates. The Qing dynasty ends, and with it more than two thousand years of imperial rule.
steps.text_zh: 1912年2月12日，在袁世凯逼迫下，宣统帝溥仪退位，清朝灭亡，延续两千多年的帝制就此结束。

title: The 1911 Revolution
summary: From failed plots in Guangzhou to the Wuchang rising, revolutionaries bring down the Qing within four months.
summary_zh: 革命党人从广州的屡次失败起义到武昌首义，短短四个月间推翻了清朝。

steps.text: 1895: a year after founding the Revive China Society in Honolulu, Sun Yat-sen plans a rising in Guangzhou. The plot leaks, Lu Haodong is executed and Sun flees abroad.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，孙中山前一年在檀香山创立兴中会后，策划在广州起义。因走漏消息而失败，陆皓东被捕遇害，孙中山流亡海外。

steps.text: 1905: in Tokyo, Sun Yat-sen, Huang Xing and others merge several groups into the Tongmenghui. Its program: expel the Manchus, restore China, found a republic and equalise land rights.
steps.text_zh: 1905年，孙中山、黄兴等在日本东京联合兴中会、华兴会等团体，成立中国同盟会，提出“驱除鞑虏，恢复中华，创立民国，平均地权”的纲领。

steps.text: April 1911: Huang Xing leads a suicide squad against the governor-general's office in Guangzhou and is beaten. Seventy-two of the dead are buried at Huanghuagang, and the defeat fires up the movement.
steps.text_zh: 1911年4月，黄兴率敢死队攻打广州两广总督衙门，激战后失败。事后收殓的七十二位烈士葬在黄花岗，革命声势反而大振。

steps.text: May 1911: the court nationalises the privately funded Sichuan railway to pledge it for foreign loans. Sichuan rises in protest; after a massacre in Chengdu in September, Hubei's New Army is sent in.
steps.text_zh: 1911年5月，清廷宣布铁路国有，把民间集资的川汉铁路收回抵押借款，四川各界组织保路同志会。9月成都发生血案，清廷调湖北新军入川镇压。

steps.text: October 1911: a bomb goes off by accident in a Hankou safehouse and the members' list is seized. On the night of the 10th the engineers of the Wuchang New Army rise early, take Wuchang, then Hanyang and Hankou.
steps.text_zh: 1911年10月，革命党人在汉口制造炸弹时意外爆炸，名册落入官府手中。10日晚武昌新军工程营被迫提前起义，次日占领武昌，汉阳、汉口随即光复。

steps.text: 22 October 1911: Changsha in Hunan and Xi'an in Shaanxi declare independence on the same day. Jiangxi, Shanxi, Yunnan, Guizhou and others follow, and Qing rule crumbles.
steps.text_zh: 1911年10月22日，湖南长沙和陕西西安同一天宣布独立。此后江西、山西、云南、贵州等省接连响应，清朝的统治迅速瓦解。

steps.text: Early November 1911: Chen Qimei's men seize Shanghai, and Jiangsu and Zhejiang declare for the revolution. The rich southeast is now on the revolutionary side.
steps.text_zh: 1911年11月初，陈其美等在上海发动起义，光复上海，随后江苏、浙江也宣布独立，东南财富之区转向革命。

steps.text: 1 January 1912: Sun Yat-sen takes office as provisional president in Nanjing, which Jiangsu and Zhejiang forces had captured in early December. Delegates of seventeen provinces had elected him.
steps.text_zh: 1912年1月1日，孙中山在南京就任临时大总统。此前江浙联军已于12月初攻克南京，十七省代表选举孙中山，南京成为民国首都。

steps.text: 12 February 1912: after north-south talks, the court accepts Yuan Shikai's terms of favourable treatment and abdicates. Sun resigns the next day, and Yuan becomes provisional president in Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1912年2月12日，经南北议和，清廷在袁世凯安排下接受优待条件，宣布退位。次日孙中山辞职，袁世凯随后在北京就任临时大总统。
